251522.title: Blood-Stained Letter
pages:
My dearest Tabitha,

How strange it is to foretell my own death. I've written this note as I do not know the hour when fate will claim me and although I know that this is a poor apology for a proper speech, my quill fails in its attempt to convey my pain for departing from you.

Every day I wake to the sorrow I failed to protect you from. I am sorry I could not protect our dear boy and I am sorry that my grieving has fallen into a trap from which it cannot escape.

You are my love, and my confidante and my life counted for more than it could alone. Every week when I venture into the ruins of our once proud home, I fear it would be my last, and every time I am thankful I have you to return to.

I pray we are reunited, if even for a moment.

251941.title: Scribbled Letter
pages:
Oi, you, $C. Get off yer duff and come see me behind the abbey. A soft, green hunter such as yerself canna hope to survive let alone thrive in this land without some guidance, and ol' Tordrin is here to provide it, if ye have the guts!

Tordrin Stemblade, (extremely handsome) Hunter Trainer

254871.title: Bloody Note
pages: The cult hit us by surprise. Raani never saw it coming and Arvensus took a sword to the gut. For my part, I took a lightning bolt to the chest and blacked out. They never bothered to finish me off... I guess they assumed my wounds would do me in. When it's all said and done, I suspect they might.

As soon as the fighting stopped, they started moving massive crates of windstones to the top of the tower. The leader, some kind of priest, said something about a ritual.

I'm writing this note just in case I don't make it back to Shen'dar to warn Aonda, but they are doing something here. Something bad.

If anyone finds this, please, do your best to stop them. There were only a few left at the tower when I scribbled this note and crawled away.

Also, try and get Raani's lucky feather from his body. He liked to tell tall tales about how he plucked it from some kind of firebird and I think he'd want to make sure that it made its way back home.

If you are also able to retrieve Arvensus Shadowsong's family signet from his body, please do so. High Elder Shadowsong is his uncle and he would want it to be returned to the family.

264693.title: Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans
pages:
We will attack the city of Brill just before dawn. The ancillary force will set the zeppelin tower aflame as a distraction. Once the fire is lit and the city defenders are drawn away, the main force led by the lieutenant will engage from the north. The Magistrate and civilians are the primary targets. Destroy all you see, and incinerate the bodies.

They say that the Forsaken feel no fear. We will put the fear of the light back into them, brothers and sisters. For Lordaeron!

265782.title: Mysterious Orders
pages:
Brother Haalien,

It is time to prove your worth to the Al'Aketh! Go into Shadowgale to find the pylon. You have conveyed your concerns about the druids and the highest in our order have heard you.

Take these faithful soldiers with you in your righteous mission. Kill the druids swiftly lest they interfere with our plans. We have eyes and ears in Valanaar that will confirm when you have been successful.

The time of reckoning is at hand! None shall be able to stop the ushering!

-N

266895.title: Solomon's Plea to Farholde
pages:
Lord Ebonlocke--

The Township of Lakeshire humbly requests the aid of the Night Watch.  We are under siege from both the Blackrock orcs and Morganth's Shadowhide gnolls.  I would not send bidding if our situation was not severe.  We await aid from Stormwind but until such help arrives, I beg of you to lend support.  Once the kingdom is breached, all of humanity is in peril.

Magistrate Solomon

267454.title: Trevan's Weapon Notes
pages:
$N,
Old Fire-Eye is a magical creature of the night, and as such, we require a magical weapon that is also of the night. We can infuse such a weapon with the light of the full moon and use it to turn the dark magic that drives this creature against itself. For this, we need a specific set of materials to craft a blade of brilliant moonsilver, capable of destroying this evil utterly.

This won't be easy, but you've shown great promise so I trust that you'll be able to get what we need.

Enchanted Moonsilver - This is the key ingredient to our creation. Moonsilver is an incredibly rare material, made from enchanted silver infused with the raw power of the moon. A number of weapons were forged to fight off the worgen once the curse began to take hold in Silverpine. Unfortunately they are all lost now and the location of the last remaining moonsilver ingots is unknown.

There is a rumor that there was a cache of such material in Shadowfang Keep to the south. It's a longshot, but it's our best bet for now to find some of this moonsilver.

Some good whitestone oak - There is a place in Westfall known as Moonbrook that once had an abundance of the lumber, used by the alliance artisans to rebuild stormwind after the second war.

Moonbrook has fallen on tough times, but I've heard that goblin woodcarvers have been hired by a syndicate of bandits to build something in the mines under the town. I'd bet my left boot that they would have claimed any of the rare lumber that was left in town when they moved in.

A Kor Gem - From the tales I've been told, the gems are used by some spell casters to hold energy for their magics, making them even deadlier. I believe one of the gem's stored energies can be used in your weapon's creation.

There is a mage I once knew called Ulric Frostveil that can tell you more of these gems. Last I heard he was in kalimdor, at the Zoram'gar Outpost in western Ashenvale.

270151.title: Benedict's Orders
pages:
Corporal Adamore,

At first light you are to muster a force of no more than 10 marines and report to a bounty hunter by the name of Terry Longdrink. You will be joining him in pursuit of a dangerous deserter whom you should presume to be armed and hostile.

This bounty hunter was a trusted ally of the Lord Admiral before his passing, and I expect you to show Longdrink the same deference you'd show any superior officer.

--Lieutenant Benedict

270308.title: The First Tablet of I'lalai
pages:
A Moon over the Vale shines
Casting its glow upon the jungle
Where proud Warriors heed the call
To defend our Nation and sacred grounds.

A Moon over the Vale shines
Far above the cries of battle
Where blood is spilled
Of foe and comrade alike.

And when our brethren pass
Into realms beyond the known
The soul-spirit hardens
Deep beneath the Vale.

And when our brethren pass
Into the Mountain's Temple
We shall protect their eternal spirit
Encased within the holy blue crystal.

And when our brethren pass
A Moon over the Vale shines.

272319.title: Tattered Note
pages: Gul'dan agreed and decided that once the denizens of Azeroth were beaten, he would find the legendary tomb and claim his reward. Assured that the Horde would serve his purposes, Sargeras ordered the invasion to begin.

Through a joint effort, Medivh and the warlocks of the Shadow Council opened the dimensional gateway known as the Dark Portal. This portal bridged the distance between Azeroth and Draenor, and it was large enough that armies might pass through it. Gul'dan dispatched orc scouts through the portal to survey the lands which they would conquer. The returning scouts assured the Shadow Council that the world of Azeroth was ripe for the taking.

Still convinced that Gul'dan's corruption would destroy his people, Durotan spoke out against the warlocks once more. The brave warrior claimed that warlocks were destroying the purity of the orcish spirit and that this reckless invasion would be their doom. Gul'dan, unable to risk killing such a popular hero, was forced to exile Durotan and his Frostwolf Clan into the far reaches of this new world.

After the exiled Frostwolves charged through the portal, only a few orc clans followed. These orcs quickly set up a base of operations within the Black Morass, a dark and swampy area far to the east of the kingdom of Stormwind. As the orcs began to branch out and explore the new lands, they came into immediate conflict with the human defenders of Stormwind.

Though these skirmishes usually ended quickly, they did much to illustrate the weaknesses and strengths of both rival species. Llane and Lothar were never able to gather accurate data of the orcs' numbers and could only guess at how great a force they would have to contend with.

After a few years the majority of the orcish Horde had crossed into Azeroth, and Gul'dan deemed that the time for the primary strike against humanity had come. The Horde launched its full might against the unsuspecting kingdom of Stormwind.

As the forces of Azeroth and the Horde clashed across the kingdom, internal conflicts began to take their toll on both armies. King Llane, who believed the bestial orcs to be incapable of conquering Azeroth, contemptuously held his position at his capital of Stormwind. However, Sir Lothar became convinced that the battle should be taken directly to the enemy, and he was forced to choose between his convictions and his loyalty to the king.

Choosing to follow his instincts, Lothar stormed Medivh's tower-fortress of Karazhan with the help of the wizard's young apprentice, Khadgar. Khadgar and Lothar succeeded in vanquishing the possessed Guardian, whom they confirmed to be the source of the conflict.

By killing Medivh's body, Lothar and the young apprentice inadvertently banished the spirit of Sargeras to the abyss. As a consequence, the pure, virtuous spirit of Medivh was also allowed to live on... and wander the astral plane for many years to come.

Although Medivh had been defeated, the Horde continued to dominate the defenders of Stormwind. As the Horde's victory drew nearer, Orgrim Doomhammer, one of the greatest orc chieftains, began to see the depraved corruption that had spread throughout the clans since their time in Draenor.

His old comrade, Durotan, returned from exile and warned him yet again of Gul'dan's treachery. In speedy retribution, Gul'dan's assassins murdered Durotan and his family, leaving only his infant son alive. Unknown to Doomhammer was the fact that Durotan's infant son was found by the human officer, Aedelas Blackmoore, and taken as a slave.

That infant orc would one day rise to become the greatest leader his people would ever know.

Incensed by Durotan's death, Orgrim set out to free the Horde from demonic corruption and ultimately assumed the role of warchief of the Horde by killing Gul'dan's corrupt puppet, Blackhand. Under his decisive leadership the relentless Horde finally laid siege to Stormwind Keep.

King Llane had severely underestimated the might of the Horde, and he watched helplessly as his kingdom fell to the green-skinned invaders. Ultimately King Llane was assassinated by one of the Shadow Council's finest killers: the half-orc, Garona.

Lothar and his warriors, returning home from Karazhan, hoped to stem the loss of life and save their once-glorious homeland. Instead, they returned too late and found their beloved kingdom in smoking ruins. The orcish Horde continued to ravage the countryside and claimed the surrounding lands for its own. Forced into hiding, Lothar and his companions swore a grim oath to reclaim their homeland at any cost.

273658.title: Bloody Parchment
pages:
It is encouraging to hear that the new magic that our lord provided has performed above expectations. If the venom is as effective as you claim, it will be a powerful tool for us to use in the conflict to come. I told you that there was much to be learned from the undead littering our mountain. Don't worry, I won't hold your initial skepticism against you.

Finish your business there and return to the summit with your samples. No need to cull the beasts. If they spread to neighboring areas, they will only sow chaos, confusion and fear. This will serve to further the Pact's goals, in the end.

Good work. The Wild King will surely be pleased with what you have accomplished.

pages:
The tunnels have reached the bluffs within Thousand Needles and our preparations have gone unseen, but we must act swiftly. We cannot allow those fools at the Freewind Post to discover us before we are ready to move.

Send your shaman. With all that Hirzek has accomplished we are ready to begin.

The storm will rage, the ground will rumble and the tide shall rise, leaving only carcasses to animate in our wake. Their bones will blaze a trail into...

274483.title: The Walks of Shaman
pages:
Azeroth is home to a host of brilliant creatures. It shows no favoritism. If you learn to listen to her, feel her presence and answer her call, it is simple to wield her strengths.

With time and patience anyone can hear the elements, but our totems lend us a conduit with which to channel this power. More civilized cultures only bestow a totem on those who have proven themselves worthy, but a suitably powerful shaman can create one at will.

We have seen such creatures wield the elements for evil. With enough corruption in the land, Azeroth cries out for protectors against these twisted totems. With enough of the corrupted conduits, one can even call upon the tainted elements and banish them back to the planes.

The Mauradine Centaur of Desolace.

When you use shamanism to empower your people, it demands harmony with nature. The wind answers your call because it chooses to. You are its champion, and it becomes the power that lets your people soar. However, the Mauradine have no respect for this balance.

This particular clan has only wielded this power for selfish gain. Hunting parties flying across the plains to stalk their foes, spellcasters channeling great storms to burn villages. And even this is not enough. They have created totems of hideous power, forcing the elements to bend to their will.

It is not for us to decide Azeroth's desires, but one thing is clear. The Mauradine are no friends to the elements.

The Mirefin Murlocs of Dustwallow Marsh.

Murlocs have an innate connection to water as any seafolk, but in a curious way. Many species can recognize the elements in nature without tapping directly into it. The murlocs, however, not only can call upon water, but wield it with surprising intelligence.

Their oracles have a curious affinity for restorative magic. Water is a source of healing for all creatures, from hydration to medicine, but the murlocs managed to tap into its even deeper sources of power. What takes some adepts decades to master, some murlocs seem to be born with this gift.

If this were any other shaman, one would think this to be a blessing. But they are murlocs, after all. Their healing magic is as much a weapon as any other, keeping their hunters sharp and their shores battle-ready. Using totems is curious for a species like this, but make no mistake. They are as corrupt as their masters.

The Stonevault Troggs of the Badlands.

The element of fire is often misunderstood as a source of destruction. While uncontrolled fire is indeed the mark of an uncontrolled spirit, a focused flame lights homes and staves off the bitter cold. A people who learn to master this element are sure to be prosperous--both in battle and at home.

The Stonevault troggs are no exception.

Troggs are rather simple creatures. They aren't known for great demonstrations of power or even particularly cohesive aggression. It wasn't until their discovery of fire that they were even considered a culture worth investigating. But the elements show no favoritism.

As the troggs have evolved, they have learned how to harness fire for their tribal barbarism. Getting hit with a club is one thing, but an aggressive trogg with a fire totem is another matter entirely. The element of fire may respect keeping their culture alive, but certainly not how their totems have been used for blind cruelty.

The Lost Ones of the Swamp of Sorrows.

Earth is the element of fortitude and steadiness. A shaman capable of harnessing the earth's power can guarantee their people sturdy homes and durable warriors. What could otherwise flatten another combatant can be shrugged off by one gifted by the powers of earth.

It can also be used to crumble others.

When left to their devices, the Lost Ones rarely interfere with the goings on of other cultures. They stalk about in a mindless fugue state as if they don't truly belong anywhere. The only thing that offers them grounding is the elements.

Unlike the others mentioned, it is not necessarily believed that the Lost Ones have a genuine desire for harm. Earth offers them solace in their aimless wandering. However, with this comes their dependence.

Calling on the elements for aid is one thing, but demanding their presence is another. They are our guides, not our crutches. Now their totems are just as twisted as the Lost Ones themselves.

279045.title: Thundris' Letter
pages:
Mr. Alexston of Stormwind,

I must congratulate you on the long journey restoring the city of Stormwind. Many whose path crosses Auberdine speak well of its grandeur and sound foundations. It is this success that bid me send you this message.

Auberdine has found its place in this world by the sea. Where we were once isolated, we now find hope carried by the very winds that batter our shores.

This courier represents one such traveler the winds bore to me. I hope that they may aid your people as they have mine.

In return, I ask that you might send supplies and labor to Auberdine, such that we might bolster the city against the wrath of this world that has taken so much from us.

-- Thundris Windweaver, Elder of Auberdine

279048.title: Alexston's Reply
pages:
I know how this letter will find you, and I am truly sorry about that, elder.

Without a doubt, I will send any able-bodied adventurers I can through your fine town. I hope their impact will make up for the lack of other support I can bring at this time.

Our lands are pressured by a great many enemies. I'm sure you are no stranger to that world yourself, but it has painfully drained what resources we have.

Should that change, I would love to help, but even then there are many projects close to home that will demand priority.

Hold strong. We're all in this together.

-- Baros Alexston
City Architect, Stormwind

280430.title: Mountaineer Gretchen's Report
pages:
A Report on the State of wendigo in the caves near Kharanos

Written by Mountaineer Gretchen based on the findings of Mountaineer Cornelius

The wendigo rarely leave their caves, but there have been reports that they have attacked civilians around nearby settlements such as Kharanos and Brewnall Village. They seem to be growing increasingly agitated as they search for food. We have now lost one of our own to the efforts of containing them. While the full removal of these beasts is impractical, the mountaineers request

additional resources to limit their spread. We can't continue to rely on throwing adventurers at the problem and hope for the best. Sooner or later the food will run out, and the wendigo will be forced to attack our cities directly. Maybe even Ironforge itself.

Please offer my condolences to the family of Mountaineer Cornelius, who bravely fought to keep the people of Dun Morogh safe.

281046.title: Raven Hill Tome
pages:
Memories of Valor
A Recount of the Valor Family and Their Service to Raven Hill

There was no greater family in all of the Eastern Kingdoms than the Valor family. Their deeds to the people they swore to protect were nothing short of miracles, and their loss is a loss for all of Raven Hill.

I write this account to set the record straight, detailing the marvels that were Grant, Ira, Silvia, and Merrick. May these writings be a small consolation for how sorry I am for their absence.

Merrick Valor, Watcher of Darkshire

Merrick was the youngest son of the Valor family. As he witnessed the corruption coming to his homeland, he chose to join The Watch in a desperate bid to protect his loved ones.

While he was the most inexperienced member of his family, he quickly made a name for himself amongst the ranks of The Watchers. He had a knack for archery, and soon became one of the most staunch defenders of Darkshire.

His personal mission was to keep the roads safe, wary of the ever more hostile creatures coming to the forests.

Silvia Valor, Raven Hill Guard

Silvia Valor had already been a local hero by the time she was offered to join the Guard. If there was one thing she could not stand to suffer more than anything, it was opportunists who took advantage of those who were struggling.

Bandits, con artists, rabble-rousers, it didn't matter. Silvia put each to the sword for trying to sow chaos in her beloved home. It was only natural she would be put in a position of real authority to act out her vision of justice.

It's said that, until she drew her last breath, she would never abandon the farmsteads and homes of Duskwood. And perhaps not even then.

Ira Valor, Forest Stalker

When Ira's father grew ill, she took it upon herself to gather food and supplies from the nearby forests. While resources were not in short supply, you were as likely to find food as you were to become it.

Over the years, she adapted to the forests, preferring to spend her time within the dark woods rather than in Raven Hill. Travelers who got lost in the trees would tell stories of a shadow seemingly opening the way for them back to the road. There was no confirmations of who it was, but rumors spread quickly.

It's said that Ira is still in the woods offering a guiding hand to those who fall prey to the beasts within.

Lord Grant Valor, Sire of the Valor Family

Lord Grant, may he rest in peace, was the pinnacle of Alliance exceptionalism. A natural leader, his guiding hand helped lead the denizens of Raven Hill to prosperity. When darkness began to creep into the woods, he was the first to rally our people.

There was no more foul a foe than the undead to Lord Grant. He personally patrolled the cemeteries of Duskwood to keep the shambling hordes in check. The day he took a grievous blow from the monsters, everyone in town shared his pain.

With his family's care, he returned to his duties, but there was a lingering malady that seemed to follow him for the rest of his days.

Lady Cassandra Valor, Loving mother and wife

Not much is known about Cassandra other than her love for her family. She nurtured brave children and a powerful husband, leading some to muse that the family's greatness was all her doing. A flattery she would always decline with grace.

If she is remembered for nothing else, let it be known that everything she did was for her family.

281139.title: Thunderhorn's Report
pages:
Arch Druid,

$N has done a great service for the land today. The Winterhoof, Thunderhorn, and Wildmane wells have been cleansed of the goblins' poisons thanks to their bravery.

With time, the rejuvenated waters will nourish all who walk upon Mulgore's great plains, and the land will heal. Earth Mother be praised.

If you are willing, I request you provide a reward commensurate with their efforts, on behalf of all in Bloodhoof Village.

With great reverence,

Mull Thunderhorn

281243.title: Hollee's Note
pages:
Tarrel my beloved,

Not a day goes by that I don't lose myself thinking of those bronze braids, that bellowing laugh, or those rippling forearms.

You must come to me in Auberdine on the next ship. We belong together--you know it to be true if you search your heart!

Yours if you'll have me,

Hollee

281347.title: Torn Page
pages: The calm comes before the storm.

282338.title: Hallowed Memorandum
pages:
While you may be a refugee who has come to Ironforge out of desperation, the Light never turns away those in need. Over time your devotion will deepen and you'll learn to feel the warmth of the Light. Our cousins among the gnomes are as welcome among our ranks as any stout dwarf.

I can tell that you have the gift of channeling the Light. This is a special quality and one that you should nurture.

Find me when ya have the time. I'll be in the back of Anvilmar, just up the hill.

- Branstock Khalder, Priest Trainer

282346.title: Tainted Tablet
pages:
Your nascent skills are too rudimentary to realize that this tablet is suffused with powerful curses of suffering to prevent any unwanted eyes from reading it.

Through my power I have felt your first steps toward a tenuous connection with the Twisting Nether, and now I reach out to offer you the boon of mentorship. With my guidance, you will learn to command demons and call down the flames from beyond the mortal coil.

Seek me out in the depths of the Den once you've found your way around. I would speak to you about important matters.

-Nartok, Warlock Trainer

282380.title: Glyphic Parchment
pages:
You see what other orcs cannot see, you feel the pulse of the universe around you. You got the touch of magic, and it be time to learn how to control it.

You find Mai'ah when you be ready. She teach you much about magic and the spells you need to destroy those dat stand against you.

Mai'ah be near the Den in the Valley of Trials. You come, you find her, then you be strong. Then you show other mages how magic bends to your will... not the other way 'round.

282400.title: Archaic Rune
pages:
You already felt the call of something greater than yourself, and that's the call of the elements. We dwarves have a strong connection to earth, but with the right training, you can learn to speak to all of the elements. The elementals can be demanding and challenging, but I'm here to guide you in learning how to communicate with them. Come find me in Anvilmar and I'll teach you how to listen to the elements, and how to get them to listen to you.

- Teo Hammerstorm, Shaman Trainer

282416.title: Glowing Recall Crystal
pages:
<As you touch the glowing crystal a draft of wind stirs around you, carrying the faint hint of spoken words.>

The High Order has been watching you, $N, and we see great promise in your abilities.

The Wind Spirits have left Zephras Isle, and now more than ever, promising mages like yourself are needed. If our people are to find the self-reliance to survive this crisis, we must use our knowledge of the arcane to uncover the secrets of this realm.

Seek me out in Thendal Village, on the ground floor of the great tree. We will begin your training in earnest.

-Dorii Brightwhisper, Mage Trainer

282418.title: Humming Recall Crystal
pages:
<As you touch the glowing crystal a draft of wind stirs around you, carrying the faint hint of spoken words.>

The Windshapers have been watching you closely, and the time has come for you to take your next steps as a shaman.

The wind spirits have vanished from Zephras Isle and the burden falls to us to brave the dangers of the elemental plane and bring them home. There is no more sacred duty, and our survival depends on it.

Seek me out in Thendal Village, near the town center. I will see to it that you are trained.

-Windshaper Boro, Shaman Trainer

282419.title: Crumpled Note
pages:
$N, you've got a good sword arm and I've taken notice.

Things are a fine mess here on Zephras Isle, no doubt about it. We need our fighting shen'dorei in top form if we are to survive what's to come. It's time for you to stop playing at being a proper warrior, and actually become one.

Find me inside the base of the watchtower here in Thendal Village. I'll see to it you are properly trained.

-Blademaster Ren, Warrior Trainer

282420.title: Folded Parchment
pages:
Greetings, $N,

Since the elemental wind spirits vanished, Zephras has been on a deadly precipice. The birds, the beasts, and even the roots beneath our feet call to us for aid.

Seek me out on the ground floor of the great tree here in Thendal Village. I will counsel and train you in the druidic arts.

-Xyton Silverwind, Druid Trainer

282421.title: Scribbled Note
pages:
Greetings, $N,

You've shown great promise as a hunter, and I'd like to ensure that you receive proper guidance and training.

The rangers do a good job of keeping the wilds in check here in Thendal Grove, but beyond our borders... well, the same can't be said.

Come find me near the center of the village as soon as you are able. The wilds are calling.

-Tai'ree Farsight, Hunter Trainer

282422.title: Simple Note
pages:
I'll make this short, $N.

You've got a slyness and grace to you that I respect, and I've been keeping my eye on you.

Slyness and grace aren't always enough to keep you alive though. If you want to learn to be a proper rogue then I can teach you.

Come find me inside the watchtower.

-Akeri Duskblade, Rogue Trainer

282423.title: Consecrated Scroll
pages:
Welcome back, $N.

I understand all too well the shock that one feels when finding themselves in the situation you now find yourself in. The fact that you have made it this far sets you apart from many other newly risen paladins.

You will find that the hardest part about your new life will be in rediscovering what you lost in life...and enduring the pain it causes you.

Speak with me in Deathknell, and I will help you find the resolve to take your first steps.

-Aramis Hammerhand, Paladin Trainer

284844.title: Dragonmaw Dispatch
pages:
Find what the Alliance have dug up. We know what lies in these hills. With this, we will bring a worthy tribute to Rend.

Chieftain Nek'rosh

285356.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions
pages:
Greetings,

As a guest of the Alliance, you have been given leave to travel freely throughout Alliance lands.

This document will serve as a guide to help you reach the other member cities of our alliance.

Your first stop should be Ironforge which can be reached via the technological marvel known as the Deeprun Tram.

You can find the entrance to the tram in the Dwarven District here in Stormwind, just to the southwest of the keep. The tram will transport you safely to the heart of Ironforge City.

Once you arrive, explore the city and locate High Tinker Mekkatorque and King Magni Bronzebeard in Tinker Town and the Great Forge, respectively. Introduce yourself as an agent of the Skyborne and they will show you their hospitality.

The city of Darnassus can be found across the sea, off the coast of northern Kalimdor. The city itself rests at the top of the great tree, Teldrassil.

The safest route for you currently is via the harbor on the west side of Stormwind. Take the ship departing from the southernmost dock to the port of Auberdine.

Upon arriving, proceed to the north side of the Auberdine docks and take the ship there to Ru'theran Village. This village contains a magical transporter that will take you into the city itself.

Explore Darnassus and seek out Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess of Elune.

After you've become acquainted with the other leaders of the alliance, Lord Fordragon has requested that you report back to him here in the keep.

I wish you good fortune in your journeys, Skyborne.

285357.title: Advisor Nazgrel's Instructions
pages:
Elf,

As a guest of the Horde, the Warchief has given you leave to travel freely throughout Horde territory.

Use this guide to find your way around our lands.

Within this very chamber you will find Vol'jin of the Darkspear Tribe.

The Darkspear Trolls are steadfast friends of the orcs, our bond sealed in blood through the heat of battle during our flight from the human lands on the continent to the East.

Treat him with respect, and he will treat you with respect. If you show him disrespect... well, don't do that.

Next, I'd advise you to travel back to Mulgore and seek out Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

Cairne is the chieftain of the Bloodhoof tribe of Tauren, and it is by his grace that your people and the Earthen Ring have been given permission to establish yourselves in Mulgore.

You should already be familiar with the path to Thunder Bluff. Seek out the flight master in the center of Orgrimmar and take a riding wyvern to Thunder Bluff. Cairne can be found in the central plateau, just east of the great totem that serves as the wyvern roost in the city.

Our Forsaken allies make their home in the land known as the Tirisfal Glades on the eastern continent. Deep beneath the ruins of a city once called Lordaeron you will find the Undercity.

To reach Tirisfal, exit the city via the great southern gate, and head east towards the zeppelin tower.

Board the zeppelin that docks at the south side of the tower. After crossing the great sea, you will arrive at the town of Brill. Simply head north from Brill into the ruins of Lordaeron.

Locate the lift and ride it down into the depths of the Undercity and find the Dark Lady in the Royal Quarter.

Word of warning, you may find the forsaken capital to be... unnerving.

286104.title: Longwalker Malah's Report
pages:
Day 1

Venture Co. activity continues to be a concern. Their mining operations have only grown, and I hear a new, grinding sound that suggests some new horrific construct may have been unloaded there.

I do not yet consider them a capable threat to Thunder Bluff, but if provoked they could successfully mount an attack on Bloodhoof Village from the south.

Day 2

I hear a thunderous, stampeding sound echoing off the cliffs to the east, where our home meets the plains of the Barrens. It may be yet another zhevra or gazelle herd, or perhaps an enraged thunder lizard, but it continues deeper into the night than such beasts typically stay active.

I will push forward to investigate further, but will maintain a safe distance.

Day 3

Centaur have invaded Mulgore! Our most vile and ancient enemy has dared re-enter these plains after being driven out. The High Chieftain's fury will rain upon them!

I must know what they plan, so that we may counter it most effectively. If I stay silent I think I can get close enough to overhear them.

It seems they plan to...

<The rest of the text is covered in blood.>

286200.title: Dillinger's Report
pages:
Scourge have continued to slip through both the Bulwark and the eastern waystation, their numbers growing by the day. How such a failure in our defenses is allowed to persist is beyond my reckoning.

As noted in my previous reports, the paltry allotment of guards assigned to Brill is insufficient for what comes for us. It is not a matter of if we will be overrun, but when. And once Brill falls, it shall serve as the perfect staging ground to lay siege to the Undercity.

It is not my recommendation, but my demand that reinforcements be dispatched from their luxurious posts in the Undercity to defuse the situation while we still possess the opportunity.

--Deathguard Dillinger

286201.title: Kristof's Report
pages:
Executor Zygand,

It is my opinion that the Scourge we see further inland are not due to our defenses failing. I have witnessed our forces at the Bulwark and eastern waypoint for some time now, and it would take a veritable army to break through.

Rather, I suspect they are being newly created by some unseen enemy within our borders. I will continue to pull on this thread, in hopes that we may stop these occurrences at the source.

--Kristof

286202.title: Gordo's Report
pages:
<Impressively, there is a barely legible carving in the remaining skin of the apple.>

Apple yum yum. Me pick flowers now.

185403.name: Cyriden Farseeker
185403.title: Archaeologist
lines: The cart! How did this happen? Relathor, come quickly, there's a fire!
And the cart is still salvageable. It will need repairs, but the damage could have been much worse.
Never better, Relathor. Come, let us return inside.

185404.name: Relathor Moonsong
185404.title: Archaeologist
lines: I don't know how it started, but it hardly matters now. We need to extinguish it!
Indeed it could have. Most importantly, you are unharmed, Cyriden?
The last of the embers are gone.

202116.name: Cut-throat Mugger

210845.name: Jixo Madrocket

Whoa there! Slow down before I fa-- Agh!!

216463.title: Mother of Storms
lines: Death's Head cannot be stopped! We'll wash away this land and pave way for the one true master!
You're too late, shaman. The storm grows and there's nothing you can do to stop it!

218571.name: Shade of Eranikus
lines: This evil cannot be allowed to enter this world!  Come my children!

218690.name: Kha'damu

219822.name: Chained Spirit
lines: I am released through you! Avenge me!

220930.name: Frix Xizzix
lines: Thanks again pal! Next time you are in Booty Bay make sure and pay my brother a visit. He might have some junk laying around you'll find valuable. Byeeee!

222703.name: Whisperwing
lines: An impressive display of strength. Hear me now, druid...
Despite the pretense of civilization, you are not apart from this. Embrace what is primal within you, so that you may better attune yourself to the raw power of nature.
The life of a beast is a constant struggle for survival. To live is to rip, claw, bite, and bleed.

222705.name: Blightbark
lines: I see now that you are worthy, druid. Perhaps the earth will be safe in your care...
These wilds have teemed with life for centuries, but they have also known great strife. Now, more than ever, the land is in need of a protector.
This duty falls on you and your kind, druid. Never forget your kinship with all living things.

226982.name: Frijidar
lines: ... LET MY REIGN OF DESTRUCTION RESUME!!

227985.name: Arkonos the Cursed
lines: Oh so the whelp survived? And would you look at that? He's found a new master to follow like the good little dog he is. Fortunately for you, I have no time to waste on distractions like yourselves. Run along now, lest my pets find you. They are ever so hungry, you see!
You dare to disrupt my ritual? I shall grind your bones into dust for your insolence!

227996.name: Sebastian Jurgens
lines: Brace yourselves, this is it! We're making history!
Goggles - on! Electromantic resonance transducer - LOCKED!
Gah! Stuck AGAIN! Brave warrior, lend me your strength and help me open this dented console door?
Huh?! This isn't right, my formulas show -

228622.name: Orthas
lines: Aye, ye done well, $N. Now I can regain me proper form and be about me business again. Ol' Mograine would never've forgiven me if I missed the party at the citadel! Gwahah!

228934.name: Thane Korth'azz
lines: Feels good to be meself again! Alas, I need to be on me way now, but I'll leave a little somethin' for ye by way o' compensation for yer time and effort. Farewell!
Gwahah what's this? These spirits mean to prevent me return? I thinks not. Begone ye dull-wit daffodils!

228935.name: Enraged Spirit
lines: He is here! He rides again! What have you done?
It is he! One of them! One of the Horsemen! NOOOOO!

230317.name: Mokvar

230319.name: Deliana
lines: Come to think about it, most everyone involved is dead.  I'll understand if you don't want to be involved in any of this, $N.

Trying to find out more about my predicament has been nearly impossible.  The smuggler that hired us has vanished and Anthion Harmon, our mercenary company's leader, is dead.
You're never going to stop coming after me, are you?  Fine, but you won't take me down without a fight!

232929.name: Gregory
lines: I suspect that this ritual may attract the nearby demons. Please protect me until it is done.

237818.name: Harrison Jones
lines: A Few weeks back, I caught wind of a rumor that some mage was in search of something in the crypts beneath Karazhan. It's not uncommon for a mage to collect magical artifacts, but I heard rumors that this person wasn't just after any old ordinary enchanted trinket...
He was about to cut me open when one of the greedy fools made the unfortunate mistake of stuffing a handful of gold into his pocket... that was all it took. In that instant the whole tomb "woke up".
I heard screams, but I didn't look back. Let me tell you, kid, I won't forget those screams any time soon.

I knew right then I had to get there before an army of hard-headed adventurers descended upon the place and one of them traded any of the fragments of the staff for a dented helmet and a handful of silver. That kind of artifact belongs in a museum!

I needed a crew though, and I had recently been acquainted with one such group in a recent expedition to Tanaris. They were a real ruthless, hardboiled bunch. Certainly not to be trusted, but my options were limited, so I recruited them.

I needed a crew though, and I had recently been aquatinted with one such group in a recent expedition to Tanaris. They were a real ruthless, hardboiled bunch. Certainly not to be trusted, but my options were limited, so I recruited them.

I tried to warn the crew not to touch anything, but they already had gold in their eyes and their leader responded by putting a knife to my throat. It was always the plan for them to double-cross me and steal the loot, of course. I should have known!

I used the confusion to break away and make a run for it. As I ran, a terrible, oppressive darkness seemed to follow right on my heels. I've never seen anything like it in my entire career. It was truly terrifying.

So that's my story. I'm in no shape to head back there any time soon, but if you plan on going in you'll need a way around that darkness... and backup. Preferably a crew that won't stab you in the back for a bit of gold. Hah!

Somehow I made it out, but in my haste to get as far from the crypt as possible, I ended up right in the middle of a camp full of angry ogres. I think you can fill in the rest of the story from there.

The place was thick with treasure of unimaginable value. No sign of the staff, but there was enough to keep scholars busy for years. However, I've been doing this long enough to know that a hoard like this doesn't just lie there undisturbed like this for long.

The rumors said he was looking to reassemble the legendary Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian. Thought shattered when Dalaran was destroyed, there are those who would see it reformed... for good or for ill.
We made our way to Deadwind and entered the crypt. It was easy going at first and we made it into the main burial chamber without incident. To say we hit the motherlode would be an understatement.

238415.name: Grok'lo Mok'lo
lines: Just as bad as the scourge, filth!
Now you die an honorless death!
You hold evil in your hands, fool! REPENT!
You risk destroying us all, human! You must be terminated!

239036.name: Scarlet Crusader
lines: But why not at least have them act as the vanguard? If they weaken Kel'Thuzad's forces, our fight would be much easier.
How much longer does the High General expect us to tolerate these freaks?
If they die fighting Kel'Thuzad's forces, they become Kel'Thuzad's forces. We win with a single decisive blow, or not at all.
We'll have peace with the Dawn for as long as is required. They're just as powerful an ally as they are an enemy.

242367.name: New Avalon Citizen
lines: My prayers have come true! My gold pouch just became heavier!
Someone just tried to pickpocket me...

243254.name: Leonid Barthalomew
lines: No! You will not harm my family! Percival, Liliana--run!
Percival, what is it? Who is...
Please, Sir Caldoran. This is my wife and son, they do not bear the taint of corruption, if I could just...

243394.name: Percival Barthalomew
lines: No, please sir! This is my father, he is...

246378.name: Danitha Morr
lines: Ah, so we are cutting straight to the point, then?
Enough of this talk. I want to speak of the good times. Garek would have wanted that for us.
I reject that notion. This is who we are now, and we will make the Forsaken see that we are not what they think we are. We can be of service to Lordaeron again.
I'm sorry Leonid but I must decline. Much has changed but the Forsaken are still the people we swore to protect.
I'm sorry, Leonid, but I must decline. Much has changed but the Forsaken are still the people we swore to protect.
Indeed it does, Leonid. I've enjoyed our correspondence, but it pleases me that you finally made the trip out to Bandarion Keep in person.
Indeed it does, Leonid. I've enjoyed our correspondence, but it pleases me that you finally made the trip out to Banderon Keep in person.
No, Leonid. Our place is here. Our fledgling order must find our identity amongst our kind. I know how you feel about the Forsaken... that our 'condition' is something to be cured.
That is why it is so important that we stay.

246389.name: Hilda the Breaker
lines: Good! That's what I'm talking about!
Put your back into it, worms! The light isn't going to swing itself!
Shake off the grave dust, worms!
What are you even swinging at?! You are the sorriest lot of rotten meat I've ever seen!

246848.name: Kirin Tor Guard
lines: Halt! The city is on lockdown until order has been restored.

248755.name: Lumina Windsinger
lines: Thank you again, paladin. I think I can make my way from here back to the sepulcher. Meet me there and we will speak further.
Thank you, paladin. Let's get moving.
We've made it out of the keep. Nearly free now!

251001.name: Deathguard Kristof
lines: I thank you for the motivation.
I will double up my efforts.
There is no escape, even in death.

251343.name: Shen'dralar Citizen
lines: Hey, watch where you are walking!
Imagine if I just waltzed right into your home and started stomping everywhere.
Is someone going to deal with this intruder, or...?
Really? Are you incapable of keeping a respectful distance?
Who do you think you are?

251361.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
lines: You there! Be careful! Your sacred shen'dorei gifts are not to be used for amusement!

251366.name: Aetheen of the Gales
lines: Aonda is a good woman, and a true servant of Zephras Isle. It is my hope that you can quickly earn her trust and help her to keep Shen'dar Village safe. May the winds guide you, $N.

251374.name: Windshaper Boro
lines: Strength and endurance; patience and wisdom--remember these things always, $N.

251451.name: Al'Aketh Ambusher
lines: For the glory of the windlord!
Submit to the will of the windlord and beg his forgiveness!

251523.name: Constable Aonda
lines: If you are looking for more work, I'm sure there are some folks in town that are also looking for help with one task or another. Just ask around, you are bound to find something.

251902.name: Illaya Amberwind
lines: As you likely know, the wind pylons gifted to us by the spirits serve as our anchor to the elemental plane of $Nwall. They are failing, and our home is in danger.
As you likely know, the wind pylons gifted to us by the spirits serve as our anchor to the elemental plane of Skywall. They are failing, and our home is in danger.

The Al'Aketh cult continues to escalate their violence, and the High Order's magical meddling could hasten our doom if left unchecked.

The future is uncertain for our people, but there is hope, and we have a plan...
The shamanistic magic we know is greatly diminished since the spirits vanished, but we are resolute in our mission to bring them home once again.
We will not stop until we are able to discover what went wrong. We will find the strength we need to call the spirits back to us.
When you find yourself in the port of Valanaar, seek out Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can tell you more.

251903.name: Rathiril Sunlance
lines: Come young one, sit with me.
Come, young one, sit with me.
It was a critical mistake that our people left their fates in the hands of fickle elemental spirits. It's up to us now to remedy that error.
The Al'Aketh cult continues to escalate their violence, and the Windshapers stubbornly refuse to recognize the inaction that brought us here.
The High Order are the custodians of the Highborne ways, and we will master the magic holding this island in place and bend it to our will.
The future is uncertain, but there is opportunity in this. We will rediscover the self-reliance that drove us before we came to this place.
The pylons that keep our island home anchored to the elemental plane of Skywall are failing. $Nras Isle--our home--is in grave danger.
The pylons that keep our island home anchored to the elemental plane of Skywall are failing. Zephras Isle--our home--is in grave danger.
When you find yourself in the port of Valanaar, seek out Elaadrin Evengale. He can tell you more of how we plan to do this.

251904.name: Sania Silverstream
lines: Go with the blessings of Al'Akir. But be warned; those that approach the $Ndlord's faithful under false pretense will quickly face His wrath.

251966.name: Commander Cyclas
lines: Only the righteous will be saved from what is to come! Death to non-believers!

251968.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
lines: ...and the Windshapers. We are ready to support an assault on the Shrine, Valennia.
$N, ensure any allies with you are prepared to fight, and speak with me when you are ready to confront Lorthuna.
$Nns, much like myself, but orders of magnitude more powerful. This power and their knowledge of the elemental planes is the key to our survival.
An entire order of visionaries just like the Windshapers called The Earthen Ring. One of their leaders, a shaman named Muln Earthfury, has shown me much.
As you know, our way of life is in grave danger. Since the elementals vanished, our people have been in a state of steady decline.
However, this journey will be dangerous. We need strong, able-bodied young shen'dorei to join us as we explore this massive new world. Those just like you, in fact.
I have seen the way. We must return to Kalimdor, confer with this Earthen Ring. They will help us master the skysight so that we may call our elemental patrons back home.
In my own clumsy searching throughout the planes for signs of our elemental benefactors, I stumbled upon them...
Inquiry? You mean his thinly veiled threat? You go back and tell Elaadrin that if he has something to say, he can come and speak to me himself.
It's 'Grand $Nseer' to you, mage. Now leave. Run along back to your master before I truly lose my patience.
It's 'Grand Skyseer' to you, mage. Now leave. Run along back to your master before I truly lose my patience.
Lorthuna! Stop this madness. You don't know what bringing down the wards protecting Zephras will do. You could doom us all!
Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring--the Windshapers would be happy to accept you as our guest.
No one? I thought not. You go tell Elaadrin that the only thing keeping me from marching my shamans over and tossing you petty charlatans off the side of this island is the current crisis.
Nor is this how I envisioned our first meeting, Muln.
Oh that's rich, little mage. What of the $Ndshapers that your agent killed in the highlands? Who will answer for them?
Oh that's rich, little mage. What of the Windshapers that your agent killed in the highlands? Who will answer for them?

Shamans, much like myself, but orders of magnitude more powerful. This power and their knowledge of the elemental planes is the key to our survival.
The Al'Aketh are a symptom of this. In many ways they are a dark mirror into the hearts of the Windshapers. Many of us believe that we are to blame for the spirits leaving us.
The cradle of our people is now part of an even larger world known as "Azeroth". There are those on Azeroth possessing a skysight so strong that they can pierce the heavens themselves to see beyond.
We understand. As it happens Elaadrin and I spoke. We made arrangements to send for... outside aid. It's unclear if they will be able to arrive in time to help, or if they will even arrive at all...

Whatever the cause, we need to find a solution quickly before we tear ourselves apart. Tell me, what do you know of Kalimdor?
You do not need to agree to this now. When the time comes however, please consider joining us in our expedition. Until we speak again... may the winds guide your path.

252076.name: High Priestess Lorthuna
lines: ...do not delay. Muster our forces to march immediately. The pylons are key and...the wards...come down. This is...
...quickly. With our forces.....will be exposed.....my ritual must not....
Belathaan... I thought we agreed to meet alone? I'd hate to think you intended to ambush me here, in the shadow of my shrine.
I alone am.....this task....the Windlord will.......our voices.....he will come.....we must not fail!
I am needed elsewhere for now and this represents but one piece on the gameboard. Do not fail me, Aanders.
The great work is nearly complete, Skypriest Aanders. Your success here is vital.

252077.name: Skypriest Aanders
lines: High Priestess, we are ready to carry out your will. I will move on the western watchtower, and Commander Cyclas will lead the attack on Shen'dar Village. Both will be ours by tomorrow.
Of course, High Priestess. We are the instruments of your will. I only wish you could be here to witness our triumph firsthand.
The grand design of the High Priestess is in motion! There is nothing you can do to stop it!
You cannot stop Lorthuna's great work! The windlord's will has been done!

252382.name: Sessaria Skystride
lines: The Eternal Flame burns once again. Well done, $N.

252383.name: Valennia Stormfist
lines: ...a recall crystal! Used to record an important moment, no doubt.
...a recall crystal!. Used to record an important moment, no doubt.

Go and speak with the leaders of the $Ndshapers and the High Order, respectively. They don't get along, but I think they can recognize that the bigger threat is the Al'Aketh. Get them to agree to the plan and then return here.

I appreciate you bringing me Ayessa's assurances. With both the High Order and the $Ndshapers working with us against the the greater threat, we stand a much better chance to thwart the Al'Aketh and whatever they have planned for Zephras.

The anchor pylons keep us suspended in this realm, but they also act as wards! The Shal'nan once spoke of this. They keep us shielded from...
The crystal is too damaged to play any further, I am afraid.
The recall crystal is badly damaged, though. The recording is likely to be incomplete so we must listen carefully.

With the cult running roughshod over most of the island with impunity, Lorthuna undoubtedly thinks we are on the back foot. We can use that overconfidence against her.

252448.name: Alvarion Windfield
lines: At this point I'm too injured to leave this bed. I'm begging you, stranger. Travel to my orchard. Tell Aamelia what happened and help her survive this somehow. Please stranger... help us.
At this point I'm too injured to leave this bed. I'm begging you, stranger. Travel to my orchard. Tell Aamelia what happened and help her survive this somehow. Please, stranger... help us.
I came to town to hire fighters to drive them off. I found one warrior who agreed to help, but he robbed me as soon as we were out of town and nearly beat me to death.
My wife and I run the stormapple orchard in the lowlands, just to the west of Valanaar.
Some years ago our farm was attacked by bandits. They took everything we had and left me bruised and bloody. The next season around the same time, they returned.
They took most of our harvest again, but this time the bandit leader--Ferauu "the Bludgeon" as he's known--told us that every season they'd return and take twice as much as the previous year.
This year our yield is light and we can't hope to give them what they expect. The best case is that they simply kill us quickly. It's more likely they take everything we have and leave us to starve.
We tried to petition the peacekeepers to come and help drive the bandits off, but they are stretched too thin just dealing with the cult and couldn't spare anyone.

lines: $N, ensure any allies with you are prepared and speak with me when you are ready to confront Lorthuna.
Ansirem! This isn't how I expected for our first meeting to go, but I'm glad you made it!
Ansirem! This isn't how I expected our first meeting to go, but I'm glad you made it!
For now, spread the word to our people. Be on your guard around Windshapers. We didn't start this fight, but once the cult is dealt with, we will be ready to end it.
I don't know who is more dangerous, the Al'Aketh, or the sky-cursed Windshapers! So be it. If she is not willing to resolve this with civility, we will not hesitate once the current crisis is over.
I think it's time for us to be leaving this place. I will open a portal to Valanaar.
I'll make this easy for you, witch. Stop what you are doing now and I will make your death swift. This is the last and best offer you will get from the High Order.
If you've spoken with Rathiril and he sent you to see me, you are no doubt aware of the peril we find ourselves in.
It's... coming from a little further away than that. We'll explain on the way.
One that does not rely upon divine intervention from external forces. We seek to master our own destiny for the first time since we've arrived in Skywall.
Recently we discovered a way to use our magic to carve a "keyhole" of sorts to peer through the planes to learn much of Azeroth.
She dares make threats against us after her lackeys massacre our people in the highlands?
Since we left our homes in Kalimdor the world has grown. They call it "Azeroth" now and its a massive, vibrant world.
Since we left our homes in Kalimdor, the world has grown. They call it "Azeroth" now and it's a massive, vibrant world.
Some among us must leave this plane of existence. We must travel to Azeroth to rediscover what we've lost, and bring that knowledge back as a tool to save our home.
The High Order seeks to find a pragmatic and enlightened solution to our current crisis.
The Kirin $Nr have graciously agreed to receive us as their guests, and we will need their help if we are to succeed.
The Kirin Tor have graciously agreed to receive us as their guests, and we will need their help if we are to succeed.
The elementals who brought us here are gone. Any feats they used to maintain our homes can be replicated with Highborne magic, but our powers have grown weak in Skywall.
We came as soon as we were told what was happening. The High Order is here to serve $Nras.

We were hoping for more reinforcements, but this will have to do. Let's push forward!
We will need explorers and adventurers of all kinds. Think on this, and when the time comes, I hope you will consider joining us. Until then, good fortune to you.

Empty threats, Elaadrin. Regardless of what happens to me now, my great work is done. Consider yourself lucky to be here at the eye of the storm, to witness the fruits of our labor.
Enough. Goodbye, Belathaan and... whomever you are.
No! Never, I would never dare!
Yes! Yes! It is by my will that the way to Zephras is open to you! Bring me before your Windlord so that he may know who was the herald of his glory!

2.title: Sharptalon's Claw
2.details: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory.  Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
2.objectives: Bring Sharptalon's Claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
2.request: Yes, mighty $C, I sensed your arrival.  I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
2.reward: Most impressive, $N... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get!  The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!$B$BSharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post.  No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!

5.title: Jitters' Growling Gut
5.details: I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.$B$BBring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.$B$BI heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
5.reward: You need some Crab Cakes, do you?  Well I might be able to cook some up for you...

6.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot
6.details: Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!$B$BBut be wary, $N.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
6.objectives: Kill Garrick Padfoot and bring his head to Deputy Willem at Northshire Abbey.
6.request: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6.reward: Hah - you caught him!  You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!

7.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup
7.details: Your first task is one of cleansing, $N.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
7.objectives: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
7.request: How goes the hunting, $N?  Have you found and defeated those vermin?
7.reward: Well done, citizen.  Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us.  And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.$B$BFor defeating them, you have my gratitude.

8.title: A Rogue's Deal
8.details: Hey, mate! Do a favor for a young man who's been fighting more than his fair share of mindless zombies and spiders?$B$BI got this here letter that needs to go to Brill... to an innkeeper named Renee something-or-other. Don't really matter none what her last name is.$B$BAnyway, it's a nice cozy little place full of victims of the plague trying to make their way in the world. And it be a great spot for you to rest too if the need arises. You should check it out... you do and I'll pay you well.
8.objectives: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.
8.request: Yes? Yes? What is it?$B$BThe forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
8.reward: Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.$B$BWhat? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?$B$BWell, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. Go on! Get lost!$B$BCome back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.$B$BNext thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.

9.title: The Killing Fields
9.details: Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.$B$BIf you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
9.objectives: Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.
9.request: Ah, I see you're back!  I hope you've been hard at work clearing those fields of those Harvest Watchers.  Have you killed twenty yet?
9.reward: Good work, friend.  You have earned your pay well.  Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.

10.title: The Scrimshank Redemption
10.details: Oh, this is just terrible!  I sent out my top assistant, Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, into the desert southeast of here.  That's an area we call the Gaping Chasm.  Well, he's gone missing, and his last report had more of those weird bugs where he was.  Could it be that they've infested two major regions of the desert now?$B$BI need you to head into the Gaping Chasm and look for Scrimshank, please!  That... or at least find his surveying equipment.  I fear that may be all that is left of the poor sod.
10.objectives: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
10.request: Well, what news do you have?  You look like you've been in quite the fight... is Scrimshank alive?
10.reward: He was a good goblin, young Scrimshank.  Let's hope that his demise was not in vain by what he was able to record with his surveying equipment.$B$BIt seems as though we have quite the situation on our hands here with these bugs.  They're way too cunning for their own good, and the research we've done so far is shaping up to indicate that they might even be under the controlling influence of a third party!  If this is the case, then it bodes ill for not only Gadgetzan, but the whole desert!

11.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty
11.details: Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest.  A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder.  Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.$B$BThe Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them.  Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
11.objectives: Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.
11.request: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11.reward: I see you've been busy!  You have our thanks, $N.

12.title: The People's Militia
12.details: The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood.$B$BOne of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
12.objectives: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
12.request: Perhaps I did not make myself clear, pledge.  In order to prove your worth as a servant to The People's Militia and to the Light you need to slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me when the deed is done.
12.reward: Well done, $N.  My scout witnessed your valiant acts.  You are proving yourself quite well so far.

13.title: The People's Militia
13.details: A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead.  The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior.  Dispatch immediately, $N, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.$B$BThe Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower.  As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
13.objectives: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters and return to him on Sentinel Hill.
13.request: We have not time to talk, $N.  The Defias Pillagers are denying the people of Westfall the peace and prosperity they deserve.  Make sure at least 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters have been killed.  That will send a clear message that corruption is not welcome here.
13.reward: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.

14.title: The People's Militia
14.details: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
14.objectives: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
14.request: $N, now is no time for idle chatter.  If you still wish to prove yourself to The People's Militia you need to slay the Defias I notified you about earlier.  Return to me when you have completed your duty.
14.reward: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland.  But there is hope for Westfall yet.  As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor.  It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia.  May the Light shine upon you.

15.title: Investigate Echo Ridge
15.details: $N, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.$B$BGo to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
15.objectives: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.
15.request: Have you been to the mines?  Are you ready to report?
15.reward: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine.  No good can come of this.  Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again.  I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...

16.title: Give Gerard a Drink
16.details: Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.$B$BIf you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
16.reward: Thanks, $N!  And come back if you want to trade again.

17.title: Uldaman Reagent Run
17.details: I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps.  They grow in clusters, deep in the Uldaman dig site; they may be elsewhere, but for now that's the only place I know they're at.  I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.$B$BFind the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps.  Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.$B$BDo this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of one of my famous restorative elixirs for you!
17.objectives: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.
17.request: Have you obtained the magenta fungus caps I need for my alchemical work?  No caps - no reward!
17.reward: Well done $N, you've proven your worth once again!  The caps will be an interesting study, yon verily!$B$BAnd now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...$B$BIf you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct.  Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!

18.title: Brotherhood of Thieves
18.details: Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.$B$BI don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
18.objectives: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.
18.request: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18.reward: Back with some bandanas, I see.  The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.

19.title: Tharil'zun
19.details: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep.  The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc.  Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
19.objectives: Bring Tharil'zun's Head to Marshal Marris in Redridge.
19.request: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19.reward: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc.  Well done--I'm sure he didn't go down easy.  Here is your reward, $N.

20.title: Blackrock Menace
20.details: The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north.  From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.$B$BHelp rid Lakeshire of this menace.  Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof.$B$BAnd although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge.  If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
20.objectives: Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
20.request: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20.reward: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.

21.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge
21.details: Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging.  Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.$B$BWaste no time, $N.  The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.
21.objectives: Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.
21.request: I know it's bloody work, $N, but it's vital to the safety of Northshire.  Are you ready to report?
21.reward: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army.  There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them.  We have further tasks for you.

22.title: Goretusk Liver Pie
22.details: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22.objectives: Salma Saldean needs 8 Goretusk livers to make a Goretusk Liver Pie.
22.request: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22.reward: These are just perfect, $N!  Thank you so much.  Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight.  And here is a little something for you, for the hard work.  You didn't think I was going to let a $C like you go hungry, did you?

23.title: Ursangous's Paw
23.details: Ashenvale Hunt.  On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery.$B$BThe paw should be brought to Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.>
23.objectives: Bring Ursangous's Paw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
23.request: Ah - $N - I was just thinking about you!  How goes your hunting?
23.reward: Ah, the paw of Ursangous!  Your skill is impressive, $C; he is credited with numerous kills.  The crescent on his paw is no doubt a sign that he was trained by the night elves that skulk about Ashenvale.  Ursangous is... was one of the mightiest bears you'd find in these parts.  To have bested such a creature is a testament to your will and resolve.$B$BYour ancestors would be proud!

24.title: Shadumbra's Head
24.details: The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it.  The head of the slain nightsaber is a fitting trophy for this fight of the Ashenvale Hunt.  Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post will want to see such a trophy to award you credit for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.
24.objectives: Bring Shadumbra's Head to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
24.request: Greetings once again, $N!  Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
24.reward: A victory for $N in the Ashenvale Hunt!  Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.$B$BShadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here.  Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger.  Thanks to you, this danger has abated.

25.title: Stonetalon Standstill
25.details: If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?$B$BThe transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path.  What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.$B$BYou up for being useful?
25.objectives: Dispatch 12 Befouled Water Elementals at Mystral Lake, due east of the Talondeep Path and southwest of Splintertree Post.$B$BScout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the nearby Alliance outpost.$B$BReturn to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
25.request: You back already?  What's the situation out there - all cleared up now, thanks to you?
25.reward: Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens.  From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends.  Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...$B$BLooks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it.  Take this - you've earned it.

26.title: A Lesson to Learn
26.details: $N, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.$B$BThe time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.
26.objectives: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
26.reward: Salutations, young $C; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form.  It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water.  You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.$B$BYou will face two trials to overcome.  The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure.  The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.$B$BStand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.

27.title: A Lesson to Learn
27.details: $N, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.$B$BThe time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.
27.objectives: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
27.reward: Salutations, young $C; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form.  It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water.  You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.$B$BYou will face two trials to overcome.  The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure.  The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.$B$BStand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.

28.title: Trial of the Lake
28.details: For your first trial, search the depths of Lake Elune'ara to locate a Shrine Bauble.  It decays rapidly, so proceed with it to the Shrine of Remulos post haste.  Use the bauble at the shrine, and then speak with Tajarri there; she is one of Moonglade's most trusted wardens.$B$BYou only have a set amount of time to complete the task, and you may be competing against other druids searching for baubles themselves.  Mental and physical dexterity will be critical to your success.$B$BGood luck, $N.
