9310.title: Faint Necrotic Crystal
9310.details: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal that is faintly radiating necrotic energy.
9310.objectives: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
9310.request: Can I help you with something?
9310.reward: You say this was taken from a wight attacking the city?$B$BWe have received word about the necropolis base camps that are being summoned by the Scourge. I suspect they were trying to create one in the Undercity. We will have to be vigilant in the future.

9317.title: Consecrated Sharpening Stones
9317.details: If you bring me eight necrotic runes from the Scourge invaders, I can give you a consecrated sharpening stone. It should be of great help in your battle against the minions of the Lich King.
9317.reward: Thank you, $N. Here are your consecrated sharpening stones. Use them prudently.

9318.title: Blessed Wizard Oil
9318.details: In exchange for the necrotic runes of the Scourge invaders, the Argent Dawn will give you one vial of blessed wizard oil.
9318.reward: I hope that you will find these items useful in future battles.

9319.title: A Light in Dark Places
9319.details: We are not the only ones who celebrate this holiday, $N. All creatures, all cultures, are touched by the flame. Even in the darkest places, the fires are being lit.$B$BIf you wish to see them for yourself, travel into the depths. Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, among the ogres of Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I will await your return.
9319.objectives: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
9319.reward: Your essence sings with the energy of the flames you found, $N. The fire you encountered is potent, and with the right knowledge, its power can be harnessed...$B$BAh! Here we are. May this light your path, no matter where you tread.

9320.title: Major Mana Potion
9320.details: In addition to our other supplies, we also have a number of major mana potions you may find useful. I will give you one in exchange for fifteen necrotic runes.
9320.reward: Here you are, $N. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.

9321.title: Major Healing Potion
9321.details: In addition to our other supplies, we also have a number of major healing potions you may find useful. I will give you one in exchange for fifteen necrotic runes.
9321.reward: Here you are, $N. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.

9322.title: Wild Fires in Kalimdor
9322.details: The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.$B$BMidsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeastern Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
9322.objectives: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
9322.reward: Your spirit glows with the warmth of the Kalimdor fires, friend. Is the heat not invigorating?$B$B Once the power fades from you, perhaps these will help rekindle the feeling.

9323.title: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms
9323.details: Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, $C. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.$B$BYou'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.$B$B Return once your journey is done.
9323.objectives: Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9323.reward: Ah, here you are. A little wearier, a bit dustier, but enlightened! The heat touches us all during this season and unites us; your very being glows with the power of the fires you touched.$B$BAh, but these days enlightenment is taken as a rather poor reward for being sent on a task, I suppose. Take these, then, and enjoy the celebration.

9324.title: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame
9324.details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Orgrimmar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9324.objectives: Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
9324.request: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
9324.reward: What's this? Unless I'm mistaken, this flame has been taken from the heart of Orgrimmar itself! The fierce hearts of the orcs and trolls are reflected in its searing heat. What a fine addition to our collection--how brave you are, stealing into the enemy's lair to retrieve the sacred flame!$B$BI wonder what power lurks in the other cities...

9325.title: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame
9325.details: This flame, stolen from the shaman of Thunder Bluff, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9325.objectives: Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
9325.request: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
9325.reward: Unless I miss my guess, this fire has been taken from the cliffs of Thunder Bluff! How it sings with the power of the spirits! You are quite the thief, $N. Take this as just payment for your skill. Now, if only we had the flames of all three cities...

9326.title: Stealing the Undercity's Flame
9326.details: This flame, stolen from the ruins above the Undercity, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9326.objectives: Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
9326.request: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
9326.reward: Hm... what a strange fire! It is subdued, nearly smoldering, but the heat is intense. And you received this from the Undercity, you say? Fascinating. With the flames of all three cities, who knows what we could accomplish?

9330.title: Stealing Stormwind's Flame
9330.details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
9330.objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
9330.request: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
9330.reward: And this brightly-burning fire... you say it came from Stormwind? Remarkable! That must have been quite an adventure! I'll pay you for this, of course. If you find anything else like this, be sure to speak with me again.

9331.title: Stealing Ironforge's Flame
9331.details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Ironforge itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
9331.objectives: Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.
9331.request: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
9331.reward: This hearty flame must be from the halls of Ironforge; it's as stalwart as the dwarves themselves. A fine catch, $N. If I had the fires of the other cities... ah, but never mind. Here is your payment.

9332.title: Stealing Darnassus's Flame
9332.details: This flame, stolen from the shores of Teldrassil, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
9332.objectives: Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
9332.request: You're practically glowing, $R. What do you have there?
9332.reward: This fire aches of ancient sorrow, $N. You pulled this from the roots of Teldrassil, you say? Fascinating! Here is a reward for your skill. Return to me should you find anything else like this; I may have a use for it.

9333.title: Argent Dawn Gloves
9333.details: If you bring me thirty necrotic runes, I will give you your choice of hand protection in return. These should prove valuable in our fight against the undead Scourge.
9333.reward: You've done well, $N. Take your pick of hand protection in thanks for your efforts.

9334.title: Blessed Wizard Oil
9334.details: In exchange for the necrotic runes of the Scourge invaders, the Argent Dawn will give you one vial of blessed wizard oil.
9334.reward: I hope that you will find these items useful in future battles.

9335.title: Consecrated Sharpening Stones
9335.details: If you bring me eight necrotic runes from the Scourge invaders, I can give you a consecrated sharpening stone. It should be of great help in your battle against the minions of the Lich King.
9335.reward: Thank you, $N. Here are your consecrated sharpening stones. Use them prudently.

9336.title: Major Healing Potion
9336.details: In addition to our other supplies, we also have a number of major healing potions you may find useful. I will give you one in exchange for fifteen necrotic runes.
9336.reward: Here you are, $N. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.

9337.title: Major Mana Potion
9337.details: In addition to our other supplies, we also have a number of major mana potions you may find useful. I will give you one in exchange for fifteen necrotic runes.
9337.reward: Here you are, $N. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.

9338.title: Allegiance to Cenarion Circle
9338.details: Even if you have no need for the material rewards we offer, these badges still mark our mutual trust and friendship.$B$BBring them to me.  I'll make due note of your service should your performance go above and beyond the call of duty.
9338.reward: You honor us, $N.  With your continued efforts we will overcome all obstacles.

9339.title: A Thief's Reward
9339.details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the (NAME) might know more...
9339.objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to (NAME).
9339.reward: You've proven yourself today, $N.$B$BWhile I have little else to give you, I do have this crown; a fitting gift for a conqueror. May it light your way.

9341.title: Tabard of the Argent Dawn
9341.details: You have aided our cause greatly, $N. If you wish, I can make available the tabard of the Argent Dawn. We are proud to have you among our allies.
9341.reward: Take this tabard and wear it proudly. Perhaps your deeds might inspire others to take up arms in support of our fight against the Scourge.

9343.title: Tabard of the Argent Dawn
9343.details: You have aided our cause greatly, $N. If you wish, I can make available the tabard of the Argent Dawn. We are proud to have you among our allies.
9343.reward: Take this tabard and wear it proudly. Perhaps your deeds might inspire others to take up arms in support of our fight against the Scourge.

9362.title: Warlord Krellian
9362.details: There isn't much time, $N!  My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic.  I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.$B$BThe pathetic little cretin is known as Warlord Krellian, hiding behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor.  Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell he covets so dearly.
9362.objectives: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
9362.request: There is not time to waste!  Have you the shell?
9362.reward: I must say, this shell has a strange aura.  It seems only fitting that part of your reward for retrieving it would be to test its magical capabilities...

9364.title: Fragmented Magic
9364.details: My research has revealed a unique purpose for the prismatic shell.$B$BCarry the shell and cast your polymorph spell on the Spitelash in Azshara.  If you wait a few moments, the chaotic aura of the shell will cause them to split into several smaller clones for a few moments.  Kill these clones as quickly as possible, and the shell will collect their essence.$B$BWhen the shell is full, return it to me.
9364.objectives: Polymorph the Spitelash of Azshara and kill the clones that appear several seconds later.  When you have slain 50 Polymorph Clones, return to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
9364.reward: Splendid!  Splendid!$B$BNow we are able to reform this magic into a new spell.  Behold!

9365.title: A Thief's Reward
9365.details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the (NAME) might know more...
9365.objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to (NAME).
9365.reward: You've proven yourself today, $N.$B$BWhile I have little else to give you, I do have this crown; a fitting gift for a conqueror. May it light your way.

9367.title: The Festival of Fire
9367.details: Midsummer is upon us once again!$B$BEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$B$BIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
9367.objectives: Touch the bonfires within Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, then speak to a Festival Loremaster within the capital cities.
9367.reward: Excellent! It seems we've appointed dutiful Flamekeepers this year if the bonfires are as well-kept as you claim. Thank you for inspecting them for me; here, take this as a small token of my esteem.

9368.title: The Festival of Fire
9368.details: Midsummer is upon us once again!$B$BEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$B$BIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
9368.objectives: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
9368.reward: Excellent! It seems we've appointed dutiful Flamekeepers this year if the bonfires are as well-kept as you claim. Thank you for inspecting them for me; here, take this as a small token of my esteem.

9386.title: A Light in Dark Places
9386.details: An eager one, aren't you? If you're willing to enter the depths once more, I'll gladly reward you.$B$BSeek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I look forward to your return, $N.
9386.objectives: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.

9388.title: Flickering Flames in Kalimdor
9388.details: There are many flames burning throughout the world today, $N. The trickiest fires to tend are those that burn green; they do not stay lit long without supervision. Make certain the emerald fires still burn on Kalimdor for our Flamekeeper, eh?$B$BYou will find them near Ratchet in the Barrens, close to the Master's Glaive in Darkshore, in the forest of Ashenvale by the bridge near Silverwing Outpost, and near the road to Windshear Crag along the main road in Stonetalon Mountains.
9388.objectives: Visit the bonfires within Ashenvale, the Barrens, Darkshore, and Stonetalon Mountains, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9388.request: The fires cannot die until the festival is done!
9388.reward: Ahhh, so they do still burn. I am glad; it would not do for those fires to burn out before their time. You have done well, $N. Take this with my blessing.

9389.title: Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms
9389.details: The Midsummer Fire Festival traditionally lights up the land with a myriad of flames. Some argue that the green fires are the finest, as they are the hardest to maintain and have such a distinctive hue.$B$BMake sure they still burn in the Eastern Kingdoms for our Flamekeeper. They sit near Dun Modr in the Wetlands, close to Pyrewood Village within Silverpine Forest, on the cliffs overlooking the lighthouse in Westfall, and by the ruined tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
9389.objectives: Visit the bonfires within Hillsbrad Foothills, Silverpine Forest, Westfall, and the Wetlands, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9389.request: Have you seen to your task?
9389.reward: So you've returned, and you've seen to the emerald flames of the continent. What do you think, mm? A rare and wonderful sight, to be certain. I am aware, however, that tangible rewards are better appreciated... so please, take this for your trouble.

9415.title: Report to Marshal Bluewall
9415.details: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.$B$BWhat are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them?$B$BNow, get going and don't dry out on the way.
9415.objectives: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
9415.reward: The Alliance needs every able body they can get. The Horde has been receiving a steady supply of reinforcements from the northern part of the continent, and it's been a struggle to keep up.$B$BLet me explain the situation to you.

9416.title: Report to General Kirika
9416.details: You must be one of General Kirika's new recruits. It's about time you showed up. Bodies wear down quick in the desert.$B$BThe dwarves have been getting reinforcements daily, and we can't afford to lose ground in our struggle for resources in Silithus.$B$BGet your instructions from the General. It's not my job to train you, just find you.
9416.objectives: Speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
9416.reward: It's good that you're hear, but there's no time to waste making small talk. You need instructions, and then you need to get out there.$B$BListen up.

9419.title: Scouring the Desert
9419.details: We recently found out that the Horde has been scavenging the Silithus desert for resources, but paid them little mind. We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.$B$BHowever, it was discovered the importance of the resources, and now we are scrambling to catch up.$B$BIf I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.
9419.objectives: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
9419.request: Be careful out there, but also be quick. We have no time to lose.
9419.reward: Thank the Light you were successful.$B$BNow if we could only have started this sooner, our need would not be so desperate. We must keep the bounty of the desert from falling into the hands of the Horde.

9422.title: Scouring the Desert
9422.details: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the Silithus desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.$B$BBut now the Alliance seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.$B$BI need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.
9422.objectives: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
9422.request: Be wary of the dangers of the desert, $N. With the Alliance lurking in the dunes, any step could be your last.
9422.reward: You've done well, $N. These resources will be added to our stockpiles, and every bit is to our gain and our enemy's loss.

9664.title: Establishing New Outposts
9664.details: Welcome to the Plaguelands, $N. As you know, the Forsaken and their allies hold the lands to the west of here against our best efforts. The Alliance commanders have decided that here in the east, we will establish new fortifications to tighten the noose around our enemies.$B$BTowers long abandoned since the days of Lordaeron are to be seized and rebuilt for this purpose. These lands are dangerous, and we could use your help.
9664.objectives: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's Hope Chapel.
9664.reward: Very good, $N. It will be important for us to hold these towers against future attacks, and for that we may need your assistance until reinforcements can be brought in to secure the area.

9665.title: Bolstering Our Defenses
9665.details: Agents of the Forsaken uncovered an Alliance plot to establish new bases here in the Eastern Plaguelands, at abandoned towers throughout the area.$B$BIt is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this Alliance incursion. Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
9665.objectives: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.
9665.reward: This is good news, $N. It will be a constant struggle here in the Plaguelands until we have fully driven back the forces of the Alliance.$B$BUntil that day, I hope that we will have your continued assistance.

65593.title: Hearts of the Lovers
65593.details: An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure.$B$BMy scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally.$B$BIn Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet.$B$BThey toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.
65593.objectives: Bring the hearts of Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
65593.request: Ah, $N, you return. Were you able to procure the lovers' hearts?

65597.title: The Binding
65597.details: The time has come at last. Bring the hearts to the summoning circle below. Place them at its center and call forth the incubus.$B$BThe demon will not be pleased when it realizes that you have tempted it into a trap. Do not fall prey to its beguilement, $N. You must subdue it fully.$B$BOnly then can I teach you the spell to bind it to your will.
65597.objectives: Using the Lovers' Hearts, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Lovers' Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
65597.request: The incubus possesses martial prowess, but its illusory charms are its most potent weapon. Falter for even a moment, and the demon will seize upon the opportunity to enthrall you.$B$BDo not let it, $N.
65597.reward: Impressive. Very impressive. The sayaad specialize in preying upon mortals. Many a $C has thought themselves strong enough to command one, only to find themselves being commanded instead.$B$BThis trial did not break you, $N, and your efforts have earned your reward. I will teach you the spell to summon the incubus.

65601.title: Love Hurts
65601.details: A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.$B$BThe demon must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion.$B$BIf you trust a blind man to lead you, $N, then listen. East from the Cleft of Shadow, along the main drag of Orgrimmar, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge.$B$BSeek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.
65601.reward: Who told you about Krilge? Have you come with any news? You better not be toying with me...

65602.title: What Is Love?
65602.details: You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.$B$BWith my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.$B$BThousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.$B$BFollow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
65602.objectives: Retrieve the Wooden Figurine and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
65602.reward: <Gakin turns the wooden figurine over in his hand.>$B$BI sense the emotional energy residing within this artifact, undiminished by the passing of time. The incubus will be drawn to it like a fly to honey.$B$BTakar never disappoints.

65603.title: The Binding
65603.details: The time has come. Take the figurine and descend into the crypts below. A summoning circle has been prepared, and you must place the figurine at its center.$B$BThen the gateway will open, and the incubus will cross into our world.$B$BA sayaad is not to be underestimated. The demon will not hesitate to attack when it realizes your ruse. You must draw upon all you have been taught to defeat it.$B$BIf you succeed, return to me and I shall bind the creature to your will. Fail, and your soul is forfeit.
65603.objectives: Using the Wooden Figurine, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Wooden Figurine to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
65603.request: The incubus will try to lower your guard through beguilement and deception. The demon is adept at swaying the hearts of mortals.$B$BRemember that anything it may offer you is false. To the demon, you are merely prey.
65603.reward: Not bad, $N. Your have bested the fiend, and your will remains unbroken.$B$BMany a $C has believed themselves strong enough to bind a sayaad, only to become the demon's next meal instead. I am pleased to see you are not so foolish.$B$BWatch closely, and I will teach you the invocation to call upon your newly bound incubus.

65604.title: The Binding
65604.details: Yes... I see. I feel the residual emotions bound within these threads. Love is woven into its stitches. The incubus will not be able to resist.$B$BTake this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, $N. Summon forth a malevolent incubus, then show it your mastery. Do not expect it to be subdued quietly. Ready your magic and prepare yourself for a fight. Underestimating a demon has been many a warlock's final mistake.$B$BWhen you have defeated it, return the cloth to me. I will let Magar know what you found.
65604.objectives: Using the Withered Scarf, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Withered Scarf to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
65604.request: The sayaad are dominators of minds and torturers of souls. Their visage brings the heart joy, leaving you defenseless when they rend your flesh with whip and claw.$B$BDo not entertain the incubus' charms, $N. Slay it quickly and let it be done.
65604.reward: Hah! Victorious, as expected!$B$BThe incubus is subdued, and it will be my pleasure to teach you to summon the demon. You strength is growing, and I have no doubt that this is a mere stepping stone to even greater powers.$B$BI will return the scarf to Magar. I have known that orc for many years, and never did I think he would care for someone the way he cared for Krilge.$B$BIt is a reminder of what separates us from the demons. We wield their darkness, but they will never wield us.

65610.title: Wish You Were Here
65610.details: I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...$B$BThey've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.$B$BWe would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.$B$BI'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
65610.objectives: Investigate Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale and report your findings to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
65610.reward: What is it you have there, $N? A scarf made of... Mooncloth? You best not be seeking to romance me.

76156.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
76156.details: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, $C. Use this mask to infiltrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.
76156.objectives: Sneak into the Venture Company mine southeast of Thunder Bluff and collect 5 Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies, then return them to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
76156.request: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, $C.  I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
76156.reward: Hmm... perhaps disguises are not your strength.

76160.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
76160.details: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
76160.objectives: Gather 8 Windfury Cones north of Thunder Bluff, use them with the Mortar and Pestle, then return to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff with the result.$B$BProvided item:
76160.request: Be careful with the salve once you are finished, $C.  Even skin contact could be quite painful.
76160.reward: $C, this is not the venomous salve I asked for.  What you have brought me is pine nut butter.  Are you sure you followed my instructions?$B$BThis will be of far more use spread on some spice bread than on a dagger.  Although you would be quite formidable against a foe with a nut allergy.

76240.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
76240.details: I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.$B$BGo and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
76240.objectives: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.$B$BProvided item:
76240.request: Do you have something for me?
76240.reward: That was quite a display, $C.  Not the rogueish precision I hoped for, but you possess an impressive ambidexterity.$B$BI see now that you will not be the one to train my people in the subtle arts, but there is one thing I can teach you.  Good luck on your travels, $C.  The Horde will need heroes like you.

78088.title: A Strange Artifact
78088.objectives: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
78088.request: Did you find something in the tower?
78088.reward: You were right to bring this to me, $N.

78089.title: Advice From Stormwind
78089.details: There's a powerful darkness about this orb. Its nature is clearly demonic, but past that it is beyond my ability to discern its purpose.$B$BTake the orb to the one known as Katherine the Pure in the Stormwind Cathedral. Consult with her for advice on the orb.
78089.objectives: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Katherine the Pure in Stormwind.
78089.reward: <Examines the orb with a worried expression>

78090.title: A Second Opinion
78090.details: I'm not sure what to make of this orb, $N. I think we will need the help of... a specialist.$B$BWe are aware of a warlock sect operating out of Stormwind. Officially we reject the presence of warlocks in the city. Unofficially, their knowledge can be of use when dealing with demonic forces.$B$BFind a representative of these warlocks, and seek their opinion on the orb.
78090.objectives: Find the warlock sanctum within Stormwind and seek advice on the orb.
78090.request: You're a long way from the cathedral, $C. I hope you realize you have no authority here.
78090.reward: So the Silver Hand requires my aid? It will not come cheaply.

78091.title: Earning Your Salt
78091.details: I will study the orb and tell you what I learn, but you must first do something for me.$B$BThe warlocks of the Blackrock clan use specially prepared salts to enhance their summoning rituals. Collect some from the orcs in Redridge.$B$BWhen you return, I will share with you the results of my studies.
78091.objectives: Collect 14 Summoner's Salt from Blackrock Summoners in Redridge Mountains, then return to Ursula Deline in Stormwind.
78091.request: <The warlock is studying the orb intently>
78091.reward: Ah... the salts. I had forgotten all about them.$B$BThis orb is unlike anything I have seen, $N.

78092.title: It Must Be Destroyed
78092.details: The tendrils of sentience reaching out from this orb are too much for even an experienced warlock like myself to withstand for long. I am reluctant to admit this, $N, but the orb must be destroyed.$B$BThe orb is nearly impervious, but it may be vulnerable to the weapon of a powerful demon lord. I have heard that such a blade is present in Ashenvale--at the site where the pit lord Mannoroth was destroyed.$B$BGather motes of the fallen demon's essence there, then shatter the orb upon the blade.
78092.objectives: Gather 12 Motes of Mannoroth from demons in Ashenvale. Bring them along with the Orb of Althalaxx to the Spear of Mannoroth at Demon Fall Canyon.
78092.request: <Your hair stands on end as infernal energies surround you>
78092.reward: <You raise the orb towards the spear>

78093.title: Return to Delgren
78093.details: <The shattered remains of the orb lay at your feet. Delgren will want to see you have succeeded.>
78093.objectives: Return the Orb Shards to Delgren.
78093.request: Did you find a way to destroy the orb?
78093.reward: This is a relief, $N. But whatever was watching Azeroth through that orb... I have a feeling they will not be happy it was destroyed.$B$BTake this as my thanks for your efforts. And... be careful.

78124.title: Nar'thalas Almanac
78124.details: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78124.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

78127.title: The Dalaran Digest
78127.details: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78127.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

78132.title: Dragonslayer's Helm
78132.details: The helm of the Dragonslayer once belonged to a great commander who fell in battle. It is said his tormented soul still haunts the site of his passing.
78132.reward: Splendid job, $N! With this, I am one step further on my path to glory.

78133.title: Dragonslayer's Shield
78133.details: The shield of the Dragonslayer is rumored to be held by an Orcish warlord. He stole it while raiding a human settlement.
78133.reward: Splendid job, $N! With this, I am one step further on my path to glory.

78134.title: Dragonslayer's Lance
78134.details: The lance of the Dragonslayer has changed hands many times. Every now and then, rumor spreads of it appearing in black market arms deals. Perhaps the lance's current unsavory proprietor would be willing to part with it; for a price.
78134.reward: Splendid job, $N! With this, I am one step further on my path to glory.

78142.title: Bewitchments and Glamours
78142.details: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78142.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

78143.details: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78143.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

78145.details: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78145.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

78146.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

78149.details: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78149.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

78150.title: Friend of the Library
78150.details: Thanks to your donations, the library is thriving.$B$BPlease, take this.

78261.title: The Horn of Xelthos
78261.details: Hello, $N.$B$BI desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.$B$BVenturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.$B$BYou must go alone.$B$BI have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you.$B$BReturn the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.$B$B- C
78261.objectives: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
78261.reward: <You place The Horn of Xelthos into the chest>

78270.title: Goblin Lockpicks
78270.details: Hello again, $N.$B$BI desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.$B$BVenturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.$B$BYou must go alone.$B$BI have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you.$B$BReturn the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.$B$B- C
78270.objectives: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village.
78270.request: You said you're breaking into Shadowfang...alone? You've got some guts!$B$BI can hook you up with explosives to get past the gate, but I'll need a work order to make it look legit on the books. An employee around here's likely carrying one. Probably someone who does a lot of tinkering or building.
78270.reward: Nice job, $N. I figure that was a cakewalk for someone in your line of work.$B$BAs promised, here's the goods.

78307.title: The Horn of Xelthos
78307.reward: <A note sits in the chest>$B$BFor $N. I'll be seeing you.$B$B- C

78676.title: The Eye of Bhossca
78676.details: Glad to have you back, $N.$B$BThe latest object of my desire is an artifact known as the Eye of Bhossca. My sources tell me the eye is somewhere within the Scarlet Monastery. As with Shadowfang Keep, you must infiltrate the monastery alone.$B$BIt may behoove you to find a disguise before going in. It will make getting around a touch easier. I'm sure you could find something on the monastery's grounds.$B$BReturn the eye here, and payment will be delivered as before.$B$B- C
78676.objectives: Find The Eye of Bhossca inside of the Scarlet Monastery. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
78676.reward: <You place The Eye of Bhossca into the chest>

78699.title: The Eye of Bhossca
78699.reward: <A note sits in the chest>$B$BFor $N. I'll be keeping an "eye" out for you.$B$B- C

78823.title: Terror of the Desert Skies
78823.details: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.
78823.objectives: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78823.reward: Well now. This is certainly interesting...

78830.title: Terror of the Desert Skies
78830.details: This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.$B$BShe was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?$B$BYou'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.$B$BA quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.
78830.objectives: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.$B$BProvided item:
78830.request: How goes the hunt? Surely the bird hasn't got you beat!
78830.reward: Now there's a feather for your cap! Nicely done, $N.$B$BYou can rest here for a while, if you like. I'm sure your trek through the desert was arduous.

78916.title: The Heart of the Void
78916.details: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
78916.objectives: Bring the Blackfathom Pearl to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.
78916.request: $N, what news do you have from Blackfathom?
78916.reward: The servant of the Old Gods, Aku'mai, is dead. Such an accomplishment is the stuff of real heroes.$B$BThis object may be the key to much greater understanding of the nature of the Void and its effect on our world, It must be studied at once. Thank you, $N.

78917.title: The Heart of the Void
78917.details: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
78917.objectives: Bring the Blackfathom Pearl to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
78917.request: $N, what news do you have from Blackfathom?
78917.reward: The servant of the Old Gods, Aku'mai, is dead. You have done a mighty service for the denizens of Kalimdor with this deed.$B$BThe pearl may also be the key to much greater understanding of the nature of the Void and its effect on our world.  It must be studied at once. Walk with the Earth Mother, $N.

79007.title: ... and that note you found
79007.details: "Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.objectives: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.reward: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.

79008.title: ... and that note you found
79008.details: "Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008.objectives: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79008.reward: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.

79091.title: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography
79091.details: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79091.reward: Thank you, $N. You say this is from the Ironforge library? ...I'm sure they won't miss it.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79092.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal
79092.details: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79092.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79093.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79094.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79095.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79096.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79097.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics
79097.details: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79097.reward: Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.$B$BIf you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

79098.title: Clear the Forest!
79098.details: This one is slain, but these infuriating alliance continue to fight... what is this charm?
79098.objectives: Bring the Silverwing Sentinel Charm to Kazragore, Far Seer, at the Bonfire base in Ashenvale.
79098.request: $N, what news do you have from the front?
79098.reward: These Alliance dogs still prevent us from harvesting the resources needed for Orgrimmar. Continue to drive them out!$B$BThis Warsong battle drum will inspire you to fight them with greater determination. Lok'tar Ogar, $N!

79192.title: Stepping Stones
79192.details: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192.objectives: You tear the note from the plank and read the scrawled writing.
79192.reward: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.

79229.title: Highway Robbery
79229.details: The campsite before you is a grisly scene. Judging by the remains, the victims were two humans and a dwarf. Markings on the bones indicate a savage attack, but the looted supplies tell you this wasn't done by an animal. The wounds don't match centaur weaponry either.$B$BPerhaps an experienced scavenger of these lands would know what to make of this.
79229.objectives: Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.
79229.reward: Ah, so you found another one...

79235.title: On the Lam
79235.details: I've found a couple of scenes like you describe, $N. Always camps of humans and dwarves. Rumor among the caravans is a group of Horde marauders did it. Seems likely given the victims, and how brutal the attacks were.$B$BApparently the bandits fled Desolace once an Alliance marshal got hot on their trail.$B$BIf you're looking to track one of 'em down, I'd check Booty Bay. Ports always have shady characters coming and going. You might catch one trying to get a boat to somewhere.
79235.objectives: Find one of the Desolace marauders.
79235.reward: You need something? Make it quick.

79236.title: Cherry for Your Thoughts?
79236.details: You with the marshal? No, you don't look like it.$B$BThe rumors you've heard are only half true. Yes, we were pillaging human and dwarven camps, but we weren't doing it for the Horde. We were privately employed.$B$BI'll tell you the whole story if you buy me some grog.
79236.objectives: Bring a Cherry Grog to Tokal, in Booty Bay, to hear the rest of her story.
79236.reward: Ah, that's the stuff. Now, where was I?

79242.title: No Honor Among Thieves
79242.details: As I was saying...$B$BOur boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.$B$BOnce the marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.$B$BI'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout on the coast of Arathi.
79242.objectives: Find Illari Duskfeather on the coast of Arathi Highlands, and get access to her cache of stolen loot.
79242.request: <Using Illari's key, you unlock the cache.>
79242.reward: <Inside of the cache, you find a small box, along with some coin.>

79358.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire
79358.details: Floodin' the Thousand Needles is no small feat, $N. If I hadn't felt the elements' outrage meself, I'd have never believed it. But here we are.$B$BThe quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.$B$BIf you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.
79358.objectives: Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.$B$BProvided item:
79358.reward: <Hmmph... the large tauren snorts as he reads the parchment.>$B$BOne things certain... whoever this note is from is right about their preparations going unseen. We've been too busy dealing with the centaur and harpies to send out wind riders to patrol the canyon and bluffs.$B$BYou have our gratitude for alerting us to this threat, but we might still need further assistance.

79360.title: Elemental Aid
79360.details: Now that you have mastered the elements, you have an obligation to them, and thus to all of Azeroth herself. We call to them for aid, we do not demand their power. It is time you return the favors granted to you. And I think I know how.$B$BThe quilboar twist the elements for their own ends, and seem to be extending their reach within these borders. Go into their kraul and put an end to whatever they scheme. These lands must be protected.
79360.objectives: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
79360.request: Danger? There's been no reports of anything like that. And our wind riders are far too busy to spend their time chasing ghost stories.
79360.reward: <You hand the note to Bath'rah who reads it over and gives a half hearted chuckle.>$B$BAh so it be true mon... I too have sensed much unrest in the elemental plane and dis must be one of the causes.$B$BTo flood all da Thousand Needles would take a great storm and many lives be lost.$B$BI t'ink I got just da t'ing for ya, but it won't come easy.

79361.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire
79361.details: So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.$B$BI had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.$B$BTake this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.
79361.objectives: Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.$B$BProvided item:
79361.request: Ah, you be gettin' a bit dusty out der?
79361.reward: Oh yes, yes. We be cookin' now.

79362.title: Grant's Shield
79362.details: A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill.$B$BWith Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.
79362.objectives: Find Grant's Mace on one of the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery then return to Sirra Von'Indie in Darkshire for more information.
79362.request: You' legs be lookin' a wobbly der. De ground be shakin?
79362.reward: Let's get ready to rumble, ya?

79363.title: Silvia's Sword
79363.details: A sword left by the spirit of Raven Hill's guard, Silvia Valor, who lived her life protecting civilians and their homes.$B$BWith Silvia's spirit still visiting farmsteads, perhaps her unfinished business was to route the defias who have taken up residence in Addle's Stead south of Raven Hill.
79363.objectives: Defeat 7 Defias Night Blades and 7 Defias Enchanters in Addle's Stead then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
79363.reward: Shake dat sludge off, we almost done.

79364.title: Eyes on the Sky
79364.details: The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...$B$BThe quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a shaman who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.$B$BWe are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful shaman like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.
79364.objectives: Speak with Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79364.request: We need a larger vial and one of crystal clarity to contain these elements.
79364.reward: Knew I could count on you.

79365.title: With Wind Beneath Your Wings
79365.details: Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.$B$BNow go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.
79365.objectives: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles at Freewind Post.$B$BProvided item:
79365.reward: Our wind riders have found something, but they have been unable to get close enough to assess the situation. Were you able to find anything that might help us?

79366.title: Heed My Call
79366.details: Now that you have the twisted totems, we must wield them to summon forth the corrupted elementals the quilboar are calling upon. Defeat them to cleanse these lands and put an end to the Razormane's abominable ritual then report back to Rau Cliffrunner with your success.$B$BYou should begin your clensing at the steam pools to the west. That area is rich with each of the elements. But be careful, $N. The quilboar will not sit idly while you interrupt their plans.
79366.objectives: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
79366.reward: The rumbling ground fell silent and in my heart I knew you had saved us. You have our gratitude, $N.$B$BPlease accept one of these gifts as a token of our appreciation.

79442.title: The Tempest's Weapons
79442.details: Our people cannot thank you enough, but I have no real use for this eye. I have heard of an old shaman in the Alterac mountains that has an eye for storm elemental magic. Perhaps he may be able to craft something for you.
79442.objectives: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
79442.request: Ahh! Looks like ye made it back in one piece there. Now tell me how did de potion do?$B$BWell 'tis a good thing I had faith in ya. Cuz dat potion be nothing but a mighty fine punch bru'dah. Much tastier than it be effective against those storms.$B$BNow, now... don't be angry wit me. All ya needed was a little encouragement. T'ings turned out how they was always meant to.$B$BBut since you's here... I did notice that mighty fine eye you be holdin...
79442.reward: Tell ya what. No more tricks, no more games. I got somet'in you'd be interested in.$B$BTrade me dat eye and I give you here this mighty fine rune that be ready to teach you new tricks.$B$BWhat ya say?

79482.title: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
79482.details: Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.$B$BWe're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it!  Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.$B$BSee if both are out there, safe and sound!
79482.objectives: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
79482.reward: Y-y-you can h-h-hear me!  Thank the b-b-bottom line!$B$BI'm not really a s-s-snowman - my n-n-name is Sacks, and I w-w-work for the Ironforge b-b-branch of Smokywood Pastures... I g-g-got sent out here to look for a m-m-missing package, when I was attacked by a c-c-creature I have never seen b-b-before!$B$BSo v-v-very cold...

I g-g-got sent out here to look for a m-m-missing package, when I was attacked by a c-c-creature I have never seen b-b-before!$B$BSo v-v-very cold...

79492.title: Metzen the Reindeer
79492.details: DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!$B$BMetzen is one of Greatfather Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!$B$BCheck out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!$B$BPlease, hurry!
79492.objectives: Find Metzen the Reindeer.  Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.$B$BWhen you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.$B$BReturn the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge once Metzen is freed.$B$BProvided item:
79492.request: $N!  Were the notes in the satchel I gave you enough information to locate Metzen?  I hate to think of that those cruel thugs might do to him... but there's no way we can afford to pay such an exorbitant ransom!
79492.reward: You did it!  Huzzah!$B$BMetzen flew back into Greatfather Winter's stables - yes Metzen can really fly - just a little while ago!  The dust worked like a charm; I knew it would.  You've saved the Feast of Winter Veil as well as Smokywood Pastures from disaster.  Thank you, $N.$B$BListen... because of what you've done here, I want you to have this.  It's something VERY special; if you have a mount, I think you'll get a kick out of it.  Happy Winter Veil!

79974.title: Wet Job
79974.details: "Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.$B$BThe face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time.$BThat's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974.objectives: Dusting off a messenger bag emerging from the soil, you find a parchment nestled among the supplies.

79975.title: Eagle's Fist
79975.details: <You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>$B$B"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.$B$BMy loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
79975.objectives: Water spray dampens the air, the view is incredible.
79975.reward: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.

79976.title: This Must Be The Place
79976.details: "So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."
79976.objectives: Whoever was here, you just missed them.
79976.reward: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.

79980.title: Scramble
79980.details: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980.reward: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.

80001.title: Rekindle
80001.details: An extinguished fire pit. The wood is even dry enough to catch a flame.
80001.reward: You put your scout skills to work.

81570.title: Jarl Needs a Blade
81570.details: I have cutting to do.  I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade.  A certain blade...$B$BSome people call it a moonsteel broadsword.  I call it a swing blade.$B$BYou help me?  Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.$B$BBut don't sleep on this.  What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
81570.objectives: Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
81570.reward: That's a good blade.  It has a good swing.  It's a good swing blade.  Thank you.  Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!  Now I want to try it....$B$BLater.  I'll try it later.  But like I was saying... thanks.

86574.title: Stonetalon Supply Run
86574.details: Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>$B$B<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>
86574.objectives: Collect 6 Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.
86574.request: I hope that shipment comes soon...
86574.reward: You found the missing shipment?$B$BOh, I had no idea that the courier didn't make it. That is... a tragic state of affairs...$B$BI'll put these supplies to good use to make sure that her loss is not in vain.

86576.title: Bloodfury Trinkets
86576.details: In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.$B$BWhile you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.
86576.request: I have important matters to consider, $C. Be quick.
86576.reward: Ah, you have brought sunstones that the harpies collect! The harpies love to gather objects that are shiny, but they do not know the true value of the stones. By capturing the dazzling light of the sun, these stones reflect its majesty and allow us to adorn our shrines and homes with tiny motes of light in its honor. The moon, too, illuminates them with its silver beauty at night.$B$BThese stones remind us of the connection we have to the lights of the skies.

86585.title: Banner of the Fallen
86585.details: The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.$B$BThe trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585.objectives: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
86585.request: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585.reward: You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.$B$BI'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.

86613.title: Excavation Tools
86613.details: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
86613.objectives: Return 6 Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
86613.request: We just, uh, need to adjust our dig site and we can get this whole thing back on track!
86613.reward: Our tools!$B$BWhen the troggs overran the camp, we had to leave most of our tools behind. This'll be a big help once we get this invasion under control and can start working again!

86614.title: Silver of the Waves
86614.objectives: Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner.
86614.request: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?
86614.reward: My hair clip! I thought this was lost for good!$B$BThis'll shine right up with just a little work. Thank you for bringing it to me! I'll make it worth your while.

86667.title: Snowbound
86667.details: My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.$B$BI'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667.objectives: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch.$B$BProvided item:
86667.reward: This jar is for me?$B$BSnow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!$B$BA pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.$B$BWell, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.

86757.title: Slowing the Orc Advance
86757.details: Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.$B$BWe need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.$B$BFight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
86757.objectives: Bring 6 Jagged Orc Swords and 4 Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.

86758.title: Twisting the Knife
86758.details: Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.$B$BAnyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.$B$BI've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758.objectives: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
86758.reward: Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick!$B$BOh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?

86776.title: Ingredients for the Forge
86776.details: Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!$B$BI can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
86776.objectives: Bring 10 Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
86776.reward: Ah, this is a relief! I should be able to keep the forge going now. Hopefully one of these days we'll get a trader bringing coal into town regularly!

86784.title: Sticks and Bones
86784.details: My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."$B$BIf you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784.objectives: Collect 6 Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.$B$BProvided item:
86784.reward: Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.$B$BI have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.

87288.title: Soft Saber Pelts
87288.details: Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.$B$BI'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
87288.objectives: Bring 6 Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
87288.request: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288.reward: Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.$B$BHere, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.

87318.title: Hearts of the Lost
87318.details: Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!$B$BI managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive!$B$BPlease, if you see any sign of her, let me know!
87318.reward: Corma sent you? That's great news!$B$BWhen the Dark Irons ambushed us, we were separated, and I hit my head and couldn't tell which direction I was going. I wound up here and I've been living out of the supplies in my bag for the last few days. Now that you've made it past the Dark Irons, though, it may be possible for me to make my escape.$B$BI just have to gather my things and take a moment to catch my senses, and I'll figure out a way to escape!$B$BShe never gave up on me. What a lovely heart.

87491.title: Spark of Freedom
87491.details: Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!$B$BFire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!$B$BNo Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly!$B$BLet me out and I will BURN THEM ALL!
87491.objectives: Escort the captive fire elemental out of Dun Modr and to its freedom.
87491.reward: That was quite a pyrotechnic display! I don't think I've seen anything quite like it!$B$BGlad the fire elemental, uh, ran outta steam, as it were. Coulda been bad if it had decided to go after the rest of us instead of those Dark Irons!

87760.title: Holy Diver
87760.details: I have received word back from Darnassus, $N!$B$BFrom the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!$B$BIt is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!$B$BThe naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
87760.objectives: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
87760.request: We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!
87760.reward: This has been a long journey, Orangequake, but it was worth it.$B$BAt long last, you have wrested away the rod that the naga use to compel the sea creatures into their service. I will make sure it is destroyed, and the threshers and sea turtles can finally live in peace.$B$BThank you again. Your persistence has finally been rewarded, and I, personally, am grateful to you.

88756.title: Bring Back a Bang
88756.details: The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.$B$BI don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!$B$BI know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
88756.objectives: Retrieve 3 Stolen Explosives from the Dark Iron Dwarf camps.
88756.request: This war against the Dark Irons just keeps going on and on!
88756.reward: Ach, that's a load off me mind. At least the Dark Irons won't be able to roll a bomb-cart into our wagons... or lob 'em in a trebuchet... or roll 'em down the hill at us... or feed 'em tae slimes and then let the slimes loose near are camp and set 'em on fire.$B$BNow we just have tae make sure the powder stays dry!$B$BThanks!

88757.title: Accessories of the Lost
88757.details: While I was fleeing from those Dark Irons, I wound up dropping lots of my gear!$B$BIt looks like I lost... my green leather waterskin, my spellbook, my necklace, and... well I need these things!$B$BIf you can find them while I repack and catch my breath, that would be a great help.
88757.objectives: Bring back Essene's Necklace, Essene's Spellbook, and Essene's Waterskin.
88757.request: Just relacing my boots! Any luck getting past those Dark Irons and finding my things?
88757.reward: You got my book! And my waterskin! And my necklace! Oh, good fortune finds me today... thank you so much.$B$BI'd better make sure everything is intact!

88758.title: Sentiments of the Lost
88758.details: I just need to finish repacking, and I can get out of here!$B$BIf you'll do me one last favor, here--take this note to Corma. It'll let her know that I'm alive and I'm on my way!
88758.objectives: Bring Essene's note back to Corma Villard.
88758.request: Have you found any sign of her?
88758.reward: She's alive? She's alive!$B$BLet me see this note... "Dear Corma..." mhmm... oh, blessed day! Thank the Light!$B$BI can never thank you enough for reuniting us. I can't wait until she makes it back here!$B$BYou've done a wonderful service for us both.

90902.title: Rediscovering the Light
90902.details: I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others.$B$BThe only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902.objectives: Heal 5 Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
90902.request: Mastery of the light will return, in time.
90902.reward: Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances.$B$BBe well and walk in the light once more, $C.

91208.title: Coming to Terms
91208.details: Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.$B$BThese individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
91208.objectives: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
91208.reward: Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.$B$BI will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, $N.

91209.title: Continue Your Training
91209.details: Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training.$B$BOne last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
91209.objectives: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
91209.reward: Welcome aboard, $C. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training.$B$BWhen you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.$B$BGo with the light, $C.

91282.title: A Second Home
91282.details: It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal.$B$BIf you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery at Northface Rock. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282.objectives: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
91282.reward: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Tyr's Watch, brother.

91285.title: Murlocs at the Gates
91285.details: Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.$B$BA tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285.objectives: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
