91285.reward: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.

91294.title: Touring the Grounds
91294.details: Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.$B$BWhen you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.$B$BI'm very glad to have met you, $N. May the light be your guide.
91294.objectives: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
91294.request: Welcome to Bandarion Keep, $C. It's always good to see a new face.
91294.reward: Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.$B$BMy name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.$B$BThere's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.

91316.title: Making Repairs
91316.details: This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.$B$BThe ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
91316.objectives: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.
91316.request: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, its turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.
91316.reward: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.

91317.title: The Tarnished
91317.details: Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.$B$BAs it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317.objectives: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
91317.request: The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.
91317.reward: Excellent work, $N. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us paladins. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal.$B$BI suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.

91723.title: Delicate Instruments
91723.details: Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.$BThe surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
91723.objectives: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91723.reward: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...

91724.title: Delicate Instruments
91724.details: Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.$BThis is most frustrating, $N. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
91724.objectives: Kill 6 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91724.reward: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, $N.

91725.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies
91725.details: I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!$B$BI dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
91725.objectives: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
91725.reward: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!

91732.title: Good Steel
91732.details: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732.objectives: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
91732.request: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732.reward: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.

91733.title: Downstream
91733.details: I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.$BBetween the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort - do you think you could find them for me?
91733.objectives: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
91733.reward: You look a bit damp, $N. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.

91736.title: Applejack Still
91736.details: A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.
91736.reward: The machine dispenses a clear liquid into a bottle...

91738.title: An Apple Treat
91738.details: The sergeant's eyes light up as he notices your bottle of Thunder Applejack...
91738.reward: Do my eyes deceive me? I haven't seen a drop of Thunder Applejack in months!$BThis should put a smile on the troops' faces. You have my thanks, $C!

91740.title: Croaky's Head
91740.details: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
91740.objectives: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
91740.reward: We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, $C. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.

91741.title: Nibbled-On Book
91741.details: Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741.objectives: Return the book to Brother Paxton.
91741.request: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741.reward: Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!$B$BThanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?

91743.title: Rascally Rodents
91743.details: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.objectives: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
91743.request: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743.reward: Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.$B$BBut there's still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?

91745.title: Mining Consultant
91745.details: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745.objectives: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
91745.reward: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.

91746.title: Elmpaw's Head
91746.details: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
91746.objectives: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91746.reward: So, you took down Elmpaw? Very impressive, $N!$B$BLet me give you something in return for your trophy - I know a few collectors who will pay quite well to have this on their mantle once I've prepared it.

91751.title: Rough Wolf Pelts
91751.details: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
91751.objectives: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91751.request: Any luck with those wolf pelts?
91751.reward: Excellent work collecting these pelts, $C. You have a real talent for hunting.

91752.title: The Big Picture
91752.details: Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.$B$BGo get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752.objectives: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
91752.request: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752.reward: Thank you for returning these stolen books, $N. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.$B$BYou're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!

91753.title: An Enchanting Lesson
91753.details: Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.$B$BObtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
91753.objectives: Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.$B$BLuminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
91753.reward: Theory and practice are two sides of a coin, $N. Remember this.

91758.title: Follow That Kobold!
91758.details: You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.$B$BGo talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758.objectives: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
91758.reward: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.

91772.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
91772.details: Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.$B$BFollow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.$B$BI have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772.objectives: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
91772.request: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772.reward: What's this, $N? Tracking kobolds?$B$BWell, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.$B$BGood work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.

91775.title: Book Return
91775.details: While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.$B$BTake this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.objectives: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.$B$BProvided item:
91775.request: Have you found all the books yet?
91775.reward: I applaud your diligence, $N. Brother Paxton sent a list of books, and you've found most of the missing ones. The rest must have been taken to the Jasperlode Mine.$B$BYou can keep that book bag!

91777.title: Rare Books
91777.details: There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".$B$BThe kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.$B$BBut I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777.objectives: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
91777.request: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777.reward: Oh, $N! Thank you so much for saving my library. You've done me an amazing service. Please take one of these fine weapons. They were intended for the militia, but you can make better use of them.

91858.title: Diplomatic Incident
91858.details: A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.$B$BA pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.$B$BWe have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858.objectives: Travel to The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and speak with Trevan Rol about the missing Earthen Ring travelers.
91858.reward: Danitha sent you? Well in that case I already know why you are here. You just walked into a damned fine mess, $C.

91859.title: A Curious Pair
91859.details: Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.$B$BWhy was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859.objectives: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
91859.reward: I might not care for you paladins, but I will say that your timing is impeccable. It's better to be lucky than good, I suppose?

91860.title: A Grim Fate
91860.details: Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.$B$BIf you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.$B$BI know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
91860.objectives: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.
91860.reward: <The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?$B$BThis will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>

91861.title: Into Fenris Keep
91861.objectives: Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.
91861.reward: You are one of the Forsaken, yes? Can you help free me?$B$BTime is short for me, I am afraid. Please hurry!

91862.title: Lumina Windsinger
91862.details: Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.$B$BI came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.$B$BWe have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
91862.objectives: Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.
91862.request: Gnolls are the second worst creatures I've encountered yet on Azeroth.
91862.reward: Thank you, $C. Unfortunately we aren't out of danger yet.

91899.title: A Sealed Crate
91899.details: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899.reward: Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.$B$BHere is your payment.

91900.title: A Sealed Crate
91900.details: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91900.reward: Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.$B$BHere is your payment.

91901.title: A Sealed Crate
91901.details: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91901.reward: Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.$B$BHere is your payment.

91904.title: A Sealed Crate
91904.details: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904.reward: Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.$B$BHere is your payment.

91905.title: A Sealed Crate
91905.details: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91905.reward: Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.$B$BHere is your payment.

91906.title: A Sealed Crate
91906.details: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91906.reward: Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.$B$BHere is your payment.

91920.title: Wild Eyes
91920.details: I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.$B$BAlong the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.$B$BIf my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920.objectives: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
91920.reward: The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.$B$BHowever, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...$B$B<Renferrel takes the eyes.>$B$BI can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.

91921.title: Return to Quinn (Again)
91921.details: Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.$B$BNow, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
91921.objectives: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
91921.request: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921.reward: <Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>$B$BYes, I can feel it working.  I will soon be able to travel.$B$BYou have done me a great favor, $N.

92109.title: My First Alchemy Set
92109.details: Erm... 'Ello, $gmister:miss;. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!$B$BWhen I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.$B$BWell, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
92109.objectives: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92109.request: 'Ello again! Did you bring back alchemy stuff?
92109.reward: Oh my gosh! Look at these! Did you pick the herbs yourself?$B$BWow, thanks mister, I am going to see what I can make with these right now! Do you want to watch?

92110.title: My First Real Potion
92110.details: Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?$B$BThat was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.$B$BI don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
92110.objectives: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92110.request: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.
92110.reward: You brought me murloc eyes! I am so excited for my first REAL potion I can't breathe!$B$BI snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... you can do the mixing this time.$B$B<The child watches enthusiastically you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.>$B$BWow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!

92124.title: Book Inventory
92124.details: We need to take stock of how many books are missing!$B$BGo talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.$B$BHe's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.$B$BDon't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
92124.objectives: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.
92124.reward: Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.$B$BIt looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.$B$BWhile you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.

92401.title: A Frightened Request
92401.details: It's my husband Edward...$B$BHe has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.$B$BThere are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401.objectives: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.reward: What I asked of you was not fair, nor would it have been unjust for you to simply walk away. Thank you stranger. I am unable to repay you in kind but I hope one of these is acceptable.$B$BI hope our paths cross again without such sorrow.

92415.title: Remember That I Love You
92415.objectives: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.
92415.request: What is it, $N? What are you looking for?
92415.reward: Heartweaver? Heartweaver...$B$BOh! Little Jeremy Heartweaver. He was brought in years ago after the attack on Lordaeron. Lost both of his parents in the attack, poor thing.$B$BHe was actually adopted not too long ago by a sweet woman out in Duskwood.

92421.title: Light's Justice
92421.details: As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.$B$BAbove the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.$B$BWould that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421.objectives: Collect 25 Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
92421.request: What remains of the invading scourge? Have you managed to find suitable replacement parts?
92421.reward: Let those who fall from the Banshee Queen's grace meet our justice!$B$BWith these parts, our brothers and sisters have hope to see another day. You do Captain Bandarion proud.

92422.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael
92422.details: Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth.$B$BOur scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, $N.$B$BIf you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422.objectives: Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
92422.reward: While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.$B$BThank you $N.

92432.title: An Alarming Request
92432.details: I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.$B$BWe know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!$B$BArchmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.
92432.objectives: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92432.reward: I see Jacques was successful in garnering aid.$B$BWhile not strictly permitted, we cannot allow our pride to turn away allies in our desperate hour. Do not let the guards fool you. Things are anything but under control.

92434.title: Blood in the Streets
92434.details: Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.$B$BTake the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
92434.objectives: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake.
92434.request: Stay your weapon, $R.$B$BI think you will find that key won't be enough to get past my wards. You didn't truly think we would leave such a vulnerability open at a time like this, did you?
92434.reward: It is surely no coincidence the horde has taken an interest in my city during such a precarious time.$B$BIn fact, I was counting on it. I have a proposition for you.

92456.title: A Green Sample
92456.details: If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.$B$BFor a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.$B$BYou're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
92456.objectives: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of Dalaran for Shylamiir in Stormwind City.

92457.title: Starving Arcane
92457.details: The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.$B$BWhile we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457.objectives: Defeat 8 Seeking Remnants, 8 Saturated Remnants, and 8 Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.

92458.title: Heart of Disruption
92458.details: Whatever disturbed the ley lines, it started at the top of the Violet Citadel. A thunderous crash rang out from the parlors above, and now we are overrun with rampant arcane power. It's taking all we have just to keep the wards in place.$B$BWe cannot afford to stall any longer. We need help.$B$BThe Kirin Tor are busy inside, but you will still need a less public approach to gain entry. Take this key and meet me in the citadel once you've made your way into the city. We must put an end to this disruption.
92458.objectives: Collect the Arcane Mote for the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.$B$BProvided item:

92459.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor
92459.details: The council will not be happy to learn of our subterfuge, but they cannot deny results. The city is calming down, and we are free to lower our wards.$B$BI think it's only fair you deliver the good word. Take this mote to Archmage Celindra within the Violet Citadel.
92459.objectives: Speak to Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.

92460.title: Coming of Age
92460.details: Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.$B$BGo, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460.objectives: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92460.reward: Gale's greetings, $N. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history.$B$BToday you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition.$B$BAs you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel.

92461.title: Harmony in Balance
92461.details: We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.$B$BThe vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.$B$BHead east and cull some of the vuldren there.
92461.objectives: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
92461.reward: Thank you for your service to Zephras, young $C.$B$BThe vuldren are typically quite docile, but the animals that call Zephras home can sense when the magic on the winds is out of balance, which can lead to dangerous and unpredictable behavior if left unchecked.

92462.title: Infestation Investigation
92462.details: One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove.$B$BCirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462.objectives: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
92462.request: Such pests cannot be allowed to find root in our peaceful grove. An infestation can quickly grow dangerous if left unchecked.
92462.reward: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.

92463.title: The Cirrusfly Queen
92463.details: If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.$B$BGo deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.$B$BPut her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463.objectives: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
92463.request: Cirrusflies aren't to be underestimated. They might not seem dangerous, but you have to watch out for the bigger ones. The bigger they are, the meaner!
92463.reward: Excellent work, $N. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.

92464.title: Elemental Unrest
92464.details: Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.$B$BNot truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them.$B$BMy apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
92464.objectives: Speak to Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
92464.reward: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.

92465.title: Agitators
92465.details: The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.$B$BRegrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.$B$BWill you lend me your aid, $C?
92465.objectives: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
92465.reward: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.

92466.title: Call of Earth
92466.details: While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.$B$BTravel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
92466.objectives: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
92466.request: The Al'Aketh cult represents the most direct and urgent danger to our homeland. Their increasingly extremist actions have destabilized our society and damaged our already-weakened connection to the spirits of the four winds. The elements demand action to prove our resilience and resolve, which are traits that are endemic to the domain of the element of earth.
92466.reward: You have returned and brought what I have requested and thus your grit and determination are unquestionable. You are ready for the next step, $N.

92467.title: Call of Earth
92467.details: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.$B$BThe sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.$B$BSeek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass northeast of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need to see.
92467.objectives: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.$B$BProvided item:
92467.reward: Ah... $N... child of the four winds... You seek understanding. You seek answers. Why have the winds left you? How may you get them back? These are answers I cannot provide, for I do not know the motives or movements of the winds.$B$BI can, however, teach you much of the earth. Its strength, its resolve. Even here, high in this endless sea of clouds, you are still a creature of the earth. If you hope to find the strength to speak to the spirits of the four winds once more, this is the path you must walk.

92468.title: Call of Earth
92468.details: Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.$B$BBe patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
92468.objectives: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
92468.request: As you will come to learn, the path we walk is not as simple as it may seem. While we seek to find the voice needed to speak with the spirits of the winds, the winds are but one of the elemental forces of this world. Only through understanding, and--we hope--mastery of all four elements will we regain our voice to again sing the songs of the wind.
92468.reward: Good!$B$BThe totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among $C--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you.$B$BThe trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge.$B$BBut for now, take this earth totem...

92469.title: Return to Rorian
92469.details: You've done enough here, $C. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.$B$BHead back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469.objectives: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92469.reward: This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.$B$BYou've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, $N. Thank you.

92470.title: Foul Matriarch
92470.details: Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.$B$BGo to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470.objectives: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
92470.request: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.
92470.reward: Very well done. You've felled beasts and laid low cultist interlopers. You have shown great promise but your path must soon take you beyond the relative safety of Thendal Village.

92471.title: Aetheen of the Gales
92471.details: You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.$B$BThe one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471.objectives: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
92471.reward: Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.$B$BSo tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?

92472.title: The Next Step
92472.details: One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.$B$BYour path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472.objectives: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
92472.reward: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.

92473.title: Aggressive Encroachment
92473.details: The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.$B$BWe were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473.objectives: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
92473.request: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?
92473.reward: Well done, $C. The Rangers of the Grove are in your debt.

92474.title: Falling With Style
92474.details: Well hello there, $N! Want to play a game?$B$BAll you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.$B$BThe rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
92474.objectives: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
92474.request: Using your ability to walk on air can get you out of--and, well... into--all kinds of trouble!
92474.reward: How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our skyborne gifts!$B$BThat being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.$B$BIn the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.

92479.title: A Scribbled Letter
92479.details: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479.objectives: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
92479.request: Ah, ye got me letter, $N... good.$B$BTime was when ye'd not catch a $R dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.
92479.reward: Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.$B$BThis land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled $C can give 'em. Good luck.

92481.title: A Student of the Arcane
92481.details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
92481.objectives: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
92481.request: Greetings, $N. I'm pleased to have the privilege of furthering your magical studies.
92481.reward: Let me have a look at you. Yes, I believe you will make a fine young $C. The power of the arcane has waned amongst our people, but there are those who would seek to rediscover much of what we've lost in the millennia we've spent here amongst the clouds. I am sure that you will lead the charge in this never ending search for arcane knowledge, and ultimately make us proud.$B$BSpeak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

92482.title: The Way of the Hunter
92482.details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
92482.objectives: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
92482.reward: The way of the $C is fraught with danger, and only those with the keenest senses and quickest reflexes can thrive in the wilds. I look at you and I am reminded of myself when I stood before my mentor, so many years ago. I believe that you have what it takes, but in the end that is up to you alone.$B$BSpeak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

92483.title: At Home in the Shadows
92483.details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.$B$BHe's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.
92483.objectives: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.
92483.reward: I almost did not hear you approach me, young $C.$B$BAlmost.$B$BAlmost won't be good enough when you leave Thendal Grove. You must be a slender blade, silent and steady. Ever vigilant and ever mindful of your surroundings. You might have what it takes to survive the dangers of Zephras. You also might end up with your throat slit in a ditch. Ultimately that's entirely up to you.$B$BSpeak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

92484.title: Embracing the Elements
92484.details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
92484.objectives: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
92484.reward: Can you hear it? The whispers of the winds? Doubtful, considering that the spirits stopped speaking with us when they left us those years ago.$B$BThose among us who would seek audience with the spirits of the four winds once more hone our understanding of the elements and the natural world, dearly hoping to reestablish the dialogue that was so abruptly ended.$B$BWould you walk this path and master the elements?$B$BSpeak with me again if you wish to take your next steps and I will train you.

92485.title: A Student of Nature
92485.details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.$B$BHeed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485.objectives: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.
92485.request: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
92485.reward: The flora and fauna of Zephras Isle represent a rich tapestry of vibrant life. The ecosystem requires constant balance to maintain the harmony of nature, and we druids are the keepers of that balance. I see much potential in you, but this path is not an easy one, and you will need guidance as you grow in strength as a student of the fang, the claw, the feather, and the branch.$B$BSpeak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

92489.title: Power Overwhelming
92489.details: The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.$B$BIn recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.$B$BWe must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489.objectives: Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran for High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.

92514.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
92514.details: You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.$B$BOh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
92514.objectives: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
92514.reward: Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.$B$BNow that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.

92515.title: The Problem With Prideclaws
92515.details: As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.$B$BBring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515.objectives: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
92515.request: If you ask me, I think Prideclaws are actually kind of cute. From a safe distance... and while standing behind someone holding a sword, of course.
92515.reward: I didn't say it wouldn't be a dirty job, did I?

92516.title: Hippogryph Harassment
92516.details: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.
92516.objectives: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92516.request: Hippogryphs are very proud creatures. It's probably the noise from the wagon trains that rile them up and cause them to attack. Whatever the reason for the attacks, dead caravaneers aren't something that we can ignore.
92516.reward: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.

92517.title: The Criminal Element
92517.details: There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.$B$BI need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517.objectives: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92517.reward: With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.$B$BStill though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.

92519.title: Ward Restocking
92519.details: Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.$B$BIf you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.$B$BFollow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519.objectives: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.

92528.title: Among the Faithful
92528.details: The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!$B$BNormally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.$B$BFor now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528.objectives: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92528.reward: Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!$B$BIf they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?$B$BThe Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.$B$BRegardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.

92529.title: Falaath Village
92529.details: It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.$B$BOnly through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
92529.objectives: Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.$B$BIf you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.
92529.reward: What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!$B$BWe welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.

92532.title: The Warrior's Path
92532.details: While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.$B$BGive it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
92532.objectives: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
92532.request: So you've come for training, then?
92532.reward: You are about to embark upon a dangerous journey. Our world is changing and it will need those who have the will to lead and protect others if our people hope to survive. As you grow in power you will need guidance. Come to me--I will do what I can to train you as you progress.$B$BGood luck, $N, may the winds guide you.

92544.title: Al'Aketh Thugs
92544.details: A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.$B$BI need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544.objectives: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
92544.request: I suspect that seeing a few of their fellows bleeding on the ground will do wonders to dissuade any zealous ambitions these thugs might have had.
92544.reward: It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon.$B$BThank you, $C. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.

92550.title: Havoc in the Highlands
92550.details: Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.$B$BI've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550.objectives: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
92550.request: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.
92550.reward: Thank the winds you've returned!$B$BSania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.$B$BYou've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.$B$BWinds guide you, $N.

92551.title: Stolen Supplies
92551.details: I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.$B$BThe Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
92551.objectives: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92551.request: There's a lot of hungry and desperate skyborne here who need these supplies.
92551.reward: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.

92553.title: Restocking the Larders
92553.details: Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.$B$BI'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553.objectives: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
92553.request: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!
92553.reward: These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.$B$BIf you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.

92579.title: To Valanaar
92579.details: For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.$B$BThe cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.$B$BAt any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $N.
92579.objectives: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92579.request: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
92579.reward: <Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>$B$BAonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers we have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.$B$BIf you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.

92595.title: The Windshapers
92595.details: <Illaya smiles warmly at you.>$B$BI am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift.$B$BCome, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92595.objectives: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
92595.request: The world is changing and the path forward will be difficult. We have but one chance to save ourselves.
92595.reward: I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.$B$BBetween threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.

92596.title: The High Order
92596.details: The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.$B$BCome, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596.objectives: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
92596.request: Our land is going through changes, but there may yet be some good to come of this.
92596.reward: The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.$B$BBetween threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.

92597.title: Reading the Ley Lines
92597.details: Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.$B$BGo to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a ley line there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
92597.objectives: Use your Read Ley Line racial ability at the ley line in Thendal Grove.
92597.reward: Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, But that's the best part of the gift... making the unknown known.$B$BIf we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... and power.

92598.title: The Gift of Skysight
92598.details: As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.$B$BYou'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.
92598.objectives: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
92598.reward: Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.$B$BYou'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.

92640.title: Desperate Times
92640.details: Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.$B$BIt so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help.$B$BSpeak with Valennia for the details.
92640.objectives: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.
92640.reward: Tensions between the Windshapers and High Order are high right now, but we couldn't hope to carry out this plan without both groups on board.

92642.title: Disrupting Logistics
92642.details: Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.$B$BYou don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.$B$BGo down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.
92642.objectives: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92642.reward: You are still alive? Thank the winds for small miracles, I suppose.

92643.title: The Turncoat
92643.details: There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.$B$BThis defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.
92643.objectives: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.
92643.reward: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>

92644.title: Unfortunate News
92644.objectives: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92644.reward: The turncoat was already dead when you arrived, you say? This is unfortunate news.$B$B<You hand over the crystal you found on the dead cultist's body.>$B$BInteresting...

92645.title: Breaking the Breaker
92645.details: This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.$B$BI might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $C.
92645.objectives: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92645.reward: Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, $C.$B$BWe might just make it out of this alive after all.

92646.title: Confront Lorthuna
92646.details: Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.$B$BI'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.$B$BUnless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $C.
92646.objectives: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
92646.reward: I sent a few of our healers to ensure that Valennia and her remaining forces made it back in one piece. She should be resting in the High Elder's residence now.$B$BMuln has already departed back to Azeroth, but he and I spoke of what is next for the Windshapers and our mission to Azeroth. Unfortunately, the island is more vulnerable than ever now and we need a plan to protect Zephras from what is to come.

92679.title: Blood Tithe
92679.details: H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...$B$B<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>$B$B...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679.objectives: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
92679.reward: <Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>$B$BAt least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.$B$BStranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.

92682.title: Make Yourself Useful
92682.details: Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.$B$BFerauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.$B$BHead outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me.$B$BLet's see what you've got in a fight.
92682.objectives: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
92682.request: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.
92682.reward: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.

92683.title: Flutterfly Dust
92683.details: I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.$B$BTake this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.
92683.objectives: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.
92683.request: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.
92683.reward: This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.$B$BDon't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.

92684.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders
92684.details: As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?$B$BTake care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.$B$BBring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92684.objectives: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.
92684.request: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.
92684.reward: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.

92685.title: The Hills Have Eyes
92685.details: The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.$B$BBring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685.objectives: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92685.request: If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.$B$B<Aamelia laughs loudly.>
92685.reward: When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.$B$BOn a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.$B$BFerauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?

92693.title: Standing Our Ground
92693.details: You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.$B$BThis is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.$B$BOn the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.
92693.objectives: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
92693.request: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.
92693.reward: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.

92698.title: What Is My Purpose?
92698.details: <You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>$B$B...Function error...$B$B...Question...$B$B...What is....$B$B...Function...$B$B<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>
92698.objectives: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.
92698.reward: The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.$B$BIn the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.

92699.title: The Supreme Magister
92699.details: Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here.
