The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.$B$BYou should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92699.reward: Hello and welcome. Rathiril sent me a magical missive about you and he mentioned you had some promise.$B$BWith you standing before me now, I can see why he suggested you seek me out. You have a vibrant arcane aura about you. Few enough of us anymore have the aptitude, let alone the will, to do what is needed to save our home. Do you have the boldness and strength needed to aid The High Order?$B$BI suppose we will see.

92700.title: The Grand Skyseer
92700.details: Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.$B$BYou should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92700.reward: Elder Amberwind sent me a message about you and your exploits in Shen'dar Village. You are most welcome here, friend.$B$BYou have a strong aura, and you clearly have a resonance with the spirits. Fewer and fewer of us have the skysight of late, and Zephras needs those with the gift if we are to survive these trying times. I am glad you have found your way to me.$B$BI look forward to further making your acquaintance.

92701.title: To Valanaar
92701.details: For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.$B$BThe cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.$B$BAt any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $N.
92701.objectives: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92701.request: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
92701.reward: <Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>$B$BAonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers I have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.$B$BIf you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.

92703.title: Deliver the News
92703.details: I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $N.$B$BIf you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.$B$B<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>$B$BHe doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
92703.objectives: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
92703.reward: <Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>$B$BI don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall.$B$BI'll never forget what you did for us, $N. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.

92706.title: WANTED: Bruuz
92706.details: Calling all anglers!$B$BA giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!$B$B-- Gazlowe
92706.objectives: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
92706.request: What can I do for ya, $R?
92706.reward: Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!"all the time?$B$BI might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.

92707.title: The Giant in the Den
92707.details: Wrenched from its hulking corpse, the goliath's bracers are massive. Your whole arm, up to the shoulder, can fit through one without touching the sides.$B$BYou should bring these back to Hammerfall, as a warning. Drum Fel ought to know what he's up against.
92707.objectives: Bring the Goliath's Wristguards to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.

92708.title: A Grand Adventure
92708.details: The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.$B$BWe'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.
92708.objectives: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
92708.reward: So now you see? There is a world of knowledge and untapped potential outside of Skywall. This will never stop being our home, but I've come to believe that the path to our salvation lies below. We must travel to Azeroth and gain the power and means to save Zephras Isle. This is the way.$B$BWill you have the courage to join us when the time comes?

92709.title: A Grand Adventure
92709.details: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
92709.objectives: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.
92709.reward: So do you now see? Rediscovering the ancient magic of our forebears is the key to unlocking the secrets of Zephras Isle and securing our future, but in order to save our home, we must rediscover what we've lost these past millennia.$B$BAzeroth is the key. The Kirin Tor will show us the way.$B$BWhile we make ready to leave, you should check in with the other members of the High Order here in Valanaar. Most of them have tasks that they could use help from one such as yourself to see completed.

92727.title: The Missing Scholar
92727.details: Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.$B$BOne of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.$B$BIf you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
92727.objectives: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.
92727.reward: <The satchel lying before you has a few specks of what appears to be dried blood on the flap. Studying the stain you also notice that the flap also has a name embroidered onto it. It reads "Fillion Flamebreeze".>

92741.title: Unwelcome Visitors
92741.details: The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.$B$BTravel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
92741.objectives: Travel to Shadowgale Forest and collect 8 Shriekling Talons for Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar.
92741.request: The High Order does not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
92741.reward: That is quite the haul of talons you've brought me. I cannot wait to dig into this!$B$BThank you for your service to the High Order, $C.

92742.title: Testing the Wells
92742.details: We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.$B$BGo to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742.objectives: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.

92743.title: A Conqueror's Crown
92743.details: As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength!$B$BWarug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.$B$BDo this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
92743.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.

92744.title: Murloc Gills
92744.details: The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.$BCollect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744.objectives: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.
92744.request: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744.reward: I see... these gills appear to be healthy, for now. But we must not be complacent.

92745.title: The State of the Mines
92745.details: The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.$BThe Defias have seized the mines of Westfall and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.
92745.objectives: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.
92745.reward: Well done, $N. But I fear the source of the poison may lie somewhere else...

92747.title: Moonbrook Espionage
92747.details: Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.$B$BI am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?$B$BPlease travel to Moonbrook, $N, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747.objectives: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.

92748.title: Explosive Consultation
92748.details: The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.$B$BWhatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748.objectives: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.

92749.title: A Dynamite Plan
92749.details: Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!$BWe'll start with some dynamite...
92749.objectives: Obtain 10 Coarse Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
92749.reward: This is a great start! Now to tie it all together... and add a little extra zing...

92750.title: Detonation at a Distance
92750.details: I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.$BI'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750.objectives: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
92750.reward: Hmm... Looking for something specific, are you?

92751.title: Detonation at a Distance
92751.details: You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.$B$BIf you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.$B$BOh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.
92751.objectives: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
92751.reward: Great - that's the detonator we need!

92752.title: Explosive Consultation
92752.details: That's it--the bomb's ready to go! Careful with that detonator, now.
92752.objectives: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.

92753.title: Destruction in Deadmines
92753.details: The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.$BI will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
92753.objectives: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
92753.reward: So you found the forge, and planted the bomb... only one thing remains to be done.

92754.title: A New Need for Shadow Protection
92754.details: Our clanmates continue to venture further south, to and beyond the cursed Valley of Bones.$B$BDespite your standing with our clan, I do not trust you enough to share the details of their ventures. They would be boring to you anyway, outsider.$B$BWhat matters to you is our need for Greater Shadow Protection Potions, in bulk, to ensure their continued survival. Bring some to me, and I will put in a good word for you.
92754.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Greater Shadow Protection Potions to Mirda in the Magram Village in Desolace.

92755.title: Mysterious Mysticism
92755.details: With each passing day, our scavengers return with fewer and fewer armaments from fallen adventurers.$B$BWhile we cannot use these pieces directly, we do salvage them for scraps. The most magical of the armaments go to me, as I can disenchant them and make use of the mysterious remnants to enchant our weapons, particularly those of our windchasers.$B$BI am in need of Greater Mystic Essences if I am to supply our next raiding party with worthwhile equipment.
92755.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 3 Greater Mystic Essences to Halea in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92811.title: Economic Warfare
92811.details: Upon completion of this quest you will gain:$B$B750 reputation with Magram Clan Centaur

92812.title: Economic Warfare
92812.details: Long ago, all of the centaur clans in the Desolace agreed to trade in story. Specifically, carved totems that represent an individual or clan's great accomplishments. Despite the endless conflict, all clans continue to honor this tradition, even if trade opportunities between us have become few and far between.$B$BShould you collect any, such as from fallen centaur of other clans, bring them to me. The Gelkis can use more bartering power, and I will inform the Khan of your assistance.
92812.reward: I will add these to our collection. Our power grows thanks to your contributions, though we have a long way to go if we are to overcome the Magram Clan.

92814.title: I Need a Tailor
92814.details: My mate, Halea, is tasked with ensuring our armaments are empowered with appropriate magical energy.$B$BThe whole concept of enchanting is far beyond my understanding, but as the centaur whose job is to keep our village well supplied and equipped, I know that Halea is often behind on her duties--to no fault of her own.$B$BI would like to gift her some simple clothes to practice her craft on. I see some adventurers wandering through sandstorms with simple facemasks. Could you get me a few of those?
92814.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92817.title: Leather Technique
92817.details: Convincing my Gelkis clanmates to put on armor is nigh impossible, despite the numerous losses we have suffered with blades or bolts through the chest.$B$BI have been tasked with designing a vest that offers some reasonable protection, without the supposed 'itchiness' that they complain about. Supplies are scarce, so I dare not waste precious leather on junk.$B$BOutsider, would you bring me a harness fit to a brutish centaur? I would like to learn from your technique.
92817.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92818.title: Big, No, MASSIVE Iron Axes
92818.details: WE NEED MORE WEAPONS.$B$BMORE. WEAPONS.$B$BHOW ELSE IS THE MAGRAM GOING TO SMASH PUNY GELKIS?$B$BI WANT TO SEE WHAT YOU CAN MAKE, OUTSIDER. BRING ME AXES. BIG, NO, MASSIVE ONES.$B$BHURRY UP.
92818.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 2 Massive Iron Axes to Grolkar in the Magram Village in Desolace.

92819.title: Destruction in Deadmines
92819.details: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.
92819.reward: I don't know what to say, $N. To think that Stormwind would put their military ambitions over the livelihood of their people...

92834.title: Avenged Tenfold
92834.details: When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.$B$BA box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment.$B$BIt's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
92834.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
92834.request: The mark of a leader is the ability to admit when they were wrong. I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
92834.reward: The High Order prides ourselves in our pragmatism and logic, and logic dictates that the avoidance of conflict and loss of life is the most prudent option in most situations.$B$B<Elaadrin's eyes begin to glow and crackle with arcane energy.>$B$B...however, the cult mistook our prudence for weakness and they are not nearly ready to pay the cost of that error.

92840.title: Catching Wind
92840.details: Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.$B$BTake this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.$B$BShould any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840.objectives: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
92840.request: It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.$B$BThey see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?
92840.reward: It would not have been my preference to spill Windshaper blood but the blame for this pointless conflict rests solely on their shoulders. We sought to peacefully gather information, and they responded with violence.$B$BUnfortunately, word has spread and the Windshapers are already calling it a 'massacre'. They wouldn't dare to retaliate here in Valanaar, but they will certainly not forget.$B$B$N, you have been of tremendous aid to the High Order. Thank you.

92841.title: Valley of Bones
92841.details: It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it!$B$BHead south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul.$B$BYou will know when you get there.$BYou will know when you see him.$BIf he thinks you deserve to know, you will know.$B$BAnd if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown.
92841.objectives: Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.
92841.reward: So the rumors are true. Unfortunate that Warug has had you running around with frivolous tasks. At least you proved your worth.$B$BPeer down into the valley below, what do you see? Bones and bodies. Roaming undead. And the Twin Goliaths.$B$BThis place was cursed long before our arrival, and I suspect it will remain as such for many generations to come. Our clan was the first to brave the horrors below, and ours will be the only one to claim its power.$B$BAre you as eager as I to rule over all of Desolace?

92844.title: Mountain of Bones
92844.details: Some sort of necromantic energy has permeated throughout the Valley of Bones, for reasons we have yet to understand.$B$BThose reasons are also of no importance to us. The magic is ours now, and those who do not fight with blade or mallet are trained in this new magic.$B$BIf you think I intend to start you off with a challenging task, think again. For now, go into the Valley of Bones and fetch some bones for me. I am sure you can handle that.
92844.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 426 Gently Cursed Bones to Orgrul south of the Magram Village in Desolace.
92844.request: For every bone short you are for the task, I will take one of yours to make up the difference.
92844.reward: <Orgrul begins to count the bones, but begins to skip numbers as they gain a second digit and eventually loses count. He tries a second time, but glares your direction partway through when your expression contorts while observing.>$B$BBah. I will count them later. This looks like enough. You had best not be deceiving me.$B$BI will hold onto these.

92846.title: Outcast Necromancers
92846.details: Have you noticed the puny centaur stomping about around here? Those are of Gelkis descent.$B$BWe Magram have already established a foothold deeper into the canyon. When the Gelkis took notice of our presence here, some among them chose to follow in our footsteps. I know not whether they wish to join us or attempt to overthrow us, but I do know that their clanmates have sentenced them all to exile.$B$BThey're lone wolves meddling in powers that do not belong to them. I want them dead.
92846.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay Outcast Necromancers within the Valley of Bones.

92847.title: Corrupting Tears
92847.details: Outsider, did you notice the weapon that the outcast necromancers held in their hands? We will ensure the Gelkis will not live long enough to master the ways of necromancy, but their methods of channeling caught my interest. They even use those same crystals Warug asked you to steal.$B$BI think we can use this technique to our advantage. Venture back into the valley to recover some wood from the accursed trees, and see if Warug will part with some of his crystals. I will make staves from them.
92847.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Petrified Bark and 3 Imbued Tears back to Orgrul.

92849.title: The Missing Scholar
92849.reward: Th... thank you, stranger. I was walking down the road on my way back to Valanaar when a looming shadow appeared overhead. I turned to look and saw a massive, terrible beast bearing down at me from the sky. I tried to run, but I was hit hard and the world went black.$B$BI think its fair to say that if you hadn't come along, I'd have been dinner for that beast and its young.

92850.title: The Missing Scholar
92850.details: I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!$B$BAfter it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.
92850.objectives: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.
92850.reward: Well, I confess that I am intensely relieved that Fillion has returned to us. He never was good at minding his surroundings. Always too busy lost in thought, or with his nose in a book.$B$BThank you, $C.

92860.title: In Service of Zephras
92860.details: The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.$B$BReport to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860.objectives: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92860.reward: I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good mage and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.$B$BYou seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.

92867.title: Ground to Keep
92867.details: Our heritage may be crumbling, but this is not our final redoubt. We have more in reserve, and it must remain hidden for its own protection.$B$BSupport grows for preserving our remaining sculptures and sacred burial grounds. The rabble that have taken up residence in our old kingdom have no notion of the vengeance coming for them.$B$BDrive back the Boulderfist and Syndicate. They must learn Stromgarde is not merely fist, eagle, and stones.
92867.objectives: Defeat the Boulderfist, Syndicate, and Witherbark intruders in Stromgarde Keep and return to Groundskeeper Lomar.

92871.title: In Service of Zephras
92871.details: Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.$B$BReport to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871.objectives: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92871.reward: You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.

92872.title: Dutiful Steps
92872.details: We eternally guard this tomb and the knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor these fallen souls.$B$BNow that you've descended three levels below the earth, you take your first steps toward returning to the sunlit world with sacred wisdom.$B$BEach season, we carry some of the dust from this tomb and spread it to the oceans of Azeroth. A symbolic act of renewing cycles.$B$BTake this small satchel. Travel to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast it into the sea.
92872.objectives: Throw the Pouch of Tomb Dust into The Great Sea and return to Caretaker Alaric in the Stromgarde Keep crypt.$B$BProvided item:

92873.title: Proof of Concept
92873.details: We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons.$B$BOrgrul hands you a newly made staff.>$B$BI will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it.
92873.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, then bring 426 Well Cursed Bones from a successful ritual back to Orgrul.$B$BProvided item:

92880.title: Return to Valanaar
92880.details: I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.$B$BI can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.$B$BMay the four winds bless you, $C.
92880.objectives: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92880.reward: <Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>$B$BThank the winds.

92881.title: The High Elder's Request
92881.details: The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.$B$BPlease speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881.objectives: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92881.reward: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.

92893.title: No Mercy for the Weak
92893.details: As you tread further into the Valley of Bones, you will find Gelkis wanderers that dared to enter our territory. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive.$B$BThis task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom.
92893.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and slay 5 Gelkis Captives scattered around the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul after the task is complete.

92894.title: Bone Raising
92894.details: I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?$B$BOf course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.$B$BAs you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.$B$BI have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
92894.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.$B$BProvided item:

92909.title: Harvesting the Harvesters
92909.details: Oh no... I'm in for it now!$B$BI heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!$B$BIf I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
92909.objectives: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.
92909.request: It's a mess out there, $N! Did you collect the parts I need?
92909.reward: Thanks a bunch! I'll get to work on an escape plan. In the meantime, take this!

92910.title: Harvesting the Harvesters
92910.details: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
92910.objectives: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.

92911.title: Harvesting the Harvesters
92911.details: I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.$B$BI'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?
92911.objectives: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.
92911.reward: Here it is, Raton! Should work great. Go give it a try!$B$B...Me? No, I'll stay here. It's starting to feel like home, anyway.

92947.title: Making Our Move
92947.details: Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.$B$BIf all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.$B$BWinds guide you, $C.
92947.objectives: Slay 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 7 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
92947.reward: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.

93034.title: Valley of Bones
93034.details: One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.$B$BThe Magram are up to something, $N. It is not good.$B$BThe Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.$B$BSeek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.
93034.objectives: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.

93035.title: Ravaging Ravagers
93035.details: You need not peer far to see the undead shambling about ahead of us, but have you noticed something unusual about them?$B$BThey walk on two legs, not four! These skeletons are not even our fallen kin. The Magram must be defiling the bodies of those who died long before the Desolace was our domain. I cannot imagine how they justified turning their backs on Mother Theradras and took to desecrating corpses that have rested here for centuries.$B$BPut the undead to rest, $N.
93035.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan and slay 6 Undead Ravagers, then return to Nerlokh at the southern entrance to Valley of Bones.

93036.title: Infiltrating the Cult
93036.details: You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.$B$BYou are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
93036.objectives: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
93036.reward: Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir?$B$BThere is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant.

93037.title: Outing Outcasts
93037.details: While I waited for your arrival, I peered a bit further between the arches and noticed something I need you to confirm for me.$B$BI cannot bear saying it aloud. Not until my suspicions have been proven true.$B$B$N, while you are getting your bearings in the valley, slay some of the necromancers that look weaker than the others. Tear off their ritual garb, carefully, and bring it to me. I must know whether I am of clear mind and vision.
93037.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring 1 Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.

93041.title: Facing the Truth
93041.details: This discovery is devastating for our clan, but it is in our best interest to keep this only to those who need to know. Uthek is one such person who needs to be aware of what is going on here. I suspect she will know how to proceed.$B$BTake this to show her. For good measure, we should also bring evidence of the necromancy itself to her. Find a skull that looks recently cursed. I suspect they may be hoarding them in the maws of one of the goliath's skeletons.
93041.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

93044.title: A Cleansing Cry
93044.details: When you return to Nerlokh in the Valley of Bones, it will not be empty-handed.$B$BGo inside the cave at the heart of our village and seek out Mulara. Ask for Tears of Theradras on my behalf. Our supply is low, but it is our best hope against the Magram's foul necromancy!$B$BI will prepare a ritual. We will create a weapon to disrupt their spells.
93044.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring Tears of Theradras back to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

93045.title: Test Your Theory
93045.details: I have placed the skull you provided alongside several bones I found while awaiting your return. Immediately I saw a sickly light spread from the skull and claim those old bones as its own. I see now why the call of necromancy is so hard to resist.$B$BDo you remember this crystal? It is draenethyst. I know little of its potential, but I believe it can channel Theradras' power. With it, perhaps you can dispel the curse.$B$BThe ritual site can be found by the pond just east of the village.
93045.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and dispel the necromantic curse present on the Accursed Skull. Once successful, report back to Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones.$B$BProvided item:

93058.title: Saving Our Own
93058.details: There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside.$B$B$N, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly.$B$BYou must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together.
93058.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue 5 Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.

93062.title: Bone Burying
93062.details: About this staff of yours. I recognize it as one of Uthek's, and you mentioned it was constructed with Theradras' Tears, augmented with a Draenethyst Crystal, and that it can dispel dark magic?$B$BI noticed that there are skeletons stuck just underneath the rocky soil further into the valley. I believe these are failed summons from the Outcast Necromancers, doomed perhaps forever to an existence smothered in dirt.$B$BLaying them to rest again would be good for our cause, and their spirits.
93062.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and dispel the curses from 8 failed summons throughout the Valley of Bones.$B$BProvided item:

93065.title: Prepare for Battle
93065.details: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065.objectives: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93065.reward: We are as ready as we'll ever be.

93066.title: Bristleback Retreat
93066.details: On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.$B$BThis task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.
93066.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat. Then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front on the other side of Valley of Bones in Desolace.

93072.title: Long-Term Solutions
93072.details: There is a second centaur village out here, to the southwest. That one belongs to the Gelkis. You expect me to send you over just to spill some blood, right? Good. That had best be your first thought, else I would cast doubt on your allegiance to the Magram!$B$BWhat are you waiting for? Go! Kill!
93072.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram clan and slay 2 Outcast Scouts, 6 Outcast Marauders, and 8 Outcast Necromancers then return to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

93089.title: What Comes Next
93089.details: Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.$B$BI can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, this mission will be all the stronger for it.$B$BWinds be with you, $N.
93089.objectives: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
93089.reward: It gladdens me to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.$B$BAnsirem has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between the city of Dalaran and Zephras Isle. We've done as much testing as we can, and the time has come for vanguard to depart.

93090.title: What Comes Next
93090.details: Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.$B$BI can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.$B$BWinds be with you, $N.
93090.objectives: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.
93090.reward: I'm pleased to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.$B$BMuln has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between Zephras Isle and a place called Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring make their home. We've been doing test voyages and some of our people are already waiting on the other side.

93122.title: Checking Things Out
93122.details: We have all underestimated the power and presence of the Magram clan in this area, but this could prove an advantage.$B$BWith so many of their own distracted and their refusal to accept other clans' exiles, who is left to defend the village? What of their Khan?$B$BI need you to go into the valley, deeper than you have gone before, and look around. If the Magram are as well fortified here as they seem, they may have left themselves vulnerable at their village...
93122.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and investigate centaur points of interest within Shen'dralas. Then return to Nerlokh at the entrance of Valley of Bones with your findings.

93125.title: Going Home
93125.details: You! I saw you outside fighting the outcasts. I know not where you come from, but I need your help.$B$BI was lured here by my Gelkis brethren with an assurance of safety. I knew the war in the Desolace was escalating beyond our control, but I never imagined my own people turning to necromancy in a convoluted bid to defect to the Magram clan. When I spoke out against this, they threatened to kill me if I ever stepped hoof outside this tent!$B$BPlease help.
93125.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway. Then inform Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones about what happened.

93128.title: Khan Jehn
93128.details: As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.$B$BI believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.$B$BBut $N, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
93128.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.

93129.title: Threat of Starvation
93129.details: Since you seem overly eager to help our clan, I am sure you would be willing to fetch some supplies while you are over in the Outcast Hideaway.$B$BFelling our foes should be enough motivation for a Magram, but I see no reason why we could not profit from the endeavor, too.$B$BWhen we have the exiles dealt with, we can secure this place for the Magram and raise an army to bring the other clans to their knees!
93129.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 6 Stolen Supplies back to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

93159.title: The Strange Hermit
93159.details: Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.$B$B<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>$B$BSo er, um... how is your day going?
93159.objectives: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
93159.reward: ...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.$B$BI have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.

93160.title: The Forest's Bounty
93160.details: I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!$B$BSo if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160.objectives: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
93160.request: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!
93160.reward: Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted!$B$BPlease excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.

93165.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears
93165.details: The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.$B$BI have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93165.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
93165.request: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.
93165.reward: Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.$B$BI suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears bring them here.

93172.title: Free the Hollows
93172.details: Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.$B$BAt the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.$B$BI'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172.objectives: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.
93172.request: We can only hope that those poor spirits are able to find peace after being freed from this place.

93173.title: (UNUSED) The Rusty Gadget
93173.objectives: Return the Rusty Gadget to The Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest

93176.title: My Little Friends
93176.details: Admiring my little menagerie, are you? They are my un-life's work. I've spent countless hours studying them: their anatomy, their diets, even their social rituals.$B$BDo you wish to join me in the hobby? Here, take this package. The notes and materials contained within should get you started. If you lose it, you'll have to purchase another one from me for a small fee.
93176.objectives: Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.$B$BProvided item:
93176.request: I must say though, there's nothing like the thrill of finding new specimens. I used to delight in scrounging for them through all manner of muck and grime, but I rarely get the opportunity these days.$B$BIn that sense, my little brood is both a blessing and a curse. Because they require so much attention, I cannot travel beyond the swamp.
93176.reward: These are simply delightful! Look at the forelegs on this one! The coloring of this one's carapace! Oh, and this one's mandibles!$B$BI didn't take you for an entomologist, but you have quite a keen eye.$B$BPlease, take this. I think he might have taken a liking to you, and I've already catalogued this particular species.$B$BNow, if you'll excuse me, I must return to my research. You've given me much to study!

93188.title: Return to Orgrul
93188.details: You have done enough on the front lines. We can handle ourselves.$B$BTell Orgrul that you have served your purpose. The Magram Front is stronger now, and we have our sights set on the outcast encampment as our next settlement when another fleet of fighters joins the fray.$B$BWell? Get going!
93188.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and report back to Orgrul near the northern entrance to Valley of Bones.

93196.title: Khan Jehn
93196.details: The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan.$B$BYou can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis.$B$BDo you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider?$B$B<Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.>$B$BThis is why.
93196.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn. The ritual site can be found in a tent at the central lake of Magram Village.$B$BProvided item:

93224.title: Carved Centaur Totems
93224.details: It likely comes as no surprise to you that both of the centaur clans are hesitant to accept aid from anyone outside of their clan. This is especially true for folks like you and me - you know, non-centaurs.$B$BOne thing we all have in common is an understanding that money is power, and we have learned that the local centaur barter with carved wood. If you bring me a few samples of their designs, I can put in a rush order for similar etchings. Perhaps we can buy ourselves an advantage.
93224.objectives: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.

93225.title: Carved Centaur Totems
93225.details: I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.$B$BI believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225.objectives: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
93225.request: Have you returned with the totems?
93225.reward: These are beautiful--I underestimated the creativity of the centaur. I never would have imagined that a race so full of brutality and cruelty would be able to appreciate stories told through carvings.$B$BI suppose appreciating them takes way less effort than crafting them. Let me rephrase: I never would have imagined the centaur to be patient enough to carve out so many tales in wood. Where are they getting the wood?$B$BIn any case, speak to me when you are ready to make your delivery.

93226.title: Buying Friendship: Magram
93226.details: Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.$B$BI sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.$B$BBring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.
93226.objectives: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.

93227.title: Buying Friendship: Gelkis
93227.details: At first glance, I would wager that the Gelkis are struggling. Their numbers are far fewer than the Magram, and I rarely hear of them stomping around from our scouts.$B$BNonetheless, they are one of the dominant clans in the Desolace and survive to this day. They must be doing something right.$B$BIf you want to make peace with the Gelkis, take this tote of totems with you to Gelkis Village far to the southwest. Primitive as they may be, they are likely to have a treasurer of some kind.
93227.objectives: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.

93317.title: Crab Season
93317.details: Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.$B$BWith all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.$B$BDo be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
93317.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
93317.request: Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.$B$BNot been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.
93317.reward: Winds bless me this meat looks fantastic!$B$BThank you so much, $C.

93318.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable
93318.details: By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.$B$BDeliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318.objectives: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
93318.request: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.
93318.reward: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.

93319.title: Pilfered Windstones
93319.details: We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.$B$BWe've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.$B$BIf you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319.objectives: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.
93319.request: These sneakthieves have likely been breaking into our supplies for months. I tried to convince Aonda to put a raid together to clear out that bandit cave for good, but she didn't want to pull the few peacekeepers we have away from the village.$B$BWith the cultists at Falaath Village to the south growing in numbers, I suppose I can't fault her for that.
93319.reward: Thanks $C. This should help us get by for now. If we can't get the supply routes squared away soon though, a few stolen windstones will be the least of our worries.

93320.title: Tower Defense
93320.details: I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.$B$BPlease leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.$B$BMy lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.
93320.objectives: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93320.reward: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.

93429.title: Blood of My Blood
93429.details: Although they are our kin, the Lost Ones of Fallow Sanctuary have become beings of pure violence and hatred.$B$BThere can be no redemption or salvation for them. They are doomed to wander this swamp as mindless, hateful creatures for all their lives.$B$BTheir suffering must end. Someone must put them out of their misery. A grisly task, I know, but would you do it to protect those of us who remain?
93429.objectives: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.

93430.title: Taking the Bait Back
93430.details: Now they've really done it! As if those wretches weren't already enough to deal with, one of them has stolen my lucky lure!$B$BI was just out fishing this morning, when one came up out of the muck, cut my line, and ran off with it. The thief is almost certainly one of the Lost Ones' own fishermen, hoping to use the lure themselves.$B$BWell, our supply of fish depends on that lure, so I need it back. The Lost Ones fish along the banks east of here. Find that thief, $R!
93430.objectives: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.

93459.title: More Al'Aketh Ears
93459.details: The Al'Aketh cult normally gives this forest a wide berth, fearing the rumors that it is haunted... rumors we are happy to maintain. The Druids of my order wish only to live quiet, peaceful lives here in Shadowgale and they threaten that.$B$BMany among us are afraid.$B$BI come with an offer. Fight the cultists for us, and bring us the ears of those you kill. We will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to our secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93459.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands and return them to Vayn Moonclaw in Shadowgale Forest.
93459.reward: As promised, here is your reward.

93461.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
93461.details: You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.$B$BOh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
93461.objectives: Speak with Rathiril Sunlance and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
93461.reward: Checked in with Rathiril then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Well, at least in the village anyway. What happens out in the wilds stays in the wilds.$B$BNow that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands. I've got a few things that need doing, if you are game for a bit of work?

93464.title: The Visiting Mage
93464.details: Allow me to admit something, $N. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.$B$BI recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands.$B$BAt the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.$B$BI ask that you find this mage, $R. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.
93464.objectives: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.

93465.title: Notes on Draenethyst
93465.details: I suppose it would be more accurate to say I know someone who knows a thing or two about draenethyst.$B$BYou see, the warlocks of the Burning Blade have been studying it. It is a substance from beyond the dark portal, so it follows that those involved with darker arts might wish to harness it to their own ends. We cannot allow this, obviously.$B$BThe specific warlock you seek is named Gimashi. She can be found atop her tower, which is in a ravine to the southeast. Her notes will have the answers you seek.
93465.objectives: Take Gimashi's notes on Draenethyst, and bring them back to Azore Aldamort.

93552.title: Harvesting Windstones
93552.details: Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the Windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.$B$BYou'll find raw Windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
93552.objectives: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
93552.reward: Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade.$B$Bwindstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.

93585.title: This Light of Mine
93585.details: Oh thank goodness, someone civilized!$B$BI came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all!$B$BHowever, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, $C?
93585.objectives: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage.

93663.title: Lost in Transit
93663.details: The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.$B$BI'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.$B$BMore importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.
93663.objectives: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.

93678.title: Abridged Notes on Draenethyst
93678.details: I've prepared a transcription of Gimashi's notes on draenethyst. It appears the shards possess some degree of energy, but a pure sphere of the stuff is vastly more powerful. That seems to be what the Burning Blade was after.$B$BMany of Gimashi's notes allude to portals and demonic summoning rituals. Portals to where, or to summon which demons, I cannot say for sure.$B$BWhile my answers are not definitive, please take these notes back to the swamp with you. I hope you'll understand if I don't come along.
93678.objectives: Take Azore's transcribed notes back to Magtoor at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

93680.title: Key to the City
93680.details: The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.$B$BThat is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!$B$BWhile in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680.objectives: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
93680.request: What have you found? An ancient tome? A secret relic?
93680.reward: A sewer key? Well, thankfully I am not the one who will be using this.$B$BBut we have work to do before it's safe to use this.

93735.title: The Broken Construct
93735.details: Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.$B$BOne of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.
93735.objectives: Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
93735.reward: <Riaani's face is buried under the heaving armor plates of the construct, attempting to work on the mechanisms underneath. He does not notice your presence at all.>$B$BStorms curse where is the core?! Who thought it would be a good idea to remove the Gyrozephyr as well? It's a miracle this construct's winds haven't dissipated entirely by now!

93736.title: Unwelcome Spirits
93736.details: The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.$B$BI need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736.objectives: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
93736.request: Shadowgale Forest is a dangerous place. Some even say its haunted. I'm quite sure that I don't believe that, but I do know that its not for the faint hearted, or the unprepared.
93736.reward: Handling these essences fills me with a sense of... deep disquiet. I can almost feel a malevolent, regretful aura emanating from them. It's enough to make me faint.$B$B<Endaria shudders slightly.>$B$BI do not look forward to studying these further.

93737.title: The Broken Construct
93737.details: Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then.$B$BNot sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.
93737.objectives: Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.
93737.request: I can't imagine why anyone would want to steal these components from this construct. Other than the gyrozephyr these components have almost no practical application. Even the gyro would be nigh-useless outside of its intended purpose.
93737.reward: Thank you for scavenging these materials. I imagine that some of this wasn't terribly easy to get.$B$BWith these parts I can get the construct up and running again. From there we can just hope that its memory is intact and it can tell us who took its components.

93738.title: The Broken Construct
93738.details: Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?$B$BThe High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.$B$BI think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.
93738.objectives: Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
93738.reward: Very interesting, so it was the High Order that was responsible for the construct breaking down?$B$BI know Belathaan. He's Valennia Stormfist's cousin and his mother was actually a Windshaper. It's disappointing that he was involved in this.$B$BI need to reflect on this for a moment.

93739.title: Exploring the Horde
93739.details: Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.$B$BIf you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.
93739.objectives: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
93739.reward: So you have returned. I hope that you learned much in your journey.$B$BIt is my understanding that your people are still establishing themselves in Mulgore. While you wait for them, I'd encourage you to explore the territory around Orgrimmar. The Barrens in particular is always in need of eager adventurers like yourself.

93740.title: Blood for Blood
93740.details: A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.$B$BHead north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.
93740.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93740.request: The Al'Aketh have engaged in their bloody zealotry for far too long. This is only the start of the reckoning they face.
93740.reward: <Ayessa looks shaken and distant as you hand her the windstone charms.>$B$BDon't mind me, $N. Today has merely been... a trying day. Thank you for your service to the windshapers thus far.

93746.title: A Firm Response
93746.details: The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.$B$BBelathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.
93746.objectives: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
93746.reward: Wait--what?! Belathaan... is dead?$B$B<Ayessa listens as you give your account of what occurred.>$B$BThe High Order was meeting with the Al'Aketh to discuss peace? There is no peace with the cult, they are murderous zealots. What was Elaadrin thinking sending Belathaan to treat with them alone?$B$BPay this no mind, $N. You are not at fault for this. The arrogance of the High Order is to blame, yet again. You were merely in the right place at the wrong time.

93791.title: Speak with Belann
93791.details: $N, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.$B$BSeek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.
93791.objectives: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93791.reward: Ah, you must be $N? It is heartening to see young mages eager to learn our ways and history. Come, I will explain the next steps to crafting your spell focus.

93797.title: Boughs in the Wind
93797.details: It is a time-honored tradition for young mages to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.$B$BI have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.
93797.objectives: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93797.request: Every year that passes in Zephras sees fewer and fewer of those who are gifted with a talent for magic.$B$BI am glad to see young mages such as yourself participate in our oldest traditions to help keep our history and culture alive and well.
93797.reward: Thank you, $N. I can indeed feel the elemental energies in this bough waiting to be harnessed by those that have the gift to do so. This will make an excellent spell focus.$B$BDid this branch sing to you, perhaps? It has often been the case that the branch picks the $C, and not the other way around.

93835.title: Confront Lorthuna
93835.details: Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.$B$BI'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.$B$BUnless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $C.
93835.objectives: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.
93835.reward: I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.$B$BAnsirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.

93836.title: The Fate of Zephras
93836.details: Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.$B$BHigh Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
93836.objectives: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93836.reward: <Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Ayessa's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>$B$BI need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet and on the timeline of elemental gods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.$B$BThere is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

93862.title: Crate Return
