93862.details: Upon completion of this quest you will gain:$B$B50 reputation with Durotar Supply and Logistics50 reputation with Azeroth Commerce Authority

93926.title: The Western Watch
93926.details: Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.$B$BI'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.$B$BPeacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!
93926.objectives: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.
93926.reward: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, its clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>

93927.title: A Last Request
93927.details: bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>
93927.objectives: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.
93927.request: What news from the western watch?
93927.reward: So they are all dead, then. Storms curse on these cult bastards!$B$BWhile you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.$B$BI have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?

93948.title: Deliver the Signet
93948.details: Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.$B$BHe will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.
93948.objectives: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93948.request: What is that you have for me? Oh... oh no.
93948.reward: I... am very sorry to hear that my nephew is dead. I thank you kindly for recovering this, and bringing it to me.$B$BIt's not common that such capable young shen'dorei come down from the highlands. If you need work, please speak with Valennia Stormfist, the captain of the peacekeepers here in Valanaar. These days we need all the help we can get.

93949.title: Bugged
93949.details: We've been bugged.$B$BIt's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.$B$BWe suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.
93949.objectives: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.
93949.reward: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.

93951.title: A Little Beauty
93951.details: The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.$B$BIf you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
93951.objectives: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.
93951.request: What beautiful things did you bring me?
93951.reward: It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible.$B$BIf one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.

93958.title: The Inner Sanctum
93958.details: Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.$B$BI'll stay here and watch your back.
93958.objectives: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.

93963.title: Exploring the Alliance
93963.details: Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn.$B$BSpeak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963.objectives: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
93963.reward: Ah, you are back.$B$BI hope your adventures have given you a sense of the scale and wonder of our world. I know it must seem overwhelming to you, but if you are to help your people, you must be prepared for whatever may come your way while you are on Azeroth.$B$BWhile you wait for your order to establish itself in Dalaran, I suggest you turn your attention to the lands around Stormwind. Westfall in particular can always use more strong adventurers to lend them aid, if you are willing.

94003.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark
94003.details: I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.$B$BThe only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.$B$BZaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003.objectives: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
94003.reward: You have done what I could not and restored my family honor. For this, I will bestow a gift that few on Zephras are worthy to receive. I will teach out the secrets of the Skybreaker Defense.$B$BAlso, you will need a shield to put what I have to teach you into practice. Please, take this one. I have little use for it now that the Skybreaker Bulwark has been returned to me.$B$BBanu'Adoraah, friend.

94004.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength
94004.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94004.reward: You brought da elixir!!$B$BT'anks, $R. You come all this way to help Sos'mol. No ogre ever done that before.$B$BSos'mol will remember this. Pay you back someday. Me promise.

94006.title: The Great Ursera Spirit
94006.details: Greetings, $N. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.$B$BTo find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
94006.objectives: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.
94006.reward: So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak.

94007.title: Taming the Beast
94007.details: Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.$B$BGo to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.
94007.objectives: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94007.reward: I am most glad that you came. Come, let us begin.

94013.title: Taming the Beast
94013.details: You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead.$B$BTake this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery.$B$BComplete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.
94013.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94013.request: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $C.
94013.reward: Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.$B$BGo with this knowledge and thrive. Be the $C that Zephras Isle needs you to be.

94050.title: Training the Beast
94050.details: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet.$B$BGo with the winds, young $C.
94050.objectives: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
94050.reward: A fledgling $C, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.$B$BRemember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.

94212.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Wisdom
94212.details: Elixir of Wisdom, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94212.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94212.request: Come, warm yourself by the fire.
94212.reward: I will admit, I expected the treacherous winds of the highlands to tear that letter to shreds. I had not imagined that someone would see my humble request, let alone deliver it straight to me.$B$BYour efforts are kind and admirable, $R. I will use this to aid my meditation.$B$BFeel free to stay and share a tale or two of your travels. I enjoy the company.

94213.title: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Mana Potion
94213.details: Lesser Mana Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94213.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94213.request: Good day, $R. I appreciate the company but my attention is elsewhere. If we do not have business, please be on your way.
94213.reward: Ah, is this the potion I requested?$B$B<The elven woman respectfully takes the vial from you.>$B$BYour arrival is timely, and generosity deeply appreciated. I accept this, and offer you a small token of my gratitude.$B$BThank you, may we meet again.

94214.title: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Protection Potion
94214.details: Shadow Protection Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94214.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94214.request: Heyo, for future reference, you shouldn't come charging at full-speed toward a goblin with a bodyguard! You never know what might happen.
94214.reward: Then again, when you're fulfilling a rush order like this one, I can't blame you for wanting to capitalize on your gains.$B$BHere you go, pal. Thanks for hooking a goblin up with some much-needed shadow protection potions. Have you SEEN the stuff that goes on out here?

94215.title: Craftsman's Writ: Free Action Potion
94215.details: Free Action Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94215.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94215.request: <You approach a thrashing creature clearly trapped in spider silk, exactly where the writ marked on the map.>
94215.reward: <You waste little time offering the wiggling mass the Free Action Potion that was requested. It seems either unaware of your presence, or unable to claim the item.$B$BA handful of coins are scattered just beside the cocoon. You may decide to leave the potion there, and take the coins for yourself. Nature will surely sort itself out, in that case.>

94216.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Lesser Agility
94216.details: Elixir of Lesser Agility, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94216.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94216.request: Are you here about...$B$B<Ziz looks around his tiny hut suspiciously, and lowers his voice.>$B$BThe elixir?
94216.reward: <Ziz continues to talk in a hushed tone.>$B$BI'm not about to give you the whole spiel about how I got into this position, but here's some advice for you.$B$BSometimes, all you gotta do to impress your new boss is take credit for someone else's work. So you're going to hand over the elixir, and I am gonna talk about how much blood, sweat, and tears I poured into making it.$B$BIt's a new gig, okay? I need to make a good first impression!

94217.title: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir
94217.details: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94217.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94217.request: Yarr, you be bringin' me my elixir?
94217.reward: Exactly what Short John Mithril ordered!$B$BHere's ye' coin. I'd keep it clutched to your chest as ye' scuttle out of here, the arena combatants thirst for riches as much as they thirst for blood!

94218.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Defense
94218.details: Elixir of Defense, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94218.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94218.request: If YOU are the assassin that the crewmen keep warning me about, well you had better think twice before charging at ME, buster!
94218.reward: Oh, oh!! The elixir!$B$BMy, oh my. I am so sorry to have lashed out at you like that. I've been on edge ever since I was told that one of those goblins has supposedly put out a hit on me!$B$BSadly I cannot afford additional security, so the best I can do is chug one of these and hope for the best. Cheers!

94219.title: Craftsman's Writ: Draught of Water Breathing
94219.details: Draught of Water Breathing, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94219.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

94220.title: Craftsman's Writ: Pearl-Handled Dagger
94220.details: Pearl-Handled Dagger, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94220.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94220.request: It is unwise to sneak up on me, $R. Speak quickly, and speak quietly.
94220.reward: Oh, you are delivering my dagger? Hah, I suppose my threat rang quite hollow then, hm?$B$BI must stay on high alert given my duties here, and especially with oth-- ahem, the foul Syndicate roaming about elsewhere here.$B$BWould you be so kind as to part with the blade, now? I must get back to my task.

94221.title: Craftsman's Writ: Golden Rod
94221.details: Golden Rod, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94221.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94221.request: <The dwarf seems to be in a deep state of meditation, though your approach interrupted his focus. Fortunately, a smile greets you.>
94221.reward: Ah, the Golden Rod I requested. I never expected it to arrive. I was considering going back to Ironforge to purchase one off the auction house. You saved me a trip, something these old feet greatly thank you for.$B$BI do not yet know how I can use this to commune with the Binding Stones, let alone if I even can, but I suspect this brings me one step closer.$B$BIn the worst case, well, I am happy to have a new cane.

94222.title: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer
94222.details: Iridescent Hammer, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94222.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

94223.title: Craftsman's Writ: Silver Skeleton Key
94223.details: Silver Skeleton Key, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94223.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94223.request: <After following the instructions on the writ, you find yourself deep in a crypt surrounded by undead. There is a note on a nearby trunk.>$B$BWhomever first reads this will be the first to learn of my death. I am a mere caretaker of the Raven Hill Cemetery, whose presence is largely forgotten by even his employers at Darkshire. I have no heir with which to bestow my vast wealth unto. I have since stashed them away, in this box, for who or whatever manages to open it.
94223.reward: <With the undead hordes endlessly gathering nearby and no sign of others, you choose to make use of your Silver Skeleton Key to effortlessly open the chest.$B$BDespite the claims of impressive riches, the trunk is nearly empty. At the very least there is enough present to cover some of the cost of this ordeal.>

94224.title: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Bronze Mace
94224.details: Heavy Bronze Mace, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94224.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94224.request: Shh. Keep your voice down. I'm not ready for a fight, yet.
94224.reward: Whoa. You came well prepared! Hope that mace is for me, unless you plan to do ALL of the fighting.

94225.title: Craftsman's Writ: Rough Bronze Leggings
94225.details: Rough Bronze Leggings, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94225.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94225.reward: These are the leggings I ordered, huh? "Three to five business days," they said. More like three to five business MONTHS!$B$BI submitted this when I was working for the Venture Co out there, and let me just say, that partnership is well over with, so we can consider this order expired.$B$BWhy aren't you leaving yet? Ugh, fine! Here's your payment.

94226.title: Craftsman's Writ: Green Iron Gauntlets
94226.details: Green Iron Gauntlets, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94226.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94226.reward: Mmph. Seems to have been a severe mistranslation. I did not ask for green iron gauntlets, I specifically requested green iron knuckles.$B$B<MacKinley fakes an uppercut in your direction, stopping himself a small but calculated distance from cracking your jaw.>$B$BThese'll knock someone out cold anyway, I suppose I can use these while I wait for a replacement.$B$BHere's your payment. Oh, you expected more? Well, so did I.

94227.title: Craftsman's Writ: Big Bronze Knife
94227.details: Big Bronze Knife, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94227.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94227.reward: Cluck? CLUCK CLUCK! BWOK!$B$B<The chicken glares menacingly toward Magus Tirth from afar, newly acquired blade in beak.>

94228.title: Craftsman's Writ: Green Iron Boots
94228.details: Green Iron Boots, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94228.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94228.request: Please tell me you're the one with the boots...
94228.reward: At last! I've been stomping around the wetlands with soggy feet for days!$B$BHopefully these aren't prone to rusting either. I trust you know what you're doing.

94229.title: Craftsman's Writ: Ornate Spyglass
94229.details: Ornate Spyglass, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94229.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94229.request: Whoa! I almost didn't see you there. I might have seen you coming sooner if a damned engineer would at last deliver my order.
94229.reward: Oh. Oh! You're the engineer? I suppose at the very least you are the delivery boy in any case.$B$BPlease hand over the spyglass. I have little time and many things to inspect.

94230.title: Craftsman's Writ: Explosive Sheep
94230.details: Explosive Sheep, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94230.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

94231.title: Craftsman's Writ: Moonsight Rifle
94231.details: Moonsight Rifle, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94231.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94231.request: Hey, HEY, man, haven't you heard of a little thing called "subtlety"? Spell it out with me, S-U-B...LETY. You're going to blow my cover!
94231.reward: Ohoho, I take it back. Look at this beautiful boomstick. I bet it'll knock a satyr's head clean off.$B$BThanks pal, now step aside or you're going to get caught in the crossfire.

94232.title: Craftsman's Writ: Minor Recombobulator
94232.details: Minor Recombobulator, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94232.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94232.reward: I don't know what I expected when I sent out an order for a curse dispelling device, but this Minor Recon--Racom--ugh, Minor Whatchamacallit sure ain't it!$B$BLook, I know how complicated the refund process is and I do NOT have time for that. It's way easier for us both if I just take this off your hands, and I'll be more specific with my next order.$B$BFor both of our sakes, let's hope you don't screw that one up too!

94233.title: Craftsman's Writ: Practice Lock
94233.details: Practice Lock, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94233.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94233.request: I watched this whole place get burned to the ground and that keep toppled over. It was glorious.$B$BNever expected a group of bandits try to use this place as a base of operations.
94233.reward: Ahh, my practice lock has arrived.$B$BThe Syndicate here have been plotting to turn this place into a prison like it once was. I already know that at least one orc is currently being held here. Maybe more. I don't intend to be another, but I intend to be more prepared than the last time if they catch me off guard.

94234.title: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Goggles
94234.details: Shadow Goggles, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94234.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94234.reward: My new shadow goggles!$B$B<Without another word, the goblin tossed a handful of coins your way with one hand while the other swiped the item out of your grasp. The transaction was completed and his attention lost before you had a moment to process what happened.>

94235.title: Craftsman's Writ: Gnomish Universal Remote
94235.details: Gnomish Universal Remote, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94235.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94235.request: Careful where you walk, $N! This thing likes to activate when you least expect it, and we don't quite have a handle on where it can take you when we aren't actively manning the controls.
94235.reward: Seems we are in luck, the remote has arrived! Looks like you precalibrated it for us which, I'll admit, isn't ideal for this scenario.$B$BI should be able to reverse engineer it in no time. Then maybe, hopefully, I'll be able to take a much needed break. Feels like I've been stuck fumbling with this teleporter's controls for months on end!

94236.title: Craftsman's Writ: Big Bronze Bomb
94236.details: Big Bronze Bomb, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

It's half the reason I haven't left this wretched place yet!$B$BThe other half being that I still have profits to make.$B$B<Kixxle greedily rubs his hands.>

94238.reward: Wut dis? Dis the ball me was dreaming of?$B$BYou, $R, give ball to me?$B$BDis is happiest day of ogre life... Dis so much more important than... uhh... what was da other thing me wanted?$B$BNo remember. Ball most important now.$B$BT'anks!!

Ah, I realized shortly after writing this that I needed a full set of clothes - new overalls included.$B$BIf it will get you out of my hair, I suppose I should honor the request. 94369.title: The Fate of Zephras
94369.details: Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.$B$BHigh Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
94369.objectives: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
94369.reward: <Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>$B$BI need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.$B$BThere is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

94373.title: Call of Earth
94373.details: Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.$B$BBut to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.$B$BBring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373.objectives: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94373.request: Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys - slow and stubborn, like a true $R. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole.$B$BOthers may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.
94373.reward: Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. Strength, stamina, patience. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares.$B$BI'll craft ye a sapta now - accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.

94374.title: Call of Earth
94374.details: Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few shaman know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.$B$BHead north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374.objectives: Find the Spirit Stone and drink the Earth Sapta.$B$BProvided item:
94374.reward: Ah... $N... the earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence.$B$BTo pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still - they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.

94375.title: Call of Earth
94375.details: Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.$B$BBe patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375.objectives: Bring the Rough Quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94375.request: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
94375.reward: Well done! Know this - totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements. As ye grow wiser, more o' the mountain's power will open to ye. The trainers will know when yer ready for more. But for now, take this totem, and let the ground speak through ye.

94411.title: Meddlesome Mages
94411.details: Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.$B$BI am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
94411.objectives: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
94411.reward: Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy.$B$BThe mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.

94413.title: A Magical Affront
94413.details: The recent emergence of the ley lines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.$B$BThe Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.$B$BGo to the ley line in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.
94413.objectives: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.
94413.reward: Sometimes I find it hard to distinguish between the blind zealotry of the Al'Aketh cult, and the stubborn refusal of the Windshapers to change.$B$BIf they truly believed the winds would guide us, they should be sensing the direction the winds are blowing and flow with them rather than against them.

94414.title: The Anchors of Zephras
94414.details: Greetings, young $N. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.$B$BThey suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.$B$BIf you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
94414.objectives: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
94414.request: My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the ley lines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it.$B$BAppreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.
94414.reward: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.

94427.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94427.details: A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.$B$BGo to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
94427.objectives: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
94427.reward: You... you are a $C? Please, do not hurt me. I-I know I'm not supposed to be panhandling. I have no quarrel with you or your order. Leave me be, I beg you!

94434.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94434.details: Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?$B$BWell, I suppose that you could be of some assistance.$B$BIt's my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
94434.objectives: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
94434.request: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly $C.
94434.reward: This is very kind of you, $C. Very kind indeed.

94435.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94435.details: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, $C.
94435.objectives: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
94435.reward: You have done well, $N. It was a small thing, but even small acts of service such as this may help strengthen our connection to the light.$B$BThe Dark Lady and many in her service mistrust us. Some even conspire against us, but we will visit their skepticism and fear with courage and righteousness. We will show them that we are members of the Forsaken and we are willing to do our part, be it large or small, to help our people prosper once again.$B$BTake this symbol, you will need it for what comes next.

94436.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94436.details: It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.$B$BThe item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.$B$BGo see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.
94436.objectives: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.$B$BShould you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94436.reward: So you'll help me, then? Good, good. I'll admit I'm not proud of resorting to... well, resorting to asking paladins for aid. The priests waved me away and you might be my friend's only chance.$B$BPlease, help me.

94438.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94438.details: Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.$B$BFalgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.$B$BPlease, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438.objectives: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.$B$BShould you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94438.reward: I'm... back? And saved by a $C no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack.$B$BIf you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more than you can do to help the Forsaken.

94440.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94440.details: These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush.$B$BYou are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440.objectives: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.
94440.reward: Thank you for saving my friend,$N. I will take these plans back to my commander and we will give those crusaders a welcoming they won't forget.$B$BI know that many among our people mistrust you paladins, but its clear to me that you are Forsaken through and through. I won't forget this, and I'll make sure others know of what you did here today.

94441.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94441.details: Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us.$B$BYou have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, $N.
94441.objectives: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Bandarion Keep.
94441.reward: The Symbol of Life is only able to be used by a $C who is ready to make use of one of the light's greatest blessings. I'm proud to count you among us, and I now bestow upon you the gift of redemption. With this you will be able to resurrect your fallen companions. Use this new boon wisely.$B$BYou have done well for both the Forsaken as well as the paladins of Tyr's Watch. Any steps we can take to win the hearts and minds of our fellow Forsaken is well worth the effort. Go with the light, $N.

94449.title: Call of Fire
94449.details: It's been long since ye were last tested, $N. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye.$B$BSeek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
94449.objectives: Find Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94449.reward: Hmm... that elder sent ye, eh? Well, a $C's word is solid, so I'll not argue. That means ye're ready for the next sapta. The sapta of fire. I see it in yer eyes already -- the burnin', the hunger. Ye've tasted power, and now ye want more. But mind yerself, $N. Remember what the stone taught ye. Fire's easy to wield, but harder to master. Know when to hold back.

94465.title: Call of Fire
94465.details: Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.$B$BBeyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame.$B$BTake this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465.objectives: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94465.request: Greetin's, $N. Ye've made it to the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame, eh? Not many do. Only those well-versed in the $C's path can grasp the secrets this place holds.$B$BShame ye came all this way just to be turned back--the climb's no stroll through Dun Morogh. But I'm the shrine's keeper, and I won't be lettin' just any foot trod about.
94465.reward: Ah, me apologies, $N. Didn't spot the Torch in yer hand. An honor to meet ye proper.$B$BMany a wanderer climbs these heights chasin' tales of treasure or beasts, only to find naught but stone and silence. But we know better, don't we, $N?$B$BThis shrine holds truths far deeper than the Alliance can fathom. To us, it's a sacred flame that waits to be awakened.

94466.title: Call of Fire
94466.details: Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, $N? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.$B$BFirst, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.$B$BI'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
94466.objectives: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94466.request: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, $N--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.
94466.reward: These'll do fine, $N.$B$BFire ain't just fury and ruin--mark me words. It's life, it's forge, it's the breath o' creation. All things are bound in balance. One force tempers the other, gives it meaning. Without shadow, light's but a glare. Without flame, stone's but cold memory.$B$BMasterin' magic means knowin' when to blend, not just burn. That's true wisdom, lad.

94467.title: Call of Fire
94467.details: The fire sapta's ready, $N. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him.$B$BStrike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.
94467.objectives: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of Fire, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
94467.request: The brazier stands about a third your height, with charred inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch.$B$BBlackrock mountain looms in the distance, in clear view to honor from this sacred place.
94467.reward: A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.$B$BYou place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire. The smoke seems to drift towards the mountain of blackrock.

94468.title: Call of Fire
94468.details: Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.$B$BYou start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468.objectives: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94468.request: Aye, $N? What do ye have there?
94468.reward: By Madoran's beard, yer spirit burns brighter than any torch I've laid eyes on, $N--and that's somethin' to be proud of.$B$BKeep walkin' this path, and the elements'll bend to yer will. Our kin will come to ye for wisdom and guidance. So let me be the first to offer me hearty congratulations -- and present ye with yer newest totem. Ye've earned it, flameborn.

94472.title: Earth Sapta
94472.objectives: Speak to Teo Hammerstorm for another Earth Sapta.
94472.reward: Take this and remember, it is sacred.

94473.title: Fire Sapta
94473.objectives: Speak to Braldir Ashmantle for another Fire Sapta.
94473.reward: May fire burn within your heart, Ukko.$B$BThe elements await you.

94484.title: Unnerving Silence
94484.details: A moment if you will, $N. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.$B$BWith Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94484.objectives: Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94484.reward: Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?$B$B<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>$B$BSo the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.$B$BIt seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

94485.title: Tears of the Lady
94485.details: If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.$B$BThis moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.$B$BGo and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
94485.request: Have you found the Lady's Tear?
94485.reward: <Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>$B$BThank you, $N, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.

94486.title: Feathers for Binding
94486.details: The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.$B$BBe warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486.objectives: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
94486.request: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.
94486.reward: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.

94487.title: Unwanted and Unworthy
94487.details: The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.$B$B<Elegael spits.>$B$BThese storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487.objectives: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.
94487.request: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.
94487.reward: <Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>$B$BSo many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, $C.$B$BI will hold onto them for safe keeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.

94488.title: The Ties That Bind
94488.details: The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.$B$BOne of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.$B$BShow him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
94488.objectives: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
94488.request: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?
94488.reward: <Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.>$B$BThank you, $N. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.$B$BDo not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.

94489.title: The Wounds of Betrayal
94489.details: I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.$B$BBefore you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
94489.objectives: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.
94489.request: $C! You have returned. Were you able to reach my brothers and sisters? Did you find Jorel?
94489.reward: <Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>$B$BNo... no! This is far worse than I had--$B$B<Elegael chokes back a sob, and grits her teeth letting out a pained snarl.>$B$BThey will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.

94490.title: Ripped Missive
94490.objectives: Bring the Ripped Missive to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.$B$BProvided item:
94490.reward: They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?$B$B<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>$B$BThey murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.$B$BGo, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.

94491.title: The Fate of the Den
94491.details: It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.$B$BHe should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.$B$BPlease go swiftly, $N. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491.objectives: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.$B$BProvided item:
94491.reward: <Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the druid den.>$B$BI--I'm sorry, $N. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.$B$BThis is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows sacrifice be in vain.

94493.title: A Sacrifice in Vain
94493.details: Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?$B$B<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>$B$BSo the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straits indeed then.$B$B<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>$B$BThen we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94493.objectives: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94493.reward: The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with little to no warning. Many inside my den lay wounded or dying. I had attempted to send a message to Valanaar but it appears my efforts were in vain.$B$BPlease, if you have come here I beg for your help. I don't know how much longer my fellows will be able to survive this onslaught.

94494.title: Call of Water
94494.details: Long has it been since ye were last tested, $N. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.$B$BSeek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, $N.
94494.objectives: Find Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94494.reward: The wind's rushin' at yer back, the stone's firm beneath yer boots, and the fire in yer belly's burnin' bright. Aye, it's time ye learned the truth o' water's purity. Yer path's been long, but it's yer spirit that'll carry ye further still. Now, go on, take that first step. The mountain waits for no one.

94495.title: Call of Water
94495.details: If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.$B$BIf ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.$B$BGo on then, don't let the river outrun ye.
94495.objectives: Find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94495.reward: Aye, I see it in yer eyes, $R. You're wonderin' what kind o' soul chooses to live out here, deep in the Wetlands, with Dark Iron scum lurkin' about and nary a guard in sight. Well, we all have our reasons, love.$B$BBut the real question is, what brings you to our home? Out here at the edge of the falls, I reckon we both know the answer to that.

94497.title: Call of Water
94497.details: Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.$B$BWe'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.
94497.objectives: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.$B$BProvided item:
94497.request: I'm nearly ready to send ye off on the rest o' yer tasks. But tell me, have ye filled the skin yet? The ocean brings life, aye -- but it carries sediment, minerals, and energies far different from the snowmelt and springwater of the highlands. Where sea and spring meet, there's wisdom to be found.
94497.reward: Glad ye managed to steer clear o' the Dark Iron. Shame they've crept so far north--makes ye wonder what dwarfkind could do if the clans ever stopped squabblin' and worked as one.$B$BStill, the tides rise high when the moons are strong, and the seawater floods the marsh. It's here that we study our estuary water.$B$BThank ye for this sacred offering, it marks the beginning of your stage as a vessel--one who seeks the waters' wisdom.

94499.title: Call of Water
94499.details: Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.$B$BBring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
94499.objectives: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.$B$BProvided item:
94499.request: The folk o' Lakeshire don't ken how good they've got it -- fresh water flowin' right at their boots, keepin' their nets full, their crops green, and their coin purses jinglin'. Even when the kingdom's guard can barely spare a lad with a sword, they've got Everstill watchin' over 'em.
94499.reward: Aye, this is good water, $N. The magic used by the shadowseers in the region must be changin' the murlocs. Nothin' but pure water, this be. Yer dedication to the task at hand and abilities to seek out that which is needed proves you're ready for the next stage of your journey.$B$BOne more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Norric will be pleased as well.

94500.title: Call of Water
94500.details: Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.$B$BIt's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.$B$BBoard the boat in Menethil to Auberdine. It stops in Southshore on the way over.$B$BAnd mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.
94500.objectives: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.$B$BProvided item:
94500.request: Do you have the water yet, $N? If ye haven't made the trek to Kalimdor yet, be careful.
94500.reward: Well done, $N! With all three samples in hand, I'll brew ye a vial o' water so pure it'd make the mountains weep. It's the final piece for yer rite o' passage. I'm proud to call ye kin, $N. Ye've done $C proud, and I look forward to hearing yer tales in the future.

94501.title: Call of Water
94501.details: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.
94501.objectives: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94501.request: Hello again, $N. Yer looking well.$B$BWhat brings you back to me so soon?
94501.reward: Ahh, water blessed by Hervdana herself, and gathered by your own hands? A gift indeed.$B$BThese vials shall birth your sapta, letting you glimpse the water spirits at Stendel's Pond, near Moonbrook. The last few drops of the water have an equally important purpose... waste not even a cork stopper dampened with sacred water.

94502.title: Call of Water
94502.details: In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent.$B$BYe must drink the water sapta, then face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.$B$BBring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.
94502.objectives: Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall.$BReturn to Norric in Loch Modan when finished.
94502.request: The shrine stands aged and forgotten, cloaked in dust and cobwebs. The pond beside it lies eerily still, its surface untouched by wind or life. Scattered along the shore are the bones of beasts once burdened by labor. The water's murky sheen raises a troubling question--has it been poisoned by the surrounding malaise, or is it the very source of it?
94502.reward: You place the bracers atop the shrine and then pour the remaining drops of Norric's potion into dry stone. You begin to incant the simple words Norric taught you and the droplets vaporize atop the stone within the bindings....

94503.title: Call of Water
94503.details: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
94503.objectives: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Westfall.
94503.reward: Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.$B$BCorruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.

94505.title: Call of Water
94505.details: Take shard. Take shard and give life.$B$BGive life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.$B$BYou protect and give life with water's power.
94505.objectives: Bring the Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94505.request: How fared your journey to Westfall? Success there is hard to measure, but even small victories carry weight.
94505.reward: Aye, this is the proof I asked for, and ye've done well, $N. I'm proud to be the first to offer my congratulations--and yer water totem. Use it wisely, and may fortune walk beside ye.$B$BYer next trial won't come soon, so take this time to learn. Pure water heals, aye, but its gifts go far beyond mending wounds.

94568.title: The Cult's True Plans
94568.details: The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.$B$BWe must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
94568.objectives: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.
94568.request: That turncoat risked everything to escape the cult and bring us this crystal...
94568.reward: We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.$B$BWe are going to need a different approach.

94616.title: Water Sapta
94616.details: Take the water sapta and find the tainted pond water in Westfall, $N. I have great faith in your abilities.

94638.title: Strength and Mercy
94638.details: You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.$B$BMy mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.$B$BEnd her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
94638.objectives: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
94638.request: What I ask of you is no easy task. Take heart in your courage and return to me when the deed is done.
94638.reward: The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.$B$BYou have done well, $C. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.$B$BGo now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.

94773.title: Divine Grace
94773.details: You have done the Light a great service by becoming a shining example to those who travel in these dangerous lands and beyond. Please, accept this lesson as a thanks for all you've done.

94774.title: Divine Grace
94774.details: You've caught the attention of our superiors, $N. They've asked you to travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94774.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94774.reward: I'm glad you've arrived, $N. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.$B$BThere are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

94775.title: Divine Grace
94775.details: Elune bless you, good $R. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.$B$BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94775.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94776.title: Divine Grace
94776.details: Time's come for you to head to Stormwind, $N. High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light wants to speak to you. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.$B$BBut don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94776.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94777.title: Divine Grace
94777.details: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, $R. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Cathedral of Light. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.$B$BElune be with you, good $R.
94777.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94778.title: Divine Grace
94778.details: You're needed in Stormwind, $N. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, $N.
94778.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94779.title: Divine Grace
94779.details: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $N.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.
94779.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.

94789.title: Call of Air
94789.details: The winds o' Azeroth greet ye, and soon ye'll stand among some o' our mightiest kin. I'm proud to see how far ye've come--your future looks bright indeed.$B$BThe element o' air's a tricky one to master, but I've faith your skill will see ye through any challenge.$B$BMake your way north into Arathi Highlands. In its northern hills, you'll find Veyric Thundervein. He'll teach ye more.
94789.objectives: Find Veyric Thundervein in Arathi Highlands.
94789.reward: Aye, I shall give ye what's needed to focus wind spells and to call upon the spirits o' air. Take this totem, and when ye are ready, train with me some more.

94792.title: Taming the Beast
94792.details: Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.$B$BTake this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.
94792.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94792.request: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $C.
94792.reward: Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner.

94793.title: Training the Beast
94793.details: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.$B$BGo with the winds, young $C.
94793.objectives: Speak to Isaac Chan in Goldshire.
94793.reward: A fledgling $C, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.$B$BRemember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.

94817.title: Confounding Flash
94817.details: You took your time arriving, $N. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.

94818.title: Contingency Plan
94818.details: Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great $C, $N. Maintain your vigilance and dedication!$B$BYou are ready for your next lesson in service.

94819.title: Contingency Plan
94819.details: $N, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
94819.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94819.reward: Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great $C, $N. Maintain your vigilance and dedication!$B$BYou are ready for your next lesson in service.

94820.title: Contingency Plan
94820.details: Your race is so very clever, $N. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to reclaiming your city, but with the burden of keeping your families safe in exile. That yearning for home must weigh heavily on you.$B$BWord came from Ironforge just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priestess Mims in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep her waiting. May Elune guide your travels.
94820.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94821.title: Confounding Flash
94821.details: A priest recently visited our halls seeking you out, young $R. He said that he was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out High Priestess Mims--she will tell you more.$B$BThe Light be with you, $N.
94821.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94821.reward: You took your time arriving, $N. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.

94822.title: Confounding Flash
94822.details: You've caught the attention of our superiors, $N. They've asked you to travel to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Mims. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94822.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94822.reward: You took your time arriving, Cub. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.

94823.title: Confounding Flash
94823.details: Elune bless you, good $R. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.$B$BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Hall of Mysteries as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Mims. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94823.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94824.title: Confounding Flash
94824.details: Time's come for you to head to Ironforge, $N. High Priestess Mims in the Hall of Mysteries commands you to come speak with her. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.$B$BBut don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94824.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94824.reward: You took your time arriving, Papi. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.

94825.title: Confounding Flash
94825.details: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, $R. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Hall of Mysteries. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.$B$BElune be with you, good $R.
94825.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94826.title: Confounding Flash
94826.details: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $N.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out your High Priestess for further training.
94826.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94863.title: Taming the Beast
94863.details: You've already mastered taming a boar. Now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.$B$BTake this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a hunter once more.
94863.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Gray Forest Wolf. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94863.reward: Well done, $N! You're quite in tune with the beast.

94864.title: Taming the Beast
94864.details: You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf. Now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion.$B$BCompleting this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.
94864.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94864.request: Go forth, $N, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.
94864.reward: The brawn of the forest. Brave work, $N!

94872.title: Buying Friendship: Magram
94872.details: The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.$B$BI worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.$B$BIf you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
94872.objectives: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.

94873.title: Buying Friendship: Gelkis
