94873.details: Either dominant centaur clan is likely to pose a good ally, but I ought to offer a word of caution regarding the Gelkis.$B$BI have trustworthy intel that suggests, between the Magram and the Gelkis, the latter are very much on the losing side. This may work to our advantage--desperation may push the isolated clan into opening up to outside help.$B$BI have prepared a tote of totems for you to take to their quartermaster, assuming they have one, in Gelkis Village. This may work in our favor.
94873.objectives: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan.  You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
94873.request: An outsider this deep in the village? You best be bringing business.
94873.reward: <Molkar peeks into the bag. A smirk tugs at his lips, falling only briefly as he catches a glimpse of a clearly fake totem. He pretends to not see it.>$B$BI do not know what possessed an outsider to bring our clan such a gift. It is a great boon for our people, as the Magram Clan have been unusually vicious as of late.$B$BYou no longer need to tread carefully in our village. I will inform Uthek, who will speak with the Khan.

94896.title: Aid For The Refugees
94896.details: You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.$B$B<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>$B$BWe've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896.objectives: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
94896.request: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.
94896.reward: Thank you, $C, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.

94897.title: The Fate of a Loved One
94897.details: If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.$B$BPlease, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897.objectives: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
94897.request: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, $C, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.
94897.reward: <Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>$B$BOh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.$B$BThank you, $C. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.

94911.title: Child of Nature
94911.details: Greetings, young $R. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade.$B$BYou will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you.$B$BAs your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
94911.objectives: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
94911.reward: A high elf, speaking to me... in Thunder Bluff. Will wonders never cease?$B$BWell, shaper of wind, let me join our Earthen Ring brothers and sisters in welcoming you to Azeroth. My fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.

94912.title: Child of Nature
94912.details: Greetings, young $C.$B$BHave you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.$B$BGo now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912.objectives: Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.
94912.reward: Greetings, fellow $C. It pleases me to meet a fellow $C from among the Skyborne, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.$B$BI think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.

94913.title: Moonglade
94913.details: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.$B$BAs for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94913.objectives: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
94913.reward: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $C.

94914.title: Moonglade
94914.details: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.$B$BAs for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94914.objectives: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
94914.reward: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $C.

94946.title: The Magical City of Dalaran
94946.details: I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.$B$BWhen you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
94946.objectives: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
94946.reward: Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.$B$BAs idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.

94947.title: Welcome to Azeroth
94947.details: It's a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.$B$BThe Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.$B$BWhen you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.
94947.objectives: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
94947.reward: Well met, $C. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.$B$BA Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect an emissary from the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.$B$BOn behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.

94978.title: Taming the Beast
94978.details: Every hunter begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras.$B$BTake this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.$B$BShow that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
94978.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water.$BPractice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94978.request: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $C.
94978.reward: Well tamed, $N! You are becoming adept already.

94979.title: Taming the Beast
94979.details: You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.$B$BTake this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.$B$BShow you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands.$BPractice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94979.request: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $C.

95034.title: The Debt
95034.details: I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.$B$BWe were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.$B$BWe were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034.objectives: Speak with Lumina Windsinger in the Sepulcher.
95034.request: I've never seen anything like what happened to Banon. Azeroth is a wonderful place, but the sheer breadth of what is possible here is truly terrifying.
95034.reward: So now you understand. At the very end of his strength after being pierced by a dozen gnoll blades, he reared up to strike me. In that final moment we locked eyes, and I could tell he still knew who he was and that he recognized me. He knew what was happening but he had no control over himself. That was the worst part.$B$BIf such a thing is possible, I will see the creature that doomed him dead so that it can never visit this horror on another living thing. I swear it upon the sky above.

95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade
95036.details: Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.$B$BThat's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.$B$BSpeak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.objectives: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
95036.request: Trust in the light to guide your blade. However, the light needs a good blade to guide.
95036.reward: Now that we've got the materials we need, we just need a smith to craft the blade for us. I think I know just such a smith.

95041.title: Data Hoarders
95041.details: Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.$B$BIt wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.$B$BThe cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041.objectives: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.
95041.request: How is the data retrieval progressing?
95041.reward: These cards seem a bit damp... but I can work with this! Thank you, $N!

95042.title: Seeking the Kor Gem
95042.details: A Forsaken paladin... here in Ashenvale? Amusing.$B$BSo you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the Alliance. Why should a fallen paladin like you be any different?$B$BIf you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, $C.
95042.objectives: Bring a Kor Gem to Ulric Frostveil in Ashenvale.
95042.request: Kor gems can be used for great acts of evil. Far be it from me to judge if your intentions are pure. It matters not to me.
95042.reward: You'll no doubt notice the corruption that permeates this gem. For your purposes, The magic needed to dispel the evil that the naga witches have infused into the gem is rather simple. A shame really, there's much one could learn from such powers.$B$BI don't suppose you'd be willing to abandon whatever quest caused you seek this gem, and sell it to me instead? It could prove valuable to my... academic pursuits.

95065.title: Fishin' Time
95065.details: What a view... Best an old man can ask for.$B$BThe fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.$B$BWould you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
95065.objectives: Bring 1 Shiny Bauble and 3 Nightcrawlers to Gilbert Gray at the harbor in Stormwind.
95065.request: Did you get the fishing supplies?
95065.reward: Great timing! Caught a big one with my last bait. Great day so far. They're really biting out here!$B$BTell you what, since you were kind enough to keep this old man in business how about a few fish for the road?

95111.title: An Underrated Talent
95111.details: In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.$B$BI'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111.objectives: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.
95111.request: Are you in need of a blade, $C?
95111.reward: Interesting. I don't think anyone has ever asked me to actually carry out a custom commission for them. Mostly I just make humble, functional weapons in my own style. It's not much, but its honest work and I don't seek accolades or glory.$B$BI'm happy to try, but why would you seek me for this? There are plenty of smiths in the Undercity that will take on custom jobs like this.

95125.title: Ott's Masterwork
95125.details: These are some truly fine materials, $C. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.$B$BPlease, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125.objectives: Watch as Ott forges your blade.
95125.request: My blade will not fail you, $C.
95125.reward: This blade is my finest work and I hope it serves you well in your travels. Thank you again for this opportunity.$B$BAka'Magosh, friend.

95126.title: The Moonsilver Blade
95126.details: Here's the blade. You said that a paladin named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.
95126.objectives: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.
95126.request: Was Ott able to carry out the commission?
95126.reward: <Trevan takes the blade and inspects it carefully.>$B$BThis will do nicely, $N. I knew that Ott had it in him to make something truly great.$B$BThe only thing left now is to kill that beast. Speak with Lumina when you are ready.

95140.title: Old Fire-Eye
95140.details: I see that you have your weapon now, $C. I pray that it will not fail you.$B$BThe locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140.objectives: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.
95140.request: Is it done? Is the beast slain?
95140.reward: Thank you, $N. Banon may now rest in peace.$B$BIf you would be willing to allow it, I believe that I can impart some magic upon your freshly blooded blade to infuse it with a small measure of the magic of my people.$B$BIt is done. It's a small thing, and I could scarcely improve such a magnificent blade. Regardless, I will pray to the winds that it serves you well, $C.

95161.title: Remember That I Love You
95161.details: If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.$B$BIf you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
95161.objectives: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
95161.reward: Oh no...$B$BIt's nice of you to bring this, but I don't think Jeremy is ready to see it. Matron Nightingale said my little Jeremy hasn't spoken since the attack on Lordaeron, and I don't intend to force him now. Showing him this will only cause him more pain.$B$BDon't look at me like that. I won't hide his past from him, but he needs time to heal. I'll give this to him when he's older. Thank you for stopping by, but I think it's time you should go.

95189.title: Crest of Lordaeron
95189.objectives: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.request: Welcome to the gallery. Feel free to browse.
95189.reward: How in the world did you find this? It's in such remarkable condition... all things considered.$B$BThank you for restoring this piece of Alliance history, $C. I'll have my best people get to work restoring this immediately.

95195.title: Bloodied Insignia
95195.objectives: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.
95195.request: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, $N. What is it?
95195.reward: Your instincts to bring these to me were not unfounded. When Lordaeron fell to the scourge, many people fled to take refuge here in Stormwind. There are likely few who remain to claim these insignias themselves.$B$BYour duty to Stormwind is commended, $N. I'll begin distributing these tokens to next of kin right away.

95204.title: Crest of Lordaeron
95204.objectives: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
95204.request: What have you got there, $C? A tasty morsel?
95204.reward: <Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>$B$BWell I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.$B$BThank you for your aid in restoring our history, $C. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.

95212.title: Never Saddle on Quality
95212.details: We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.$B$BCollect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212.objectives: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
95212.request: You look chilly, $C. How goes the hunt?
95212.reward: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, $C!

95213.title: Stolen Blasting Powder
95213.details: The keg is stamped:$B$BBLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER$B$BYou get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
95213.objectives: Bring the Empty Powder Keg to Quarrymaster Thesten at Gol'Bolar Quarry.
95213.reward: <The $R turns pale as he sees the empty keg.>$B$B...Where did you find this?

95214.title: Stolen Blasting Powder
95214.details: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
95214.objectives: Recover 16 Stolen Blasting Powder from the troggs east of Gol'Bolar Quarry, then return to Quarrymaster Thesten.
95214.request: I hope you've got good news for me?
95214.reward: That should be all the stolen powder. Thank you, $C.$B$BPlease accept this reward, and... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention this little incident to anyone.

95216.title: The New Plague
95216.details: Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.$B$BYou've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!$B$BI wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216.objectives: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
95216.request: Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood.$B$BI must see this strain for myself!
95216.reward: You killed it??$B$BHmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society.$B$BGet out of my sight!

95217.title: The Quarry's Smith
95217.details: So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.$B$BThe supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?
95217.objectives: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.
95217.request: Don't slack off, $N. Smithin' isn't for the lazy!
95217.reward: You're a resourceful one, $N.$B$BNow listen up - I'm not going to repeat myself!

95250.title: Abominable Creatures
95250.details: What do you want, $R? Can't you see there is a war to be won?$B$BMy master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.$B$BI doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250.objectives: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.

95314.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir
95314.details: Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.$B$BI've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314.objectives: Collect 8 Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
95314.request: I trust you did not get lost?
95314.reward: You say there is evil in Shadowvale? I admit, I am not surprised. The forest folk were an odd lot, and they did not care for visitors. Some believe the Whispering Forest itself is cursed, and the elixir distilled from its roots carries that same curse...$B$B...but enough of superstition and rumors, $N. Thank you for the elixirs. Here, take this as payment.

95328.title: Whispering Horror Residue
95328.details: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328.objectives: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.
95328.request: Do you have something for me, $C?
95328.reward: What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void.$B$BI welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, $C. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.

95349.title: The Earthen Ring
95349.details: The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.$B$BWhen you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.$B$BBanu-Alah, $N.
95349.objectives: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.
95349.reward: More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.$B$BAzeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.

95350.title: Welcome to Azeroth
95350.details: It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.$B$BThe Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.$B$BSeek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, $N.
95350.objectives: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.
95350.reward: Lok-tar, $C. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde.$B$BAn Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect members of the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the horde will welcome you as our guest all the same.$B$BYou have my blessing to travel through horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.

95384.title: Partial Mystical Notes
95384.objectives: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.

95494.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides
95494.details: I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.$B$BThe big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494.objectives: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
95494.reward: Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade.$B$BI've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.

95495.title: The Hermit Tanner
95495.details: These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.$B$BOh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495.objectives: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
95495.request: Greetings, $C. What brings you up to my property today?
95495.reward: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.

95507.title: Vrang's Game
95507.details: While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.$B$BBring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
95507.objectives: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.
95507.request: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
95507.reward: Thank you for your aid, $C. I was starting to wonder if I'd have to go to bed hungry tonight because this cursed wound on my leg.

95508.title: Unwelcome Guests
95508.details: Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.$B$BThere's more to the story but... wait... what's that?$B$BThere's a group of men coming up the ridge!
95508.objectives: Help Walton survive the encounter with Terry Longdrink and the Kul Tiras marines.
95508.reward: Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.$B$BPlease, take this. It's not much, but its the least I can do.$B$BSafe travels, $C.

95534.title: Strahnbrad Mystery
95534.details: <The note is singed in places, but is still readable.>$B$BRumor has it those old bellows have a mind of their own, springing to life when no one is watching. I don't care if it's a ghost story, you'd better get to the bottom of it before I return.$B$BThere's great power in Strahnbrad, I know it.$B$B< The rest of the note is singed and torn, as if burnt by fire magic. >
95534.objectives: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.
95534.reward: So there was a fire elemental living in the old bellows up in Strahnbrad? The real mystery is how it got there, I suppose. Either way, good work. Your efforts will be rewarded.

95621.title: Trouble in the Valley
95621.details: This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras.$B$BIf you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
95621.objectives: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
95621.request: The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.$B$BI don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621.reward: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.

95646.title: Horrors in the Highland
95646.details: These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.$B$BThe creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.$B$BGo to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646.objectives: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
95646.request: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
95646.reward: It is worse than I feared. An ancient energy stirs. It would be most wise for you to carry word to your eager excavators to stop digging, for their own safety.

95647.title: Lost in the Thicket Things
95647.details: My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.$B$BBut I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!$B$BIf you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
95647.objectives: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.

95663.title: Dragonmaw Rumors
95663.details: The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.$B$BThey're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.$B$BA deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663.objectives: Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
95663.reward: These are the courageous few? Mind your voices.

95664.title: Elder Knowledge
95664.details: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664.objectives: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
95664.request: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664.reward: It is a favored sign to have a stranger approach in this manner. I feel a power amidst you... what is this you have brought?

95682.title: Open the Maw
95682.details: Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>$B$BThe remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?$B$BClear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.$B$BIf the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682.objectives: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
95682.request: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682.reward: Don't mind me snatching that right out of your hands.$B$BI recognized that orcish scrawl. So they're hoping to appease Rend? A fruitless and wasted effort.$B$BNo matter, this is highly valuable knowledge for the dark lady to consider.$B$BHere, I won't be taking any of this with me--and don't talk about the mission, grunt.

95697.title: Changing Tastes
95697.details: Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.$BIf we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.$B$BHer idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.$B$BA hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.$B$BUp for a job?
95697.objectives: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
95697.request: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697.reward: Look at the marbling on these! What are they eating up there? Thank you for going all the way and back for us. If you don't mind waiting, we'll cook some for you now, on the house, of course!

95737.title: Seeking Caitlin
95737.details: From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.$B$BOne alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.$B$BIf you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.objectives: Speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.reward: Llana must be wondering where those grass seeds are that I promised I'd have my husband bring back! It comforts me to know she's as concerned as I am. It must be something about the excavation site itself that we're both sensing.

95748.title: The Gurubashi Legends of Old
95748.details: This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.$B$B$N, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.$B$BTake this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.
95748.objectives: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.

95770.title: Locating the Lost City
95770.details: After rereading the legend, it doesn't seem like we are in the wrong place for the lost city, but perhaps there is yet some detail that has been overlooked.$B$BIn my younger years I used to dive in the Vile Reef ruins, but that was before the murlocs settled there. If memory serves there was a cavern there.$B$BI have heard that there are now naga gathering in that region, which is unusual. I want to know what has lured them there.$B$BGo and explore just west of the Vile Reef and return to me with any news.
95770.objectives: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.

95772.title: Songblade Search
95772.details: Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.$B$BAye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.$B$BDaewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.$B$BIf yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772.objectives: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.

95773.title: Enemies in the Water
95773.details: $C, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.$B$BWe are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.$B$BGo and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.
95773.objectives: Gather 10 Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.

95774.title: Her Name Is Olgra
95774.details: The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.$B$BYou did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.$B$BSlay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!$B$BI will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774.objectives: Slay quilboars and collect 4 of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
95774.request: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774.reward: I will place these adornments with my wife's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge!$B$BYou have done me... done us... a great favor, $N.

95775.title: The Drowned City
95775.details: What I am about to ask you is no small feat, $C, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.$B$BI want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.$B$BEnter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.
95775.objectives: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.

95776.title: The Only Good Brinescale...
95776.details: You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.$B$BI have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.$B$BWe can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.
95776.objectives: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.

95786.title: An Acquaintance in Southshore
95786.details: $N, I have a friend in the Hillsbrad Foothills that is studying troll legends and evil magic. I think he may have insight about how this foul magic captured Colenel Kurzen's mind.$B$BI also have a scout's report that the local trolls seem to be agitated, mentioning the word..."I'lalai".$B$BI must know if this is related to Kurzen's corruption! Here, take the fetishes and legends along with this scouting report to Loremaster Dibbs. With any luck he will be able to unravel some of their secrets.
95786.objectives: Find Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore and bring him the Savage Coast Report Bundle.$B$BProvided item:

95787.title: Take Two With Water
95787.details: <Loremaster Dibbs' hands shake as he reads the scouting report and the troll legends.>$B$BCould it be? By this account it sounds like the lost troll city of I'lalai has risen just off the coast of Stranglethorn! We must investigate immediately. Why, if my research is correct this could be the archeological discovery of the century!$B$BPlease, I know it is a long trek back to Stranglethorn but if you find yourself in this Drowned City, collect any legends you find there and return them to me.
95787.objectives: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.

95788.title: Magics of the Drowned City
95788.details: The Skullsplitter fetishes Brother Nimetz sent with you are indeed powerful, though I do not think they contributed to Kurzen's condition, or at least not directly.$B$BStill, if the rumors are true and the lost troll city of I'lalai has indeed risen from its watery grave, it is possible the dark magics used to raise the doomed city may be related.$B$BIf you dare to venture into the Drowned City of I'lalai, please gather any troll fetishes you find and bring them here to me for further study.
95788.objectives: Collect 5 I'lalai Fetishes from trolls in the Drowned City.

95795.title: Fallen in the Fen
95795.details: <You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>$B$BTravel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795.reward: Ah no...$B<He buries his head in his hands and sobs.>$B$BI should 'ave gone with 'em.$B$BMuch of what I was smithin' was for 'im, was plannin' a surprise but it wasn't ready when he came by gettin' things for his journey.$B$BNow that these are finished, I don't have it in me to reforge or sell any of it.$BYou can have this. It's the least I can do for you, bringing me this grim day.

95803.title: A Token of Good Faith
95803.details: Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.$B$BDeliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803.objectives: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
95803.reward: I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.$B$BThere may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.$B$BWe will be watching.

95805.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha
95805.details: The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.$B$BWe pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.$B$BIf you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.$B$BDon't get it wet!
95805.objectives: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!
95805.request: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805.reward: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>

95809.title: Heartwoven
95809.details: I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.$B$B<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>$B$BTake this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.$B$BThank you.
95809.objectives: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95809.request: I'm more than worried about him!
95809.reward: Goodness, that sounds terrible!$B$BBy the light, I'm grateful he's one of the survivors.$B$B<She holds the reed-woven heart to her own.>$B$BI'll start cooking a hearty meal for him. Thank you for bringing me this. I'd like you to have something as a token of our appreciation.

95810.title: Lost Relic Carry
95810.details: You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'$B$BProspector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810.objectives: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands excavation site.
95810.reward: Ah, ye ventured all the way in and survived to tell the tale?! Let's have a look at what ye carry there.$B$BWell, knowing what ye went through to bring it back to me, I think it warrants a certain reverence for your artifact.

95816.title: Sign Me Up!
95816.details: Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!$B$BCompletion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!$B$BOnce completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing.$B$BHappy crafting!
95816.objectives: Bring the completed form to Elaine Compton in Redridge Mountains.$B$BProvided item:

95817.title: Rotgath Stonebeard
95817.details: Have you ever met Rotgath Stonebeard? He is a dwarven blacksmith in Ironforge. Not the most chatty fellow around, but always reliable. We often come to him when we need bulk crafts of simpler designs--the kind that Stondry is too proud to take on himself.$B$BHis turnaround times are excellent, particularly when it comes to helping new craftspeople get their shops established. I would trust no other to get your sign made fast. Let him know I sent you if he gives you any trouble!
95817.objectives: Meet Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.

95818.title: A Quick Craft
95818.details: We can get ye sorted out and out of here in no time, provided you have the materials on hand! We are going to need 25 Mithril Bars and 15 Heavy Leather. Normally we need some other metals and the like too, but I've got some scrap that's been taking up space we can use for those extra bits.$B$BOh, as a personal favor, I am gonnae ask for 5 Goldthorn as well. My wife knows a great recipe for tea and I'd like to surprise her. Consider this your payment!
95818.objectives: Bring the requested materials to Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.

95819.title: Sign Me Up!
95819.details: Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!$B$BCompletion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!$B$BOnce completed, please bring this to your local Durotar Supply & Logistics Contract Coordinator to begin processing.$B$BHappy crafting!
95819.objectives: Bring the completed form to Jornah in The Barrens.$B$BProvided item:

95883.title: The Tortured Soul
95883.details: Tortured Soul.$B$BThe undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883.objectives: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95883.reward: <The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.$B$BIt appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>

95884.title: The Offering Stone
95884.details: offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.$B$BPerhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884.objectives: Find the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95884.reward: <Strange implements and items litter the rough surface of the stone.$B$BThis is surely the offering stone that is mentioned in the note.>

95885.title: The Offering of Blood
95885.objectives: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.$B$BProvided item:
95885.reward: <The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.$B$BThe rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.$B$BSomething glitters from within the remnants...>

95981.title: Watching the Roads
95981.details: Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.$B$BSearch the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981.objectives: Slay 8 Dalaran Wizards and 8 Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
95981.reward: Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.$B$BFor now, however, the why is irrelevant.

95998.title: The Great Outdoors
95998.details: Well howdy there, $C. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.$B$BIt's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.$B$BHave a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998.objectives: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
95998.request: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
95998.reward: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

95999.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im
95999.details: Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.$B$BBeware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999.objectives: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
95999.reward: Excellent work, $N! Incinerator Gar'im was preparing to bolster the defenses at Stonewatch Keep. With this victory, we may yet succeed in reclaiming the keep!

96016.title: The Tempest's Weapons
96016.details: Ye did good, and I can see yer itchin' fer yer reward. Sorry tae say, I'm not exactly a dwarf of many possessions.$B$B<Veyric gestures broadly at his remote location.>$B$BTell ye what, though. I hear a troll named the Windwatcher lives out in the Alterac Mountains. He's a powerful shaman himself, and an expert in storm elementals. If ye bring that there elemental core to him, I bet he can make ye a weapon worthy of yer victory.
96016.objectives: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.

96031.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking
96031.details: You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $C. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.$B$BWith a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
96031.objectives: Speak with Gretta Finespindle in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96031.reward: There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96044.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
96044.details: So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
96044.objectives: Speak with Tognus Flintfire in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96044.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96045.title: Camping 101: Alchemy
96045.details: Now that you've taken up Alchemy, I can also teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp once you've learned a bit. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
96045.objectives: Speak with Vosur Brakthel in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96045.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Mana Well. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96046.title: Camping 101: Mining
96046.details: Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
96046.objectives: Speak with Yarr Hammerstone in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96046.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96047.title: Camping 101: First Aid
96047.details: So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $C.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
96047.objectives: Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96047.request: I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.
96047.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96050.title: Camping 101: Fishing
96050.details: You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
96050.objectives: Speak with Paxton Ganter near Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96050.request: I can teach you once you've gained some skill as a fisherman.
96050.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96055.title: Camping 101: Herbalism
96055.details: Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055.objectives: Speak with Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96055.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96056.title: Camping 101: Skinning
96056.details: Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056.objectives: Speak with Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96056.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96057.title: Camping 101: Tailoring
96057.details: Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.$B$BI know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96057.objectives: Speak with Uthrar Threx in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96057.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96058.title: Camping 101: Engineering
96058.details: Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
96058.objectives: Speak with Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96058.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96059.title: Camping 101: Enchanting
96059.details: Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.$B$BIt's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059.objectives: Speak with Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96059.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96101.title: The Great Outdoors
96101.details: Greetings, $C. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.$B$BYou'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.$B$BHave a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101.objectives: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96101.request: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96101.reward: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

96102.title: Camping 101: Tailoring
96102.details: Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.$B$BI know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96102.objectives: Speak with Snang in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96102.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96130.title: Chakuyak
96130.details: Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.$B$BShe stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.$B$BEnd this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130.objectives: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.
96130.request: Have you found the big wolf?
96130.reward: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.

96135.title: Heed My Call
96135.details: Euck, just bein' around these blasted totems is givin' me the willies--but that's good. This much twisted corruption will be exactly what we need tae summon the quilboar's elementals.$B$BGo to the Thousand Needles and find a suitable spot for your defenses. The steam pools should work. They're rich with fire, earth, water, and air alike. Place these totems and be ready for a fight. The Razormane won't take too kindly to yer interference.
96135.objectives: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.

96136.title: Call of Air
96136.details: As you have no doubt experienced yourself, the elements of Azeroth are unique to those in Zephras. It is one thing to channel the forces of nature within the elemental plains, and another thing entirely to do it down here in the muck.$B$BI could grant you your totem of air, but I think it would do you more good to meet with the one who trains the other earth-bound initiates. What say you, $N?
96136.objectives: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

96137.title: Ira's Dagger
96137.details: A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.$B$BWith Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
96137.objectives: Defeat 10 Young Black Ravagers and 7 Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96137.reward: Ira? Are you sure? Sounds like the woman was damn near a ghost before she died. I'm surprised you found her.$B$BRest assured I will take great care of this dagger.

96138.title: Merrick's Bow
96138.details: A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.$B$BWith Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138.objectives: Defeat 8 Splint Fist Warriors and 4 Splint Fist Taskmasters then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96138.reward: Merrick Valor, you say? Poor boy always wanted to prove himself. It was a shame what happened to him and his family.$B$BThank you for bringing this, $N. Perhaps it can shed some additional light on Raven Hill's history.

96139.title: The Valor Family
96139.details: In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.$B$BHave you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.$B$BIf you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139.objectives: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
96139.request: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139.reward: This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.$B$BI'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.

96204.title: The Windshaper's Wrath
96204.details: Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.$B$BLet's get out of here, $C.
96204.objectives: Accompany Lumina Windsinger and help her escape Fenris Keep.
96204.reward: Thank you again, $N. I've been aquatinting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.$B$BI've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. As a sky-touched shen'dorei elf traveling through horde territory, I can certainly understand how easily intolerance and prejudice can take root.$B$BYou and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.

96222.title: Khan Hratha
96222.details: While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.$B$BKhan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.$B$BBring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
96222.objectives: Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.

96241.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon
96241.details: Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.$B$BSome say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
96241.objectives: Use the Toxin Extractor to gather 5 Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.
96241.request: Did ya get what I need?
96241.reward: Heh... when I said unique properties, I wasn't kiddin' mon! You seem no worse for wear, so it be all good.$B$BThank you for your aid, $C. It be much appreciated.

96243.title: Call of Earth
96243.details: It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave Shaman. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.$B$BSeek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243.objectives: Find Teo Hammerstorm in Dun Morogh.
96243.reward: The land itself let me know ye were comin'! Aye, sometimes, the burnin' fire within us is enough to power us through the snow without even touchin' the ground!

96259.title: Defending the Dead
96259.details: There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.$B$BIt would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259.objectives: Kill 10 Gloomrise Hatchlings and 5 Gloomrise Soldiers.
96259.reward: Thank you for your service to the people of this land. It may take time for us to completely clear out the infestation, but your efforts have created a stable foothold for us to leverage against these vile creatures.

96260.title: Stronger than Steel
96260.details: Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.$B$BOne of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.$B$BBring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260.objectives: Gather 3 strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.
96260.request: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260.reward: These are excellent samples, and more than sufficient for my needs.$B$BHere, take this. I was able to craft a rather unique cloak with a weave I spun from the small sample of silk already in my possession. I am hopeful that you will find it useful in your travels.$B$BEarthmother watch over you, $C.

96261.title: The Broodmother
96261.details: As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.$B$BIf we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
96261.reward: Reanimated dead? The broodmother possessing a night elven form? These are troubling revelations. One has to wonder what it all means... I fear that must be a concern for a later time.$B$BThank you, $N. You've done the Earthen Ring and the people of Mulgore a great service.

96264.title: Elemental Aid
96264.details: So yer a big shot shaman now, eh? Ye've mastered the elements and want tae put 'em to good use? I think I got just the thing.$B$BIf ye want the elements' respect, ye gotta repay yer debts to 'em. They help you, you help them. And right now they need all the help they can get from those who would abuse their power.$B$BEarth's rumblin', $N. It speaks of the quilboar amassin' for some ritual of terrible power. We need tae go investigate their kraul and see what they're up to. Bring me back whatever ye find.
96264.objectives: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
96264.request: Back so soon? What'd ye find?
96264.reward: Interestin'. The quilboar plan tae flood the Thousand Needles, eh? Those good fer nothin' beasts never did respect the elements. With abuse of this magnitude, it's no wonder we can feel it from here.$B$BYe did good findin' the source of this threat, $N, but now we gotta put an end to it.

96294.title: A Darker Truth
96294.objectives: Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.
96294.reward: This is... most disturbing. Why would a druid be behind a brood of dangerous spiders? Who or what is this "Wild King" and "Pact" that is referenced in this letter?$B$BI will confer with the druids of the Cenarion Circle on this.
