Perhaps they will know more.$B$BThank you again for your aid. As disturbing as this information is, we will rest easier knowing that the person controlling these vile creatures has been destroyed.

96339.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

96390.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud
96390.details: Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.$B$BHead eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390.objectives: Slay 10 Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.
96390.reward: These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.$B$BHopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.

96391.title: Underground Map
96391.details: Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
96391.objectives: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.
96391.reward: Judging by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force.$B$BThank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.

96392.title: Farsen's Watch
96392.details: Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.$B$BIf ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
96392.objectives: Speak with Earthseer Farsen and ask him to lend you his farsight to observe the Dark Iron threat.
96392.request: Farsight can show ye a great many things, even things ye'd rather not see.
96392.reward: So ye see now, $C? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.$B$BYe look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?

96393.title: Old Ironforge Incursion
96393.details: Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults.$B$BMy Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard.$B$BOh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393.objectives: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
96393.reward: A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.$B$BThe guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.$B$BThank ye for yer service to Ironforge,$C. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.

96394.title: The Restless Dead
96394.details: Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.$B$BHead down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394.objectives: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
96394.request: I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.
96394.reward: Ah good, its done then. I can't have the other keepers refusing to enter the hall to do their duties on account of "ghosts" and "angry dead", can I?

96395.title: An Ancient Grudge
96395.details: The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.$B$BPlease... help him... help him... rest...$B$BConsumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395.objectives: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.

96403.title: Important Heirlooms
96403.details: You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.$B$BI was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.$B$BI assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
96403.objectives: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
96403.request: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403.reward: Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned!$B$BNow, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.

96408.title: A Visitor to Dun Morogh
96408.details: Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.$B$BIt's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
96408.objectives: Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

96604.title: The Great Outdoors
96604.details: Lok-tar, $C. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.$B$BYou'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.$B$BHave a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604.objectives: Sit near Brakk's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96604.request: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96604.reward: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

96626.title: Camping 101: Cooking
96626.details: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $C. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.$B$BCooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626.objectives: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.
96626.request: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96626.reward: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.$B$BRaise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.$B$BYou can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

96627.title: The Adventurer
96627.details: $N, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.$B$BI've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627.objectives: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
96627.reward: I appreciate the lookin' out, $C. That marshal's just a worrywart.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96628.title: The Adventurer
96628.details: Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.$B$BMy mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628.objectives: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer near Kharanos.
96628.request: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628.reward: You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, $C.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96630.title: The Adventurer
96630.objectives: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
96630.request: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96630.reward: Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $C.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96638.title: The Adventurer
96638.details: More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.$B$BSeek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638.objectives: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.

96652.title: The Adventurer
96652.objectives: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.
96652.request: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96652.reward: Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $C.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96656.title: The Adventurer
96656.details: $N, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.$B$BI've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
96656.objectives: Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.
96656.reward: I'm not affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade, if you couldn't tell. I'm just an adventurer stopping by before my next venture into the wilderness.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96658.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96658.request: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96658.reward: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.$B$BRaise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.$B$BYou can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

96659.title: The Adventurer
96659.details: Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.$B$BThere is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
96659.objectives: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.
96659.request: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659.reward: Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, $C.$B$BHey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96661.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96661.objectives: Speak with Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn to become a cook.
96661.request: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96661.reward: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.$B$BRaise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.$B$BYou can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.

96774.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol
96774.details: The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.$B$BOl' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774.objectives: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.

96779.title: Syndicate Sabotage
96779.details: Sometimes, $R, a single cut in the right place will drop a foe dead. The same is often true of organizations.$B$BOur agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.$B$BHe plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.
96779.objectives: Find Lord Tomas inside Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and kill him. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform.
96779.reward: With Tomas dead, Durnholde Keep will no doubt be destabilized. Lowly thugs of the Syndicate's kind often fall to disarray without a figurehead to lead them.$B$BGood work, $N. I may call upon you for future missions.

96781.title: What's the Big Idea?
96781.details: We have noticed a Syndicate scouting party prowling around the ruins of Alterac, led by a man named Barton.$B$BThey're clearly searching for something, but I cannot know what without reading his scouting reports.$B$BI ask that you pickpocket the report from him, rather than killing him outright. Barton's death will tip off the Syndicate that we're on to them, and they will certainly take counter-measures to cover their tracks.$B$BIf you hope to find him, he is most likely among the Syndicate at Strahnbrad.
96781.objectives: Steal Barton's Scouting Report by pickpocketing it from him. Then, bring the report to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

96782.title: Covert Extraction
96782.details: It seems our friend Barton here has made this very easy for us. He is after two heirlooms of the Perenolde family within the ruins of Alterac. The Blade of House Perenolde, a sword, and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde, a shield.$B$BFrom the report, it seems these armaments are within two towers among the ruins. Best we acquire them before the Syndicate does.$B$BThe ogres occupying the ruins are fierce, but I trust you should be able to sneak past them without needing to bloody your blade at all.
96782.objectives: Find the Blade of House Perenolde and the Royal Aegis of Perenolde among the ruins of Alterac. Then, bring them to Myrokos Silentform.

96783.title: A Way In
96783.details: Stromgarde Keep is one of the Syndicate's largest strongholds. Many of the organization's most important dealings take place behind its walls.$B$BI have received word of a certain trade taking place between members of the Syndicate somewhere in Arathi Highlands, and I'm certain the details of this trade can be found somewhere in Stromgarde.$B$BTo infiltrate the keep without arousing suspicion, you'll need a disguise. See if you can find one among the Syndicate outside the keep, at Northfold Manor.
96783.objectives: Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.
96783.reward: <Taking the uniform, you ready yourself for the next part of your mission.>

96784.title: Master of Disguise
96784.objectives: While disguised as a member of the Syndicate, find someone inside Stromgarde Keep who knows about the secret deal.$B$BProvided item:

96785.title: Ain't No Telling
96785.details: Who do you think you are? Showing up and sticking your nose in official business.$B$BI'm not telling some rookie anything about the higher-up's dealings without good reason. Unless you've got something important, or valuable, for me, I've got nothing to say to you.
96785.objectives: Find something within Stromgarde Keep to convince Anastasia to give up details of the secret deal.$B$BProvided item:

96786.title: The Syndicate Sting
96786.details: Falconcrest sent some guys to do a handoff at the southern part of Thoradin's wall. I don't know what they're picking up. Must be good, because everyone involved has kept it a total secret. I don't think the guys picking it up even know what it is.$B$BThat's all I've got. Don't make me regret telling you that.
96786.objectives: Break up the secret deal, and take the object being traded to the Syndicate. Then, return to Myrokos Silentform at Ravenholdt Manor.

96800.title: Past Due
96800.details: You there, $C. I have a matter I could use assistance with.$B$BI just so happen to be writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol, and there's a particular tome I need to complete my research. According to our ledgers, a mage by the name of Doan checked the book out of the old Dalaran library before the Third War and never returned it!$B$BArcanist Doan is now holed up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Retrieve this book for me and you'll be well rewarded.
96800.objectives: Retrieve the book The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery.

96821.title: Legging It
96821.details: We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.$B$BIf your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821.objectives: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
96821.reward: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, $N. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.

96822.title: For Honor
96822.details: We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.$B$BGo to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822.objectives: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
96822.request: Have you done what I asked?
96822.reward: These warriors will always be remembered, $N. You have made sure of that.

96825.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back
96825.details: Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.$B$BI've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825.objectives: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
96825.reward: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!

96873.title: A Pain in the Neck
96873.details: The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.$B$BPractice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
96873.objectives: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
96873.request: What do you have for me, $N?
96873.reward: Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.

96874.title: This Is Spinal Axe
96874.details: Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?$B$BAs part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.
96874.objectives: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
96874.reward: These spines are tougher than I expected, $N! Crafting with them may not be as easy as I thought... but I'll keep working on it!

96875.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
96875.details: Orgrimmar is always expanding, $C. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!$B$BThe hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875.objectives: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
96875.reward: Your work helps Orgrimmar grow. Know that as you walk the city's paths.

96876.title: Ukor's Lost Pack
96876.details: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
96876.objectives: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
96876.reward: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!

96877.title: Halikor's Hoof
96877.details: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.
96877.reward: What a trophy, $C! That must have been some fight!

96895.title: The Argent Emissary
96895.details: Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.$B$BOne of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895.objectives: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
96895.reward: Stay low and try not to be seen, $C. These cultists are not to be trifled with.

96896.title: A Righteous Cause
96896.details: Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.$B$BHe might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.$B$BIf only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...
96896.objectives: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
96896.reward: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.

96897.title: The Cult of the Damned
96897.details: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897.objectives: Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
96897.reward: Thank you for your aid, $C. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.

96898.title: Remnants of War
96898.details: It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.$B$BDuring the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.
96898.objectives: Gather 12 Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
96898.request: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898.reward: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.

96899.title: Bandarion Keep
96899.details: You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.$B$BIf you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
96899.objectives: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
96899.reward: This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was here from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.$B$BWhen we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.$B$BShe even named the keep after... a mutual friend.

96984.title: Heart of Disruption
96984.details: You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.$B$BSo, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.$B$BScavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
96984.objectives: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.$B$BProvided item:

96986.title: The Grave Knight
96986.details: Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.$B$BI care not for the fate of the mage city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986.objectives: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.

96987.title: Opportunistic Education
96987.details: Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.$B$BMy kinda $R!$B$BWhile our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.$B$BHey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
96987.objectives: Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.

96988.title: Source of Power
96988.details: With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.$B$BImagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?$B$BGo to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988.objectives: Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.

97003.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener
97003.details: You there, $C. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.$B$BMost don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.$B$BSeek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.$B$BBlood and thunder, $C.
97003.objectives: Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.
97003.request: It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.$B$BIf these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the qullboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003.reward: Impressive, $C. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.$B$BLok-tar!

97005.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener
97005.details: There are rumors of a colossal abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say it's so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.$B$BFew believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.$B$BGather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me its head.
97005.objectives: Bring Chol'aruk's Head to Bainham in the Barrens.
97005.request: It took six of us to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to kill all but myself and one other before we were able to bring it down.$B$BThis far from alliance lands I should leave it well enough alone. Light knows I'll lose little sleep over a few tauren savages or orcish brutes. However, the honor of my fallen brothers demands action.
97005.reward: My dead men will rest easier knowing that there is one less of these monsters in the world. You've done well, and are a true and stalwart defender of the alliance. Thank you.$B$BGo with honor, $N.

97047.title: The Cook in the Cage
97047.details: Hey! You! You have to help me! I was just out exploring the jungle when, all of a sudden, I was ambushed by these maniacs! I don't know what they plan to do with me, but I've heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, and I don't want part in either!$B$BI don't know how, but you have to get me out of here! Please! A key to this cage, a disguise to sneak out, something! Anything!
97047.objectives: Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.

97048.title: Returning to Port
97048.details: Listen, I can't repay you right now, but I'm a cook on Captain Aransas' ship. I'll be sure to put in a good word for you when I get back to Booty Bay. You should speak to the captain when you get the chance. I'm sure she'll be grateful to have me back.
97048.objectives: Speak to Captain Aransas in Booty Bay.

97066.title: Tip the Scales - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer

97220.title: Philmor's Favor
97220.details: Every day this week we've been short dockhands.$B$BCare to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?$B$BTake this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
97220.objectives: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.
97220.request: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
97220.reward: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.

97222.title: Gatehouse Goods
97222.details: Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself!$B$BTrias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.$B$BPlace the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.
97222.objectives: Carry the Gatehouse Shipment up the stairs in Trias' shop and leave it outside the door.$B$BProvided item:
97222.reward: Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.$B$BConsider us professionally acquainted, $C.$B$BWe respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.

97223.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch
97223.details: All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.$B$BOne raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223.objectives: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
97223.request: The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.$B$BUnfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.$B$BStill I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
97223.reward: Thank you, $N. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.

97225.title: Forgotten Loa Idols
97225.details: When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.$B$BThe followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.$B$BThis is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.$B$BGo, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225.objectives: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
97225.request: Have you found our loa idols, $N? We must begin our rituals again soon.
97225.reward: You have done a great deed for our tribe today.$B$BUnlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.$B$BI would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.

97234.title: Reading Room
97234.details: Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?$B$BWell, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.$B$BComplimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.
97234.objectives: Bring the wrapped reading material to the Stormwind library.
97234.reward: Let's see here. Roy's Book Club, isn't it? I recognize this wrap technique.$B$BWell, if he says this is what people want to talk about, it's all fine by me. The material we receive back is always in as good of quality as we loaned it, so we know they're treating it with respect regardless of how provoking the words may be.

97236.title: Fang of Githyiss
97236.details: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
97236.objectives: Deliver the Fang of Githyiss to someone interested in the study of spiders in Aldrassil.
97236.reward: My, my. How I do love surprises, $N.$B$BThis specimen will surely help further my studies.

97237.title: Shelf Picked
97237.details: I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.$B$BYou will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.$B$BReturning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.$B$BGood day, $N.
97237.objectives: Find each of the reading materials located somewhere in the library and then return to Roy Lewells in Stormwind's Park.
97237.request: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.
97237.reward: These are them! Some of them even smell exotic! Fantastic, I can't wait for us to have lively conversations about these writings.$B$BCellar after hours, of course.$B$BThanks for the quick errand run, $N. As promised, it's on the house. We keep our word here.

97242.title: Yelmak's Medley
97242.details: Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.$B$BHe told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.$B$BGather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242.objectives: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.
97242.request: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with it in their own way.
97242.reward: This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.$B$BI'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.

97243.title: Call of Fire
97243.details: Even though we are in the realm of Skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.$B$BBring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
97243.objectives: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
97243.request: Yes, $N? What do you have there?
97243.reward: So you've brought the torch. Yes, young $C, I can teach you to heed the call of fire. It will not be easy, but nothing that we do in this realm is ever easy.

97244.title: Call of Fire
97244.details: There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of his former brothers and sisters.$B$BYou will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
97244.objectives: Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.
97244.request: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.
97244.reward: The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor.$B$BThis heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to done.

97245.title: Call of Fire
97245.details: The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.$B$BGo to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.$B$BBe warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.
97245.objectives: Find the home of Kuramaa in the Shen'dar Highlands, and defeat the spirit in combat. Bring Kuramaa's Mask to Olariaan Swiftburn in the Gustberry Lowlands when you are victorious.
97245.request: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. It's mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.
97245.reward: We now have what we need. We will light the eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.

97246.title: Meal Appeal
97246.details: My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!$B$BPlease, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.$B$BDuties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246.objectives: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
97246.reward: Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.$B$BSometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.

97249.title: Favorite Food
97249.details: Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea.$B$BThey made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily.$B$BTake this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249.objectives: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.
97249.request: I think we can win this one...
97249.reward: Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?$B$BOh!$B$BWow... this smells really good! Yummy.$B$BThanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong flavored crumbs.$B$BIf it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!

97250.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
97250.details: Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.$B$BRumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.$B$BKill first, investigate later!
97250.objectives: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
97250.reward: So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory.$B$BHowever, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time.$B$BIn any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!

97253.title: Parts and Pieces
97253.details: Hey, got a sec?$B$BSo, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!$B$BI need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253.objectives: Collect 5 Handfuls of Complicated Parts from the upper pirate camp south of Ratchet, then return to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet.
97253.request: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253.reward: Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype.$B$BUhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?

97257.title: Call of Fire
97257.details: Now we will perform the ritual.$B$BI will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.$B$BCarry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.
97257.objectives: Wait for Olariaan to begin the ritual at the Brazier of Offering and follow his instructions.$B$BYou must deliver the Eternal Flame to Valanaar before the timer runs out.
97257.request: You have done well to come this far. You do the Windshapers honor, $N.
97257.reward: It is done. The Eternal Flame burns once again.$B$BYour trial is now complete. I am pleased to present you with your Fire Totem. Use this icon of power well in your travels, $N.$B$BJust remember, the power of the elemental plane serves those that respect it, and consumes those who do not. This is our way.

97263.title: Your Package Has Arrived
97263.details: misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">
97263.reward: What! I've been going to the mailbox by the bank every day looking for this package! This city needs to figure out its layout. Not easy to navigate like Aerie Peak!$B$BLet's see what I've got... totem carving tools... spare axe... some kind of goblin device? I didn't order that! Ah, I'll just send it back.$B$BEr, uh... I mean... thank you for bringing all of this to me. Here's a little something for your trouble.

97265.title: Hate the Hatefury
97265.details: Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?$B$BI have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?$B$BBah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.$B$BNow, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.
97265.objectives: Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.

97275.title: Whuut's the Rush
97275.details: Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.$B$BHe is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.$B$BGive him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275.request: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...
97275.reward: Grorru--whaa?$B$BYou say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day.$B$BMaybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.$B$B$N, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.

97277.title: Grund and Gozwin
97277.details: Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!$B$BWicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.$B$BLuckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.$B$BHead back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277.objectives: Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler.
97277.request: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277.reward: Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'!$B$BGoz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.$B$BThanks, $N. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.

97279.title: Wayward Weapons
97279.details: With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.$B$BWhile you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279.objectives: Collect 6 Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
97279.request: Throm'ka, $C. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!$B$BWere you able to collect the training weapons I requested?
97279.reward: Thank you for returning these weapons, $N. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.

97281.title: A Simmering Storm
97281.details: Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281.objectives: Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
97281.reward: Woah, where did you find a neat thing like that? Ya know it reminds me of the other thing my boss Gazlowe always used to tell me...

97282.title: Stormy Potential
97282.details: "Rezlack, when an opportunity comes knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.$B$BThis orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!$B$BThere are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.$B$BGo harvest some and bring them back to me!
97282.objectives: Bring 5 Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
97282.request: It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.$B$BWell, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.$B$BTrust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.
97282.reward: Hey, thanks pal! You've been a really big help to me here and I appreciate it.$B$BHere's to hoping I can get this all charged up using these organs. I bet it'll make those no good harpies think twice about attacking my caravan again. I sure hope this works.$B$BEither way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.

97284.title: Vahlarriel's Vengeance
97284.details: If Malem is still alive, then I suspect the Burning Blade orcs are expecting someone to come searching for her soon enough. They will certainly be ready for a fight.$B$BI would prefer if you kept a low profile and stayed out of their way, but the far more likely reality is that they will be looking to meet you, blade to Burning Blade, at every opportunity.$B$BSo how about we plan to keep score from the start. Kill as many as you can, and I'll make it worth your time.
97284.objectives: Slay Burning Blade orcs at Thunder Axe Fortress in the Desolace, then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel's Point.

97286.title: Research Access
97286.details: Your actions show you are one who respects knowledge. The library is open for use in your studies.

97287.title: Shrewd Negotiations
97287.details: You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.$B$BAs much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?$B$BTake the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.
97287.objectives: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.

97288.title: Unending Torment
97288.objectives: Deliver the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell within the Undercity.
97288.reward: Oho! I believe I know this head. A cruel joke by our Dark Lady. A delicious one at that.$B$BI think I have a use for this.

97289.title: Unending Torment
97289.details: We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.$B$BOoh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.$B$BGo ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289.objectives: Bring the Head of the Baron to the body of Othmar in the Undercity.
97289.request: <The abomination remains lifeless without a head to control it.>
97289.reward: <The body twitches to life, panicking as it relives its final moments.>$B$BYou...

97290.title: Unending Torment
97290.details: You... abomination...$B$BWhy should... help you...$B$BBe gone...
97290.objectives: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97290.reward: Not cooperating, eh? Excellent. I always love a challenge.

97291.title: Unending Torment
97291.details: With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.$B$BWe simply need to motivate it.$B$BFetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.$B$BWe have a potion to make!
97291.objectives: Collect a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed near the Herbalism Trainer, and Essence of Agony from the poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter for Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
97291.request: It will be ever so lovely to have our lost sheep returned to the fold, don't you think?
97291.reward: These will do nicely. We will see how much bravado our honored guest retains after he is subjected to my masterpiece.

97292.title: Unending Torment
97292.details: I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.$B$BTake this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.$B$BAnd try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
97292.objectives: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
97292.request: For Othmar's crimes against the Dark Lady, placing him under that oozing specimen is the least he deserves.$B$BAnd it's funny...
97292.reward: Excellent. We'll let his flesh simmer for awhile. Give him time to acclimate to his new home.$B$BI have no further use for the wretch for now, but we shall keep an eye on him. I have many plans for Othmar's future.

97326.title: Rocks to Rests
97326.details: Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.$B$BThis spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.$B$BYou're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326.objectives: Return 8 Smooth Boulders to Thra behind Grommash Hold.
97326.request: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326.reward: How can you even hold all of those boulders!$B$BThose are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.$B$BThanks, $N!

97328.title: Anything of Value
97328.objectives: Recover 8 Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.

97329.title: Where's the Key?
97329.details: You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down!$B$BI screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here!$B$BI survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage!$B$BLook, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.
97329.objectives: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.

97331.title: Zimmix's Great Escape
97331.details: Wait, wait, don't go yet!$B$BI know I said I just needed the key but... well, they caught me once, they could do it again, right? I'm just one goblin, and there's hundreds of trolls around here!$B$BYou've already put enough of a dent in their numbers to get this key, so it should be easy enough to stand guard while we mosey on out of here, huh?
97331.objectives: Escort Zimmix Sputterspark away from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda then tell Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay of your successful rescue.

97420.title: Reduce, Reuse, Reconcile
97420.details: I have a favor to ask of someone, and you look helpful!$B$BYou see this baby here? Ain't she a beaut? This is my newest racer, designed and built all by myself, because SOMEONE wouldn't help. I plan on taking this to the races in Thousand Needles, but it needs a little extra kick.$B$BNow, I'm too handsome to be a goblin, and I know better than to trust their tech, but I know the Venture Co struck liquid gold over at the lake. I'm sure they won't mind if you, erm, borrowed some? They won't even notice!
97420.objectives: Acquire 5 Drums of Crude Oil from the Venture Co. operations at Lake Nazferiti, then return to Knaz Blunderflame in Stranglethorn Vale.

97485.title: Traditions of the Bluff
97485.details: Blessings of An'she, friend.$B$BWe tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.$B$BYou will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.$B$BYou will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485.objectives: Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.$B$BCombine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.
97485.request: There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors.$B$BOr it could be something else entirely.$B$BThough the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.
97485.reward: You have done well, friend.$B$BI thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, $N. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.$B$BShould you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.$B$BGo with An'she's warmth.

97538.title: Pigments for Paints
97538.details: Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.$B$BIn the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
97538.objectives: Tah Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff wants 30 Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake.
97538.request: You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?$B$BWe tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538.reward: Ah, thank you, $N.$B$BIt means much to me to have you venture all the way out there for what must seem a trivial notion from an old tauren, but with your kindness I will have enough pigment for the rest of the season.$B$BThank you for supporting my livelihood, and I will strive to create something magnificent with the pigments you have brought.

97539.title: Silky Sutures
97539.details: This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.$B$BWe are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.$B$BUnder pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.$B$B$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
97539.objectives: Return 12 Surgical Spidersilk to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands.

97558.title: Hides for the Forsaken
97558.details: One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?$B$BWell, it doesn't.$B$BOurs is a cursed life, $N. We must take from the living to further our own existence.$B$BWhen we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!$B$BBring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558.objectives: Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 Duskbat Wing Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
97558.request: Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.$B$BIt may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.$B$BSimilarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558.reward: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.

97583.title: WRIGGLE.
97583.objectives: Purchase Nutritious Slime Sludge and return to your befriended excitable slime. If it seems tired, try dancing with it again to catch its attention.
97583.request: <The slime seems to regard you with interest.>
97583.reward: <The slime shudders with newfound energy. It seems to want to follow you, now that it has associated you with food.>

97891.title: Prompt Potion Runner
97891.details: You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!$B$BIt has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.$B$BJust another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.$B$BBut we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!$B$B<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
97891.objectives: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.$B$BProvided item:
97891.reward: Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!$B$BHere, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?$B$BIf not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.

97894.title: Business in Auberdine
97894.details: Pleasure to make yer acquaintance! Name's Borgus, of the one and only Steelhand family. You can always count on a Steelhand fer a fair deal!$B$BA few weeks back me brother Gorbold joined up with a merchant stall in Auberdine. Plenty of coin to be made supplyin' ships there, let me tell you! Lucky sod.$B$BI haven't heard from him since--mind checking on him if yer heading that way?$B$BThere's a new ship in the harbor that will take ye straight there. Head to the southern-most dock; can't miss it!
97894.objectives: Check on Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore.$B$BBorgus mentioned a boat on the southern-most dock in Stormwind Harbor that can take you there.
97894.reward: Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.$B$BWe could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.

97899.title: Camping 101: Alchemy
97899.details: So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97899.objectives: Speak with Whuut in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97899.reward: There ya have it, directions for your very own Mana Well. Most folks don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to try it out.$B$BNo camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those as the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check in with someone who can train you in cooking if you haven't already learned the basics.

97900.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
97900.details: So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97900.objectives: Speak with Dwukk in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97900.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97901.title: Camping 101: Enchanting
97901.details: Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97901.objectives: Speak with Jhag in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97901.reward: There you have it, you can craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folks don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to try it out.$B$BNo camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those as the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check in with someone who can train you in cooking if you haven't already learned the basics.

97902.title: Camping 101: Engineering
97902.details: Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97902.objectives: Speak with Mukdrak in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97902.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97903.title: Camping 101: First Aid
97903.details: So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $C.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97903.objectives: Speak with Rawrk in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97903.request: I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.
97903.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97904.title: Camping 101: Fishing
97904.details: You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97904.objectives: Speak with Lau'Tiki near Sen'jin Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97904.request: I can teach you once you've gained some skill as a fisherman.
97904.reward: Dere ya have it, ya be craftin' your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't be carin' much for camps being set up in da center of town, so ya be needin' ta head into da wilderness if ya be wantin' to try it out.$B$BNo camp is complete without a campfire, mon. Ya be needin' one of dose before ya be startin' up your camp. Most cooks be teachin' ya ta make a fire. Check in with someone who can train ya in da culinary arts if ya haven't already learned da basics.

97905.title: Camping 101: Herbalism
97905.details: Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97905.objectives: Speak with Jandi in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97905.reward: Dere ya have it, ya be craftin' your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't be carin' much for camps being set up in da center of town, so ya be needin' ta head into da wilderness if ya be wantin' to try it out.$B$BNo camp is complete without a campfire, mon. Ya be needin' one of dose before ya be startin' up your camp. Most cooks be teachin' ya ta make a fire. Check in with someone who can train ya in da culinary arts if ya haven't already learned da basics.

97906.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking
97906.details: You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $C. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.$B$BWith a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97906.objectives: Speak with Karolek in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97906.reward: There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97907.title: Camping 101: Mining
97907.details: Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97907.objectives: Speak with Krunn in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97907.request: I can teach you to develop your skills.
97907.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97908.title: Camping 101: Skinning
97908.details: Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. 97914.title: Expanding Horizons
97914.details: Auberdine is a humble place, $C. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.$B$BYet Auberdine remains in their shadow.$B$BI would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.$B$BMake our home known.
97914.objectives: Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.$B$BThundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there.
97914.request: I can smell the sea on you, friend!$B$B<Baros laughs.>$B$BWhat brings you to Stormwind?
97914.reward: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>

97926.title: Making Do
97926.details: I wish it was that easy to help, $C. I really do.$B$BShould you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.$B$BGive this reply to the elder the next time you see him.
