You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97943.objectives: Speak with Astaia in Darnassus to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97943.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. 97977.title: Nature's Call
97977.details: The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.$B$BSearch their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.$B$BYou'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977.objectives: Collect 4 Gnarlpine Totems and bring them to Tarindrella.
97977.request: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977.reward: Oh, it's even worse than I thought.$B$BThese engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you...$B$BOur only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, $N.

97979.title: The Goddess Provides
97979.details: You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.$B$BOur Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.$B$BDemonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979.request: There are few joys so great as basking in Mother Moon's light.
97979.reward: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.

97985.title: Thundering Hearts
97985.details: Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.$B$BI have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!$B$BI hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!$B$BOh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
97985.objectives: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.
97985.request: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your flesh and organs would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.
97985.reward: Excellent! I can hardly contain my excitement. Oh, and the heart still has electrical pulses? That's impressive. I won't have to shock it back to life then!$B$BThis heart will be a wonderful addition to the abomination, and certainly looks to be the specified size, if these notes are correct.$B$BAh, I love it when a plan comes together.

98013.title: Swelling Forces
98013.details: Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.$B$BScores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.$B$BWhat they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.$B$BWar is what they seek, $C. War... is what we will bring.
98013.objectives: Eliminate 12 Stormscale Myrmidons, 8 Stormscale Sorceresses, and 6 Stormscale Warriors for Arbal at the Grove of the Ancients.
98013.reward: Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master...$B$BIt is unforgivable.

98021.title: Journey to Sentinel Hill
98021.details: If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.$B$BAfter journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.$B$BGood luck out there, adventurer!
98021.objectives: Report To Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
98021.reward: I've been begging Stormwind for aid for months and he sends me a skinny elf? Well, beggars can't be choosers I suppose.$B$BWelcome to Westfall, $C. Let's see if we can't put you to work.

98024.title: Journey to the Crossroads
98024.details: After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.$B$BIf you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.$B$BGo with honor, adventurer!
98024.objectives: Report To Thork at The Crossroads in The Barrens.
98024.reward: What's this? An elf? And you say the Warchief sent you?$B$B<Thork grunts sharply as he looks you up and down.>$B$BYou look a little skinny to me, but it matters not. Out here you'll either thrive and survive, or you'll die. That is the way of things in these lands.

98025.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel
98025.details: Attention!$B$BA reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".$B$BUnfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.$B$BJai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.$B$BReward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.$B$BThe Auberdine Village Council
98025.objectives: Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
98025.request: Greetings $C - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025.reward: It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her decent into madness.$B$BRegardless, thank you for your service today, $C. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.

98027.title: Gleaming Crescent Necklace
98027.details: Maliynn". Perhaps it belongs to Maliynn in Astranaar?>
98027.objectives: Deliver the Crescent Necklace to Maliynn in Astranaar.$B$BProvided item:
98027.reward: Oh my! I can't believe you found this. I thought I had looked everywhere!$B$BI had lost it when I went to deliver supplies to one of our outposts, but after searching along the road I had given up.$B$BThank you for bringing this back to me. It was a gift from my late parents, and I can't express how much it means to have it back.

98028.title: Baron Marinous
98028.details: All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.$B$BWhatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.$B$BOnly Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028.objectives: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
98028.request: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, $R... what have you brought me?
98028.reward: <Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>$B$BStairs descending down in Mathystra? Could be it be?$B$B<Onu shakes his head.>$B$BI must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.$B$BPlease accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.

98042.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...
98042.details: Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>$B$BThey have failed.$B$BYou will be forgotten.$B$BThey will lose the eye they gained.
98042.objectives: Obtain a Peerless Eye from a Twilight Disciple or Thug at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore and find someone in Auberdine who is willing to take it.
98042.request: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042.reward: <Thundris does not speak for some time.>$B$BThis bears the mark of an ancient evil, $C. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.$B$BAnde'thoras-ethil.

98046.title: Crown of the Earth
98046.details: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>$B$BYou're still here?$B$BTake the phial and get out of my sight, $C. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before.$B$BPerhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.$B$B<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>$B$BI must look elsewhere if this is to work...
98046.objectives: Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98046.reward: Do not mind the Arch Druid, $N. He bears the weight of much in Malfurion's absence.$B$BWait! Some drops yet remain in the phial! Perhaps that is why his incantation failed?

98059.title: Hillsbrad's Hoard
98059.details: Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence.$B$BWe're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound.$B$BWalk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table.$B$BReturn to me when the deed is done.
98059.objectives: Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.$B$BProvided item:
98059.reward: Good work, soldier. I know you're not stationed with us, but we never turn away capable hands.$B$BIf they don't respond to THIS letter, we'll have to be more crude in our messaging.$B$BWe'll keep you on reserve for civilian interactions should the need arise again.

98065.title: Crown of the Earth
98065.details: You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.$B$BDo not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.$B$BShe will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
98065.objectives: Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98065.request: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.
98065.reward: Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone.$B$B<Tyrande's face settles.>$B$BI apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome.$B$BFandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills.$B$BEvery drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.

98067.title: Eyes of the Sentinels
98067.details: General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.$B$BYou may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.$B$BSomething is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067.objectives: Place Sentinel Owls at the entrance to the Cenarion Hold depths, the Darnassus Bank, the Craftsman's Terrace Inn, and the City Gate for Sentinel Dalia Sunblade in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.$B$BProvided item:
98067.request: We must remain vigilant, for though Darnassus is well-protected our enemies are everywhere.
98067.reward: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.

98069.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies
98069.details: Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.$B$BI'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
98069.objectives: Bring 8 Stolen Freewind Supplies to Jandia in Freewind Post.
98069.request: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069.reward: Thank you, $N. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.

98070.title: Stop the Screeching
98070.details: The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.$B$BI fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.$B$BGo, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
98070.objectives: Slay 5 Screeching Harpies, 5 Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and 5 Screeching Windcaller Harpies.
98070.reward: This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.

98071.title: Brewer's Trade
98071.details: Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars.$B$BBring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.$B$BIn return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.$B$BThat keep is the closest thing to home around here!
98071.objectives: Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.$B$BProvided item:
98071.request: Lookin' ta try a new ale?
98071.reward: That's the hops smell I missed! Ye done me a great favor, $N, takes me days to leave every time I make the trip to Dun Garok myself. Hard to pull me self outta the halls o' that fortress once I get comfortable.$B$BHappy to keep some old tastes on the shelf for fellow dwarves.$B$BHave a little somethin' for helpin out.

98072.title: Crocs of the Sky
98072.details: You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.$B$BThe crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.$B$BCrocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!$B$BYou'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!
98072.objectives: Collect 8 Pristine Crimson Scales and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
98072.request: Ah, $N! Do you have those scales?
98072.reward: You're a real natural talent! Say, if you ever decide to take a break from the adventuring life, you come on back to your buddy James. I'll put you right to work!$B$BAlthough, I suppose you'll be even older by then. Oh well!

98093.title: Field to Clear
98093.details: I'm so glad you saw me!$B$BThe weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.$B$BScrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.$B$BWould you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
98093.objectives: Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out 7 Stormhide lizards and 7 Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.
98093.request: There might be a chance to get down without them noticing me soon...
98093.reward: Thank you for helping me out, $N. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day!$B$BThis is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you.$B$BI'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.

98094.title: Scout Support
98094.details: Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.$B$BBring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.$B$BOur plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094.objectives: High Executor Darthalia wants you to deliver updated orders to Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill, outside of Dun Garok.
98094.reward: Quaint. A fresh face for the field work.$B$BWell, let's see what you have then.

98095.title: Valuable Vantages
98095.details: Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.$B$BTake these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.$B$BLook for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.
98095.objectives: Deathstalker Masoj needs you to place the three Apothecary Vials on peaks around Hillsbrad Foothills and return to him.$B$BProvided item:
98095.reward: Good work. We advance the plans.$B$BDeathstalkers dare.$B$BLet purpose guide your strikes, $N.

98155.title: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts
98155.details: The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!$B$BI would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.$B$BI don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
98155.objectives: Bring 5 Pristine Pesterhide Pelts to Kristy Grant.
98155.request: Were you able to collect the pelts? Rendow has promised to help me clean and tan them to send back home! I know my sisters will be very excited.
98155.reward: Thank you, $N! These hides are in perfect condition. I can't imagine it was easy to get so many, but I am very grateful to you for your work.

98156.title: Packaged Pristine Pelts
98156.details: $N, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead?$B$BI am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.
98156.objectives: Bring the Package of Pristine Pelts to Kimberly Grant.$B$BProvided item:
98156.reward: This is from our sister? We hadn't heard from her in some time. I hope she is doing well.$B$BMy, these pelts have such a beautiful color of fur! Kelly and I will make sure we put these to good use.$B$BThank you for making the long journey. It is good to know Kristy is still doing well and is thinking of us.

98189.title: Return the Statuette
98189.details: My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!$B$BThe Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!$B$BI believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?
98189.objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.
98189.request: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.
98189.reward: You managed to get it back from those monsters! There aren't too many artifacts of the late king left now.

98190.title: A Friend of the Family
98190.details: You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.$B$BThe Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.$B$BDon't bother going up the chain of command on this one, $glad:lass;. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
98190.objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
98190.request: Let us speak, $C. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190.reward: You have my gratitude for recovering this. I am relieved it did not fall into the wrong hands.

98191.title: A Friend of the Family
98191.details: King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.$B$BThe irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.$B$BIt seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
98191.objectives: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.
98191.request: Light be with you, $C. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191.reward: By the Light... it looks just like his boy...$B$B<Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.>$B$BThis statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength.$B$BIt is best kept here for now, under guard of the paladin order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead.$B$BThank you, $C. Light bless you.

98197.title: Spoils of War
98197.details: This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!$B$BSo many lives lost...$B$BWhat's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!$B$BPlenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197.objectives: Recover 6 Khaz Modan Timber and 30 Khaz Modan Iron from Menethil Harbor for Valstag Ironjaw.
98197.request: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197.reward: Ah! A bit damp, but nothing a few days in the sun won't fix.$B$BThank you, $C. It's nice to not solely rely on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine for once!

98208.title: Bloom of the Heavens
98208.details: I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.$B$BMy people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.$B$BPlease help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
98208.objectives: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.
98208.request: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
98208.reward: It has survived! Oh, Elune be praised!$B$BA thousand thanks, $N. If you are willing, I do have one more favor to ask of you...

98209.title: Bloom of the Heavens
98209.details: Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?$B$BThe boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.$B$BI apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!
98209.objectives: Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.$B$BYou recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there.
98209.request: I welcome you to Auberdine, $C. How may we be of aid to you in your travels?
98209.reward: The Nord'el survived? It cannot be... after all these years!$B$BOur goddess is most wonderful indeed!$B$BYou have my thanks for delivering it here. It is a rare light in the dark times we have had of late, and a symbol of not only Elune's grace, but of the enduring will of our people to persevere without our immortality.$B$BI will see to it that it is transported safely to Darnassus, so that it may be properly cultivated.

98216.title: Understanding Our Present
98216.details: Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all!$B$BI've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone!$B$BTake it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!$B$BIf I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!
98216.objectives: Use the Goaz Stone near the Goaz Warder and bring its Titanic Keystone back to Prospector Whelgar.$B$BProvided item:
98216.reward: Look there--see how the Goaz Stone starts to glow when near the keystone? I can almost make out some more words...$B$BWe still must learn more about this Goaz. I feel like we're just on the tip of the iceberg with something huge!

98219.title: The Shamed Lieutenant
98219.details: Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, $N.$B$BI could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.$B$BHis father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.$B$BThere is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98219.objectives: Speak to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
98219.reward: Ah, of course. Another one of Stormwind's finest here to check on me. Same as last month!

98221.title: From the Ashes
98221.details: In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!$B$BThey were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.$B$BDun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221.objectives: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.
98221.request: Wars are won--and lost--on information. You would do well to remember that.
98221.reward: Ironforge as well? Nek'rosh certainly has his father's ambition!$B$BWhat he lacks, of course, is the enslaved army of red drakes that proved so devastating in the war. He's made a gambit, alright--one he will pay for dearly.

98223.title: Old Habits
98223.details: This book has been badly burned--perhaps by the dragonfire that destroyed much of the Dragonmaw clan.$B$BOf what little is legible, it seems to describe rituals relating to the use of the Demon Soul that the clan had used to control the dragons.$B$BIt is far too incomplete to be of real use, but based on roughly inserted pages on animal hide it seems Nek'rosh had attempted to salvage it. Freshly dried ink mentions a "Shadow Council."$B$BCaptain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor would want to know about this.
98223.objectives: Bring the Tattered Spellbook to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor.
98223.request: I can practically hear the cries of the Dragonmaw from here! They deserve every bit of it and more.
98223.reward: It's best we destroy this. Useful or not, we're not in the business of taking chances with any of those foul orcs.$B$BThe last thing we need are dragonriders on our doorstep!$B$BAnd this Shadow Council business... most troubling. I'll send word to my superiors at once.

98230.title: This Land Was Their Land
98230.details: After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol.$B$BIt was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish.$B$BIt didn't last long, sadly.$B$BHowin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand.
98230.objectives: Find Howin Kindfeather east of Menethil Harbor, along the road.
98230.reward: If yer here to help, I won't say no. Help's awful hard to come by these days.

98240.title: Crimson Crate Delivery
98240.details: Word is officially out on those whelps, $N. We already have an order in!$B$BI'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise!$B$BThese will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar.
98240.objectives: Bring the Crimson Crate to Howin Kindfeather off the road to the east of Menethil Harbor.
98240.reward: These are perfect. Thank ye for making the journey.

98245.title: Razormaw Needling
98245.details: I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.$B$B<Howin spits.>$B$BI aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.$B$BThese whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.$B$BThe Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.$B$BBring me a handful of the incisors.
98245.objectives: Collect 10 Razormaw Incisors for Howin Kindfeather.
98245.request: Any luck prying those teeth off? I need 'em whole so they don't snap on the scales right away.
98245.reward: These'll make a beautiful set of awls. Thank ye.

98246.title: Trying Times
98246.details: I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.$B$BThey need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.$B$BTake some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.$B$BLet's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.
98246.objectives: Gather 12 Perfect Razormaw Eggs for Howin Kindfeather.
98246.request: The Razormaw won't be none too happy about you taking their eggs, so be ready for a squabble.
98246.reward: They're not for me plan--they're to feed Bassbeak. She's of no help at all if she's hungry, trust me. She might be more dangerous than the orcs if she's ticked off!$B$BUntainted food can be hard to come by in these lands as of late...

98247.title: Shipping Label
98247.details: shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.$B$B"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."$B$BBeside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247.objectives: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub in Redridge Mountains.
98247.request: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247.reward: You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.$B$BWhen you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.$B$BNow, do you happen to have the crate this came from?

98248.title: Shipping Label
98248.details: shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.$B$B"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"$B$BBeside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98248.objectives: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade hub near the Crossroads in the Barrens.
98248.request: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?
98248.reward: You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.$B$BAll we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find out during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!$B$BDo you happen to have the crate this label came with?

98251.title: Never Coming Back
98251.details: Gaaah!$B$BI'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?$B$BOne moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?$B$BWhen I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.$B$BCould you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.
98251.objectives: Kill 6 Shadowhorn Stag and 6 Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.
98251.request: Once I get out of this place, I'm never returning.
98251.reward: Ha! That's right, you beasts!$B$BThanks. That does seem to already have helped.

98252.title: A Void Path
98252.details: Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path.$B$BI'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest.$B$BI can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.
98252.objectives: Show Va'xug's Eye of Kilrogg the way back to the main Ashenvale road.
98252.reward: <You hear the voice of Va'xug echoing from within the floating eye.>$B$B"Was it that simple? No matter. This vision will assist me in wrangling my unruly Voidwalker along the correct trail when I resummon him. Thank you, traveler. Cut through this forest with sure steps."$B$B<The Eye of Kilrogg begins to dissipate.>

98282.title: Alchemical Hazards
98282.details: Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!$B$BI need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!$B$BCan you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282.objectives: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
98282.request: Have you had any luck? I know it's a pain to ask, but I really do need a whole gland!
98282.reward: Oh, perfect! This is exactly what I need. You're a real hero, you know.$B$BPlease, I'd be remiss if I didn't share some of the fruits of your labors with you. Stay safe out there!

98283.title: Carnage
98283.details: The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.$B$BI fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.$B$BIt will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.$B$BCarnage will come. Bring me its head.
98283.objectives: Bring Carnage's Head to Rethiel the Greenwarden in The Green Belt.
98283.request: The Rotclaw came down from their homes in Loch Modan, now driven mad.$B$BSuch a waste of life's boon.
98283.reward: Carnage's death will bring balance to his pack. Perhaps it will buy enough time for the greater ecosystem they support.$B$BWe shall see, but I thank you for the effort regardless.

98284.title: Camping 101: Enchanting
98284.details: Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98284.objectives: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98284.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

98285.title: Camping 101: Engineering
98285.details: An engineer is ever-resourceful, and if you are in the wilds alone, it's always good to be able to put your trade to use. No good camp is complete without a few helpful constructs!$B$BYes, come back and see me when you've gained a little bit of experience as an engineer and I can show you how to make something special!
98285.objectives: Speak with the Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98285.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

98286.title: Camping 101: Enchanting
98286.details: Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98286.objectives: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98286.reward: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.$B$BOh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

98287.title: Camping 101: Engineering
98287.details: Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.$B$BI reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
98287.objectives: Speak with Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

98291.title: Death to the Dragonmaw
98291.details: I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, $N. Or at least learn a thing or two.$B$BDon't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.$B$BRegardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.$B$BI need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.
98291.objectives: Kill 8 Dragonmaw Reclaimers, 5 Dragonmaw Soulbinders, and 3 Dragonmaw Infiltrators in Dragonmaw Retreat for Howin Kindfeather.
98291.reward: You won't catch me mournin' their ilk. They deserve their fate.

98293.title: Forced Disarmament
98293.details: The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.$B$BCaptain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.
98293.objectives: Collect 30 Dragonmaw Armaments in Dragonmaw Retreat, then bring them to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.
98293.reward: Well done! Very well done!$B$BWe can definitely put these to use in replenishing our men. Half of these are from our own soldiers to begin with.$B$BFewer weapons in the hands of the enemy and more in ours is my kind of math, $C.

98297.title: Stopping the Cycle
98297.details: I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!$B$BThe very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.$B$BAbsolutely not. Not again.$B$BYou have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.$B$BNone of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.
98297.objectives: Kill the Subdued Dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates for Howin Kindfeather.
98297.reward: I can't thank ye enough, $N. Truly, I cannae do enough for what ye've done today.$B$BMuch remains to be done before Grim Batol might hear the laughter of wee dwarven children echo through its halls again, but it's a mighty good step closer.$B$BFor all of the dwarves lost in those dark days, we may yet reclaim what was ours.$B$BHere's hopin', anyway.

98298.title: Arugal's Folly
98298.details: Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.$B$BThese shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.$B$BGo to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
98298.objectives: Bring 6 Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
98298.request: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
98298.reward: It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.$B$BThese pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.$B$BRegrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.

98299.title: Stop the Spread
98299.details: If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine--be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.$B$BWhile I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.$B$BGo to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal. And try not to get bit, $R.
98299.objectives: Slay 5 Sickly Refugees and 5 Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
98299.reward: It seems the Gilneans are not too keen on allowing anyone past their wall. That is fortunate, I suppose. It means there is likely no chance for the worgen curse to spread to their city.$B$BCan you imagine the depravity if an entire kingdom were infected?

98300.title: Word to Ironforge
98300.details: My work here is far from over, $N. And I need tae send word to me wife Claira in Aerie Peak--and get Falstad an update as well.$B$BBut that's my business. Wildhammer business.$B$BThat said, you ought tae let King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge know about all this as well. Wetlands is but a stone's throw from his lands, and none of what's happenin' here is good news on one's doorstep. This letter oughta do the trick.$B$BYe can travel back through Dun Algaz or fly from Menethil Harbor to get to Ironforge.
98300.objectives: Deliver Howin's Missive to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
98300.request: Welcome to Ironforge, $C. I am King Magni Bronzebeard, ruler of these lands.
98300.reward: Ah, the Wildhammer. Yes, I know them well. They may not call me sovereign, but our relations have improved greatly as of late--the Thandol Span is a testament to that.$B$BIf what this Howin reports is true, then we must prepare for further action on our northern borders. Grim Batol has a deep, bloody history, and I'm well aware of its strategic significance.$B$BFor your efforts in helping the Wildhammer in the Wetlands, and the Alliance in Menethil Harbor as well, you have my thanks.

98310.title: Gleaning Our Future
98310.details: There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found!$B$BI'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!$B$BYou'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.
98310.objectives: Use the Goaz Stone near Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru and bring their hearts back to Prospector Whelgar.$B$BProvided item:
98310.request: Be careful out there. I suspect these constructs will be tougher than the warder was.
98310.reward: By Magni's beard, they're beautiful! Wait a second, do you see that?! Hold the hearts closer to the Goaz Stone for a moment...$B$B<New text reveals itself on the stone in a faint shimmering light.>$B$BHmm, it's hard to make out. "Curse of Flesh... they will fail." What's that supposed to mean?!$B$BWe've got to get this somewhere safe so we can study it further!

98313.title: For Further Study
98313.details: Whatever this is all about, $N, it's epic stuff alright.$B$BI'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.$B$BIt'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!
98313.objectives: Bring the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
98313.request: Apologies, I'm terribly, terribly busy. Did you need something?
98313.reward: Well I'll be...$B$BThis is a lot to go through! Very exciting, though. VERY exciting!$B$BIt'll take me some time to even put a plan together on this one. Come back another time and I can give you the latest. For now, please accept the thanks of the Explorers' League.

98319.title: Secure the Mountain
98319.details: It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.$B$BIf we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.$B$BHead into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.
98319.objectives: Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen.
98319.request: Any news? I told Cornelius not tae go into the Grizzled Den alone, but he's always been a stubborn sort.
98319.reward: Ach, the fool...$B$BThank ye for the help, $N. Guess we have our report.

98321.title: Flintfire's Shipment
98321.details: Hoha! Good to see a $R who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.$B$BIf yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!$B$BSay, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321.objectives: Collect 8 Flintfire Shipments from the Grizzled Den for Tongus Flintfire in Kharanos.
98321.request: Wendigos are nasty beasties. Its just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321.reward: Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!

98322.title: Secure the Mountain
98322.details: Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.$B$BTrouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.$B$BIf you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322.objectives: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.
98322.reward: Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye?$B$BI got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!

98323.title: Secure the Mountain
98323.details: Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.$B$BFrom what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.$B$BFeel free tae pass along the message, $N. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.
98323.objectives: Deliver Mountaineer Gretchen's Report back to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
98323.request: Ah, you're back just in time.$B$BWhat's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323.reward: Completely overrun? Why am I not surprised.$B$BWell, that's going in the report too.$B$B<Senir folds Gretchen's letter into his pile of notes>

98326.title: Frosthowl
98326.details: Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.$B$BWell, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.$B$BDo us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
98326.objectives: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village.
98326.request: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
98326.reward: Yer a real lifesaver, $N!$B$BMy husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.

98340.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98340.details: It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.$B$BYou have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98340.objectives: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
98340.reward: And so it continues, Father Cenarius.$B$B<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.>$B$BGreetings again, $N. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.

98341.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
98341.details: A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.$B$BAll druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.$B$BIt can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.
98341.objectives: Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in the southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.
98341.reward: Greetings, young shen'dorei. I have come to you because I sense you are ready to undertake the trial to determine if you understand my spiritual nature or not.$B$BI will have you take the trial of the Great Cat Spirit of Azeroth, but as you are from Zephras, I wished to oversee your progress myself. After all, it is my shape you would take, not that of a Azerothian cat spirit.$B$BLet us begin.

98342.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98342.details: To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.$B$BIn the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.$B$BReturn these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98342.objectives: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.
98342.request: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98342.reward: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.$B$BI now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $C.

98362.title: To Thunder Bluff
98362.details: The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.$B$BGo back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98362.objectives: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
98362.reward: Welcome back, $N. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.$B$BI will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.

98372.title: An Unfortunate End
98372.details: The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.$B$BYou notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.

98386.title: Alther's Mill
98386.details: Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!$B$BIf you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.$B$BOh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.
98386.objectives: Slay 12 Greater Tarantulas and destroy 6 Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.
98386.reward: The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.$B$BI'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, $N!

98387.title: Blackrock Blockade
98387.details: You can't fight a war without weapons.$B$BThough the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.$B$BHead southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.$B$BWe'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387.objectives: Bring 8 Stolen Weapons and 10 Blackrock Supplies to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
98387.request: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387.reward: Excellent work, $N. With the Blackrock orcs cut off from their allies in the Burning Steppes, they will have no hope of maintaining their foothold here without proper supplies.

98389.title: A Light in the Darkness
98389.details: Greetings, $C. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.$B$BThis is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.$B$BIn truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
98389.objectives: Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
98389.request: Have you freed the poor, unfortunate souls trapped in that cave?
98389.reward: May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.$B$BThey will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.$B$BLight be with you.

98391.title: The Sisterhood of Elune
98391.details: Blessings to you, $C. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.$B$BBefore the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.$B$BWe now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391.objectives: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
98391.reward: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.

98392.title: Darkness in the Glade
98392.details: These belts... look closely at the leather, $N. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?$B$BI have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.$B$BVenture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
98392.objectives: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
98392.request: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392.reward: <Arynia investigates the amulets.>$B$BDo you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.$B$BI have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.$B$BI will inform my superiors of this at once.

98393.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98393.details: It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.$B$BYou have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98393.objectives: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
98393.reward: And so it continues, Father Cenarius.$B$B<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.>$B$BGreetings again, $N. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.

98394.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98394.details: In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.$B$BMuch like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.$B$BGo meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
98394.objectives: Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.
98394.reward: I see you have come to learn to draw upon my spirit. Good. Let us see if you are ready to take my shape.

98396.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98396.details: To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.$B$BIn the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.$B$BReturn these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98396.objectives: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.
98396.request: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98396.reward: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.$B$BI now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $C.

98397.title: To Darnassus
98397.details: The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.$B$BGo back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98397.objectives: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.
98397.reward: Welcome back, $N. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.$B$BI will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.

98398.title: The Oracle Tree
98398.details: I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, $N. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.$B$BI have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
98398.objectives: Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.
98398.reward: As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.

98403.title: Twisted Hatred
98403.details: Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.$B$BHe has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.$B$BDispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
98403.objectives: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
98403.request: <Tallonkai lowers his voice.>$B$BDoes Xethorr still walk freely?
98403.reward: I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.$B$BI have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.$B$BNormally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we kept this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.$B$BI trust you to do the same.

98404.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
98404.details: In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.$B$BIn the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.$B$BReturn these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.
98404.objectives: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Avatar of Saeyleenan.
98404.request: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98404.reward: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.$B$BI now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $C.

98405.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98405.details: In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.$B$BMuch like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.$B$BGo meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
98405.objectives: Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.
98405.reward: I see you have come to learn to draw upon my spirit. Good. Let us see if you are ready to take my shape.

98407.title: Show of Force
98407.details: If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.$B$BThe beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.$B$BShould you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
98407.objectives: Collect 5 Spiked Collars from Redridge Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.
98407.request: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407.reward: Quite the armful you have.$B$BWhile this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, $N.

98417.title: Vengeful Trail
98417.details: At the moment our fates bound us most vulnerable, tragedy fell upon our villages. Satyrs defiled our temples, their profane touch staining sacred boughs, and they slaughtered the innocent without mercy.$B$BKurothel was consumed by wrath. The druids are taking the fight to the satyr, and he has followed.$B$BOur bond endures. I feel my husband, west, within these woods. Please, return to me with news of his fate.
98417.objectives: Maseara Autumnmoon wants you to search west of Forest Song, amongst the Satyrnaar demons. Report any signs of her husband Kurothel upon your return.
98417.request: What have you found within the hills of our forest?
98417.reward: Oh no... words like these do not bring me comfort. Kurothel must be more than living in the wild, he's living more like a wild beast each passing night.$B$BI fear the whispers must be true.

98418.title: Shared Fury
98418.details: Kurothel mentioned sightings of what they say are wolf-men. Those of the pack now lurking in greater numbers in our forest. Last we had spoken, druids were pursuing communication with those of the beast heart who displayed measured control of their animal instincts.$B$BHis written words show a darker struggle. If there is anything we can do to help see HIM again, surely quelling the demon threat that is driving him to this burning transformation will be of aid to his anguished soul.$B$BSlay the Xavian, $N.
98418.objectives: Kill 5 Xavian Rogues, 5 Felsworn, 5 Betrayers, and 5 Hellcallers.$BReturn to Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song afterwards.
98418.reward: There was a welling up of... Elune's light within and around me. I feel Kurothel has witnessed your act of battle within this war that rages within our land, and within our hearts.$B$BMy hopes are that with time, the efforts of our Sentinels and our wayward druids will eliminate the demonic menace once and for all. Perhaps then and only then will the feral drive for vengeance burn out from our lineage's heritage.$B$BThank you, $N. You are an ally to the forest, and a friend of the Kaldorei.

98423.title: The Treaty of Understanding
98423.details: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423.objectives: Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
98423.request: What have you brought from the depths, $C.
98423.reward: Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.$B$BAs you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not.$B$BThank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, $C.

98424.title: Fizsprocket's Notes
98424.details: Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.$B$BThey seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.
98424.objectives: Collect the rest of Supervisor Fizsprocket's pages inside The Venture Co. Mine and bring them to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
98424.request: What is it you bring me, $C?
98424.reward: Ah, this is most valuable knowledge. I thank you for your efforts.$B$B<Morin looks through the notes.>$B$BIt seems our next move is clear.

98427.title: Ceasing Operations
98427.details: The shredder one of the pages speaks of--I have seen them before in my travels. They can decimate a forest in a fraction of the time that hand and axe can.$B$BEntire glades--homes to the Earth Mother's children for millennia--erased in days.$B$BWe will not allow this to happen in our home, a stone's throw from where our young ones take their first steps.$B$B$N, I must ask you to gather others, go back into the mine to the northeast, and ensure it fells not a single tree more.
98427.objectives: Bring the Clearcutter Key to Morin Cloudstalker outside Bloodhoof Village.
98427.reward: All of Bloodhoof Village is in your debt this day. May the Earth Mother's grace stay with you always.

98430.title: The Longwalkers
98430.details: Hail, $C. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?$B$BI was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.$B$BAll you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.$B$BAre you up to the task?
98430.objectives: Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, and report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
98430.reward: I am relieved that Longwalker Stormhoof is well. He is my most trusted scout, and his mission of the utmost importance.$B$BPlease, accept my thanks and my hospitality for riskng your life to save his own. You have done a greater service to our people than you know.$B$BI encourage you to explore our great city while you are here. It is a place of safety, and you will find many that may aid you on your own travels upon its bluffs.$B$BIsh-ne-alo por-ah.

98435.title: Thunderhorn's Report
98435.details: Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.$B$BPlease, take this to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.
98435.objectives: Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.$B$BProvided item:
98435.reward: Ah, no wonder there is such joy running through the streams of Mulgore. You have done a great service today. The wells provide much for not only our people, but to the wildlife we depend on for food, clothing, and companionship.$B$BIt is my humble pleasure to honor Mull's request. Please, accept this token of my gratitude.

98459.title: A Lack of Virtue
98459.details: Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!$B$B"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!$B$BIf you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.$B$BThere's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!$B$BAnd he cheats at poker!
98459.objectives: Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
98459.request: Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!$B$BOh? What's that you have there, traveler?
98459.reward: <Bart unwraps the gift.>$B$BWhy that no good, son of a--$B$BDid he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!$B$BI swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--$B$BI'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!
