98461.title: Unrequited Love
98461.details: If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!$B$BMy dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.$B$B<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>$B$BSorry, and his wife... Merrin.$B$BIt doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
98461.objectives: Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
98461.reward: <Tarrel reads the note.>$B$BOh... oh my. Poor Hollee.$B$BShe always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married!$B$BI think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!

98463.title: Talk of the Town
98463.details: Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.$B$BThe real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.$B$BDon't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.$B$BNixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
98463.objectives: Visit Nixxrax Fillamug in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn.
98463.reward: I've got what you need, pal! Stay awhile, spend some of that gold weighing down your pocket, and have a good time.$B$BWelcome to the Salty Sailor Tavern!

98471.title: Message from the Supreme Magister
98471.details: Greetings, $N.$B$BI have an assignment for you that is of the utmost priority. Please meet me in the mountains called Alterac, northwest of the village known as Strahnbrad. I will meet you at the cliff overlooking the Uplands valley.$B$BCome alone, and tell no one.
98471.objectives: Meet Elaadrin Evengale at the cliffs overlooking The Uplands in Alterac Mountains.

98512.title: Al'Aketh Assassins
98512.details: You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.$B$BI was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.$B$BIf you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
98512.objectives: Kill 10 Al'Aketh Assassins in the Shen'dar Highlands.
98512.request: I wonder what they are after?
98512.reward: I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers.$B$BThank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.

98517.title: Call of Fire
98517.details: Greetings, young Skyborne. The spirits have spoken of you, and tell me that you are ready to heed the call of fire. However, I shall not be the one to start you on that Path. Return to your home in the elemental plane, seek your mentors there. They will tell you what must be done.
98517.objectives: Report to Sessaria Skystride or Aarnor Galestrike on Zephras Isle to continue your training as a Shaman.$B$BYou can return to Zephras via the skycutter transport that docks in Mulgore at Skywatcher Plateau, northwest of Thunder Bluff.

98545.title: Leonid's Letter
98545.details: Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.$B$BYou are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.$B$B<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
98545.objectives: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.
98545.request: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
98545.reward: Thanks for delivering this, pal.$B$BWait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that!$B$BFine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.

98574.title: Hallowed Memorandum
98574.details: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98574.objectives: Read the Hallowed Memorandum and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.
98574.request: Ah, another $R comin' ta learn about the Light! You'll find that deepening your connection to the Light relies on curiosity and intelligence, qualities that many gnomes have in abundance. The way o' the Light isn't a technical discipline, it's a riddle, and one that provides both life lessons and practical blessings.
98574.reward: With time and practice, you'll discover new facets to the Light. In a way, it's finding a union between what you think and what you feel. As you deepen your connection with the Light, you can come back to me to talk about what you've learned. I'll be happy to show you how to tap into that force to teach ya how to heal, or to smite the wicked. For a small donation, of course!

98575.title: Tainted Tablet
98575.details: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.$B$BI usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
98575.objectives: Read the Tainted Tablet and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
98575.request: Ah, you received my message. Excellent. We orcs have a long and turbulent history with the entities of the Nether, but now we forge our own path, in command of our destiny. You, too, can seize the power to shape the future for your people. Where our leaders falter, we are ready to press forward and claim our rightful place. You will be of eminence among the trolls.
98575.reward: You have just glimpsed the power that can be yours. The feeble and foolish among us are afraid of the path that we tread, but with boldness and cunning we can decide our own fates.$B$BGuard your powers closely. The fearful lash out against that which they do not understand.$B$BNow you are one of us. If you need training in spells then return to me.

98576.title: Glyphic Parchment
98576.details: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
98576.objectives: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
98576.request: Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.
98576.reward: Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do.$B$BWhen ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.

98581.title: Archaic Rune
98581.details: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the shaman trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581.objectives: Read the Archaic Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
98581.request: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of a $C.
98581.reward: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new shamans learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.

98601.title: A Difficult Path
98601.details: While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a paladin like yourself.$B$BRead it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601.objectives: Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.
98601.reward: Your training can now begin in earnest, $C. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.

98731.title: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
98731.details: I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.$B$BNow you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.

98738.title: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit
98738.details: I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.$B$BNow you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.

98739.title: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
98739.details: Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.$B$BMay the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.
98739.reward: <Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>$B$BI sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.$B$BNow you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.

98815.title: Highland Hides
98815.details: The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?$B$BI don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
98815.objectives: Return 4 Thicket Raptor Hides to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.
98815.request: Welcome back, $C. Need any leather oil for your equipment?
98815.reward: These are some of the most impressive hides I've ever held; these will make spectacular detailing on all of my fine trim. Thank you, $N.$B$BTry these on and take one you'd like in trade.

98823.title: Earthen Echo
98823.details: Truly, this is a fascinating object.$B$BIt shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.$B$BWhile our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.$B$BYou can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.objectives: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.reward: Ah... this shard hums with the voice of the world itself. The light within is a memory from the past, glimmering with flashes of history. This titan machine must have been waiting to be understood for lifetimes.$B$BYou've done wisely to bring it to us. The Earthen Ring will safeguard it, study it, and share the truths it keeps when we are able to receive its messages.$B$BYou honor the elements today, traveler.

98824.title: Prehistoric Prism
98824.details: With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.$B$BI'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by $N! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.$B$BHigh Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.$B$BGood find!
98824.objectives: Bring the Titan Relic to High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.
98824.request: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.
98824.reward: What's this you've got...$B$BWoah! Look at this marvel! The light through it dances like nothin' I've seen since my first dig in old Uldaman. The marks of the keepers on this cannot be mistaken.$B$BYou've done the League a great service bringin' this home. A find like this pushes the very boundaries o' the world's wisdom forward.$B$BWe'll be sure to record the details of your contribution! Truly a job well done, adventurer.

98887.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
98887.details: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.$B$BGo, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98887.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
98887.request: What news from the Darkspear Islands, $N?
98887.reward: The sands of the Darkspear Islands are awash with the blood of the Alliance you've killed. Well done, $N.$B$BFor the Horde!

98888.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
98888.details: The fight in Darkspear Islands is ceaseless, $N. Together, we will destroy the Alliance dogs in the Theramore Expeditionary Force!
98888.reward: Well done, $C! You've helped the Horde gain control of Darkspear Islands!

98889.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
98889.details: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.$B$BGo, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98889.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

98891.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
98891.details: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.$B$BGo, show them the might of the horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98891.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

98893.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
98893.details: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.$B$BGo, show them the might of the horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98893.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

98895.title: Darkspear Islands Clash
98895.details: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.$B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98895.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
98895.request: How goes your campaign in the Darkspear Islands, $N?
98895.reward: You've distinguished yourself honorably in battle at the Darkspear Islands and your efforts have not gone unnoticed.$B$BThere are ever more battles to fight, however. Continue to prove yourself in battle and you will surely reap the rewards.

98896.title: Darkspear Islands Clash
98896.details: The fight in the Darkspear Islands continues, $N. Rally your forces and crush the Darkspear Raiders!
98896.reward: Excellent work, $C! With each blow struck against the Darkspear Raiders, we move one step closer to total victory.$B$BFor the Alliance!

98897.title: Darkspear Islands Clash
98897.details: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.$B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98897.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

98899.title: Darkspear Islands Clash
98899.details: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.$B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98899.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

98901.title: Darkspear Islands Clash
98901.details: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.$B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98901.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

98903.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!
98903.details: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, $N! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98903.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.
98903.reward: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are grateful for your dedication and prowess in the battle for the Darkspear Islands, $N.$B$BFor the Alliance!

98904.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!
98904.details: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, $N! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98904.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.

98905.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!
98905.details: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, $N! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98905.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.

98906.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!
98906.details: The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $C. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is.$B$BCarry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $C!
98906.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.
98906.reward: You be showin' strength and dedication out at the Darkspear Islands! Your prowess in battle are to be admired, mon!

98907.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!
98907.details: The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $C. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $C!
98907.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.

98908.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!
98908.details: The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $C. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is.$B$BCarry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $C!
98908.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.

99046.title: The Lost Runner
99046.details: The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.$B$BI received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.$B$BPlease head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
99046.objectives: Search for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road leading to the Oracle Glade.
99046.reward: Elune's grace... I shall not die... alone...

99047.title: Not Dead Yet
99047.details: My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...$B$BTree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...$B$B<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>$B$BI may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047.objectives: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolanaar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.
99047.reward: The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.$B$BWe must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.

99048.title: A Missing Hand
99048.details: A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.$B$BI doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
99048.objectives: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
99048.reward: Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.$B$BWhatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.

99049.title: Threat from Below
99049.details: The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.$B$BOrgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049.objectives: Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.
99049.reward: This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.$B$BWe cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.

99050.title: The Great Tree Provides
99050.details: I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.$B$BThankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.$B$BThe core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.$B$BIn addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
99050.objectives: Collect 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds, an Empty Vial, and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar.
99050.request: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
99050.reward: Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water.$B$BNow, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.

99051.title: Threat from Below
99051.details: It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.$B$BFind where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.
99051.request: Hopefully those snake scum aren't giving you trouble?
99051.reward: Hopefully that sends them packing back to the north. I'll have some grunts keep an eye out for any stragglers or funny business.

99052.title: Threat from Below
99052.details: One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.$B$BIt's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
99052.objectives: Kill the sea giant along Durotar's north coast and bring back proof of your accomplishment.
99052.reward: Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!$B$BBe proud of your kill today, not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.

99053.title: Escaping Ban'ethil
99053.details: My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.$B$BI was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.$B$BI don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
99053.objectives: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.
99053.reward: Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend.$B$BPlease, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.

99073.title: Easing Suffering
99073.details: The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.$B$BI do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.$B$BIt will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
99073.objectives: Take the Lashwater Salve to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road to the Oracle Tree.
99073.request: <Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.>
99073.reward: <Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.>

99079.title: Longwalker Malah
99079.details: The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.$B$BThis is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.$B$BI must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079.objectives: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.
99079.reward: It is clear that Malah did not die naturally. Arrows cover her back and the ground nearby.

99080.title: Drive Them Out
99080.details: Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.$B$BGo to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.$B$BIf you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080.objectives: Kill 6 Galak Centaurs, 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.
99080.reward: You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.$B$BI could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!$B$BToday marks a great victory for our village, and a security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young $C.

99081.title: Grim Tidings
99081.details: You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.$B$BThe Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
99081.objectives: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.$B$BProvided item:
99081.reward: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!

99082.title: The High Chieftain
99082.details: Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.$B$BIt was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.$B$BYou must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
99082.objectives: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
99082.reward: The Galak centaur dare show themselves in Mulgore?!$B$BYou have brought pride to your ancestors by driving them out. Perhaps that will remind them of the pain that awaits them should they do so again!$B$BPlease accept this gift in honor of this. May it serve you well as you venture out into the Earth Mother's kingdom, to the far reaches of this world.

99101.title: Our Ancient Enemy
99101.details: Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.$B$BBring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.$B$BQuickly, now. There is no time to waste!
99101.objectives: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.
99101.request: What is it you bring me, $C?
99101.reward: <Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>$B$BThis will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, $N.

99108.title: Sparring Match
99108.details: Hail, young $C. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.$B$BBefore you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.$B$BWill you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108.objectives: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.
99108.request: There is no teacher quite like the sharp end of your adversary pointed at your heart.
99108.reward: You honor me with your abilities, $C. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.$B$BTake these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.

99123.title: Lost in the Shadows
99123.details: I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.$B$BIf you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.
99123.objectives: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
99123.reward: Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?$B$BHopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.

99127.title: A Net Disaster
99127.details: The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.$B$BLee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127.objectives: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.
99127.reward: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.

99128.title: Slimy Menace
99128.details: This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match.$B$BIf we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128.objectives: Kill the murlocs at Crystal Lake.
99128.reward: I can hear their warbling from here, it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.

99129.title: A Man About a Murloc
99129.details: Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do.$B$BHe might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
99129.objectives: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.
99129.reward: I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.$B$BI have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.

99130.title: An Enticing Offer
99130.details: I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.$B$BThere's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.$B$BAnd some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.
99130.reward: Give me just a minute...$B$BIt's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.

99131.title: Baited for Success
99131.details: Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.$B$BHopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.
99131.reward: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.

99134.title: Discipline
99134.details: You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.$B$BAs a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.$B$BSwiftly now--$N, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
99134.objectives: Punish 5 Deathguards for Executor Zygand.$B$BProvided item:
99134.reward: There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.$B$BYou please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.

99141.title: Patience
99141.details: Make no mistake, $C--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.$B$BReports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.$B$BYou will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
99141.objectives: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
99141.request: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141.reward: I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.$B$BYou have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.

99142.title: Tomb Weed
99142.details: If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.$B$BAs I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.$B$BDo keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
99142.objectives: Collect 5 Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
99142.request: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142.reward: Most glorious indeed!$B$B<Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.>$B$BHmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!$B$BA great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.

99143.title: Bottles and Baubles
99143.details: Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!$B$BIf you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.
99143.request: What did you find? Anything interesting?
99143.reward: An interesting collection. These should work well enough!$B$BHere's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.

99144.title: Seeking Refuge
99144.details: Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!$B$BBareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>$B$BI know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144.objectives: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.
99144.reward: Blessings upon you for aiding Dawnstone. Our order is still taking root here and it would be devastating to lose one so promising before his time.$B$BPlease accept this as a token of our thanks. Should you ever take an interest in our ways, our monastery Bandarion Keep lies on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. We welcome all who seek guidance in the Light.

99152.title: As Above, So Below
99152.details: While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.$B$BI need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.$B$BTravel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
99152.objectives: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
99152.request: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
99152.reward: Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.$B$BWith these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.

99153.title: The One That Got Away
99153.details: Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.$B$BProblem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.$B$BFind that crystal before this gets out of hand.
99153.objectives: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
99153.request: Did you find the damned thing?
99153.reward: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...

99156.title: Rear Guard Patrol
99156.details: Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.$B$BSomething is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.$B$BKeep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.$B$BSee this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
99156.objectives: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
99156.request: Have you dealt with our little problem?
99156.reward: You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.$B$BPlease accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.

99158.title: Dawn in the Mountains
99158.details: There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.$B$BFather Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?
99158.objectives: Bring the crate of candles to Father Gavin at Misty Pine Refuge.
99158.request: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158.reward: Ah. Candles from Ironforge.$B$BWhile I am mostly able to live independently in my hermitage, there are a few key things that I appreciate from the city and the pious.

99159.title: Finding Warmth
99159.details: My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.$B$BI simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
99159.request: Light guide you on your tasks.
99159.reward: Ah, perfect. These will do--any that are too wet to use right now I will leave to dry.$B$BNow, if you're willing, I have more tasks I could use help with.

99160.title: Rime's Wrath
99160.details: You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.$B$BThese frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.
99160.reward: I wish we could have simply placated them. Unfortunately it was beyond my knowledge and they were too dangerous to leave unchecked.

99161.title: Rime's Wrath
99161.details: I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasional weather changes and other minor slides.$B$BI've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.
99161.objectives: Kill Avala and retrieve its core.
99161.reward: Light bless you, $C. Your efforts make this area much safer and hopefully will prevent unnecessary deaths.

99162.title: Treacherous Cold
99162.details: Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.$B$BAfter a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
99162.objectives: Collect the rifles of fallen mountaineers.
99162.reward: The mountaineers engrave their names on the stock of their rifles. It helps identify them should something happen. I'll send these back to Ironforge--there someone will pass them on to any family.

99191.title: A Donation of Wool
99191.details: The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.$B$BA donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions.  Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now.$B$BIf you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99191.reward: Wonderful!$B$BWe thank you for your generous donation, $N!

99192.title: A Donation of Silk
99192.details: Upon completion of this quest you will gain:$B$B150 reputation with High Order

99196.title: A Donation of Wool
99196.details: The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.$B$BA donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity.$B$BIf you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196.reward: We thank you for your generous donation!$B$BWinds be with you, friend.

99197.title: A Donation of Silk
99197.details: Upon completion of this quest you will gain:$B$B150 reputation with Windshapers

99260.title: Fillion's Mission
99260.details: I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.$B$BThe data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
99260.objectives: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.
99260.reward: Thank you for saving Fillion, $N. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is.$B$BWithout that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth is at serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret.$B$BAs ever, their own dogmatic hubris take precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.

99267.title: An Unfortunate End
99267.details: The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.$B$BYou notice that the corpse still has an unlit torch in his hand. You must not have taken it earlier after all.$B$BYou reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.

99411.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
99411.details: Help, $N! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.$B$BWill you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.$B$BTo feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
99411.objectives: Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.$B$BFeed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.
99411.reward: Fantastic work, $N! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
